english: Not at all! I'll make arrangements so they all arrive at their proper destinations.
french: Non, pas du tout ! Je veillerai à ce qu'elles arrivent toutes à bon port.
russian: Вовсе нет! Я позабочусь, чтобы каждое письмо нашло своего адресата.
bulgarian: Not at all! I'll make arrangements so they all arrive at their proper destinations.

english: I have some letters here for various people in the Capital. I hope this isn't too many!
french: J'ai plusieurs lettres pour des habitants de la capitale. J'espère que ça n'en fait pas trop !
russian: Я тут приготовила письма для разных людей в столице. Это же не слишком много?
bulgarian: I have some letters here for various people in the Capital. I hope this isn't too many!

english: It's great for the local economy, and the entire town really looks forward to it!
french: C'est très bon pour l'économie locale, et les habitants adorent y flâner.
russian: Во-первых, он поднимает местную экономику. Во-вторых, все горожане каждую неделю его ждут!
bulgarian: It's great for the local economy, and the entire town really looks forward to it!

english: I know I sure do! I don't know how I got through the week without Darcy's =Coffee=!
french: Oui, et moi aussi ! Je ne sais pas comment j'ai réussi à tenir toute la semaine sans le =café= de Darcy !
russian: Да, я точно жду! Не знаю, как бы я протянула неделю без =кофе= Дарси!
bulgarian: I know I sure do! I don't know how I got through the week without Darcy's =Coffee=!

english: After a few seasons, it's fair to say that the Saturday Market is better than ever.
french: Après quelques saisons, on peut dire que le marché du samedi est un vrai succès.
russian: Субботний базар пережил уже несколько сезонов, и можно точно сказать, что дела у него идут отлично.
bulgarian: After a few seasons, it's fair to say that the Saturday Market is better than ever.

english: Got it. I'll let March know...
french: Entendu. Je préviendrai March...
russian: Понятно. Тогда я попрошу Марта...
bulgarian: Got it. I'll let March know...

english: I've got another shipment coming in, but I'm afraid nails aren't on the manifest.
french: J'attends un autre arrivage, mais je ne vois pas de clous sur le bon de commande.
russian: Новый заказ скоро приедет, но, к сожалению, гвоздей в этой поставке нет.
bulgarian: I've got another shipment coming in, but I'm afraid nails aren't on the manifest.

english: I'm attached to my wagon, Adeline. That's four walls, a roof, and wheels!
french: Je suis habitué à mon chariot, Adeline. Il a quatre murs, un toit et, pour ne rien gâcher, des roues !
russian: Мне по душе мой фургон, Аделина. Тут тоже отдельная крыша и ещё четыре колеса в придачу!
bulgarian: I'm attached to my wagon, Adeline. That's four walls, a roof, and wheels!

english: You really don't want a permanent storefront here? With four walls and a roof?
french: Ça ne te dirait vraiment pas d'avoir une boutique en dur ? Avec quatre murs et un toit ?
russian: Уверен, что не хочешь открыть у нас постоянную лавку? Будешь торговать под отдельной крышей.
bulgarian: You really don't want a permanent storefront here? With four walls and a roof?

english: Glad I folded early. My merchant's instinct was whispering to me.
french: Heureusement que je m'étais couché avant. Mon flair de marchand ne m'a pas trompé.
russian: Хорошо, что я рано ушёл в пас. Чутьё торговца не обмануло.
bulgarian: Glad I folded early. My merchant's instinct was whispering to me.

english: I really thought Adeline was going to take it! How did you know, Celine?
french: Je pensais vraiment que c'était Adeline qui allait gagner ! Comment tu as fait, Céline ?
russian: Я была уверена, что Аделина заберёт банк! Как ты догадалась, Селин?
bulgarian: I really thought Adeline was going to take it! How did you know, Celine?

english: I kind of got the feeling Adeline was keeping her cards in order, but she didn't rearrange them when she got her last card!
french: J'ai eu l'impression que les cartes d'Adeline étaient rangées dans l'ordre, et elle ne les a pas réorganisées quand elle a eu la dernière !
russian: У меня было чувство, что Аделина держит карты по порядку. Но она не меняла порядок, когда взяла последнюю карту!
bulgarian: I kind of got the feeling Adeline was keeping her cards in order, but she didn't rearrange them when she got her last card!

english: Oh gosh... am I too organized?
french: Mince... Serais-je trop bien organisée ?
russian: Ну и ну! Выходит, я слишком аккуратная...
bulgarian: Oh gosh... am I too organized?

english: Celine wins! Wow, that was a nail-biter.
french: Et c'est Céline qui gagne ! La partie était drôlement tendue.
russian: Селин выиграла! Ух, напряжённая была партия!
bulgarian: Celine wins! Wow, that was a nail-biter.

english: I've got a silk scarf from the Capital.
french: Moi, je joue une écharpe en soie de la capitale.
russian: С меня столичный шёлковый платок.
bulgarian: I've got a silk scarf from the Capital.

english: I'll see that and bet you the first flush tea from my own garden.
french: Je suis, et je parie le thé de printemps de mon jardin.
russian: Ну, раз так, я поставлю чай из первого урожая в моём садике.
bulgarian: I'll see that and bet you the first flush tea from my own garden.

english: I'll put up a free breakfast!
french: Moi, je renchéris d'un petit-déjeuner gratuit !
russian: Ставлю бесплатный завтрак!
bulgarian: I'll put up a free breakfast!

english: And I'll take the whole pot! Read 'em and weep, guys and gals.
french: Et moi, je repars avec le pot ! Vous pouvez pleurer, mesdames et messieurs.
russian: А я заберу этот чудный банк! Кусайте локти, дамы и господа!
bulgarian: And I'll take the whole pot! Read 'em and weep, guys and gals.

english: Okay, so to review, I'm betting a dozen roses from the manor garden.
french: Bien, récapitulons. Je parie un bouquet de roses des jardins de manoir.
russian: Итак, повторим ещё раз. Я ставлю дюжину роз из сада особняка.
bulgarian: Okay, so to review, I'm betting a dozen roses from the manor garden.

english: I think it's high time for me to fold.
french: Moi, je me couche.
russian: Я думаю, самое время мне пасовать.
bulgarian: I think it's high time for me to fold.

english: Hmm. I think Celine's got a winning hand.
french: Mmm. Je crois que Céline a une bonne main.
russian: Хмм, кажется, у Селин сильная рука.
bulgarian: Hmm. I think Celine's got a winning hand.

english: Why would you think that!
french: Pourquoi dis-tu ça ?
russian: Почему ты так думаешь?
bulgarian: Why would you think that!

english: My cards are so bad! The worst!
french: J'ai un jeu horrible ! Vraiment !
russian: У меня просто ужасные карты! Хуже не бывает!
bulgarian: My cards are so bad! The worst!

english: Ummm... yeah, I'm out too.
french: Euh... OK, je me couche aussi.
russian: Ууу... пожалуй, я тоже пас.
bulgarian: Ummm... yeah, I'm out too.

english: So, how're we feeling? Any raises?
french: Alors, vous le sentez comment ? Quelqu'un relance ?
russian: Что думаете? Кто-то будет повышать?
bulgarian: So, how're we feeling? Any raises?

english: That was so exciting!
french: C'était fantastique !
russian: Какой потрясающий рассказ!
bulgarian: That was so exciting!

english: And stressful.
french: Et stressant.
russian: И тревожный.
bulgarian: And stressful.

english: So stressful!
french: Oui, vraiment stressant !
russian: Ещё какой тревожный!
bulgarian: So stressful!

english: What a tale! We should have you over for dinner more often, Balor.
french: Quelle histoire ! Nous devrions t'inviter à dîner plus souvent, Balor.
russian: Вот это история! Надо почаще приглашать тебя на ужин, Балор.
bulgarian: What a tale! We should have you over for dinner more often, Balor.

english: And that's the story of how I won a most dangerous game of cards, with my very life on the line.
french: Et c'est ainsi que j'ai gagné une partie de cartes déterminante. J'ai presque joué ma vie.
russian: Вот так я выиграл самую опасную партию в карты, поставив на кон свою жизнь.
bulgarian: And that's the story of how I won a most dangerous game of cards, with my very life on the line.

english: Is there one on the board that might suit my abilities?
french: Y en a-t-il une sur le panneau qui serait à la hauteur de mes facultés ?
russian: Найдётся ли на доске прошений задача мне по способностям?
bulgarian: Is there one on the board that might suit my abilities?

english: Let me see... how are you at smelting?
french: Voyons voir... Vous savez fondre du métal ?
russian: Давай посмотрим... Как ты относишься к плавлению металла?
bulgarian: Let me see... how are you at smelting?

english: The best word for it would likely be... incapable.
french: Je crains que mes compétences en ce domaine soient... nulles.
russian: Вернее всего будет сказать... не способен.
bulgarian: The best word for it would likely be... incapable.

english: And how is your logging ability?
french: Et couper du bois, vous savez faire ?
russian: А умеешь ли ты рубить дрова?
bulgarian: And how is your logging ability?

english: One could say... poor.
french: Je... n'excelle pas dans cette activité.
russian: Я бы сказал... едва ли.
bulgarian: One could say... poor.

english: In that case... I'll keep you in the loop when something else comes up!
french: Dans ce cas... dès que j'aurai une requête qui vous convient, je vous la réserverai !
russian: В таком случае... Я тебе сообщу, если понадобится что-нибудь ещё!
bulgarian: In that case... I'll keep you in the loop when something else comes up!

english: Lady Adeline... I would like to fulfill a request, if you are amenable.
french: Dame Adeline... Je souhaite répondre à une requête, si cela vous sied.
russian: Леди Аделина... Я бы хотел выполнить прошение, если вы не против.
bulgarian: Lady Adeline... I would like to fulfill a request, if you are amenable.

english: You... do?
french: M'avouer... quelque chose ?
russian: И... в чём же?
bulgarian: You... do?

english: Yes. As I understand it, all requests must go through the request board, and you.
french: Oui. D'après ce que je comprends, vous devez valider toutes les requêtes, puis elles doivent être publiées sur le panneau.
russian: Насколько мне известно, все прошения должны подаваться через доску прошений и через вас.
bulgarian: Yes. As I understand it, all requests must go through the request board, and you.

english: During my time recovering in the Deep Woods, I confess that I bypassed the board and sent my requests directly to Balor.
french: Lorsque j'étais en convalescence à Boissombre, je reconnais que j'envoyais toutes mes demandes directement à Balor, sans passer par le panneau.
russian: Признаюсь, что во время моего выздоровления в Глубокой чаще я отправлял прошения Балору напрямую, минуя доску.
bulgarian: During my time recovering in the Deep Woods, I confess that I bypassed the board and sent my requests directly to Balor.

english: Oh. That's totally fine, Caldarus! I'm just glad you got what you needed.
french: Oh. Ne vous en faites pas pour ça, Caldarus ! Je suis juste contente de savoir que vous avez reçu ce dont vous aviez besoin.
russian: О, Кальдарус, это не страшно! Я рада, что тебе удалось добыть, что ты просил.
bulgarian: Oh. That's totally fine, Caldarus! I'm just glad you got what you needed.

english: I am prepared to accept whatever punishment you decide.
french: Je suis prêt à accepter n'importe quel châtiment qui vous semblera juste.
russian: Я готов принять любое наказание, что вы пожелаете.
bulgarian: I am prepared to accept whatever punishment you decide.

english: That's not really how I do things...
french: Ce n'est pas vraiment ma façon de procéder...
russian: Это совсем не мой подход...
bulgarian: That's not really how I do things...

english: Adeline, I have a confession to make.
french: Adeline, il faut que je vous avoue quelque chose.
russian: Аделина, я должен вам признаться.
bulgarian: Adeline, I have a confession to make.

english: It is like a well-tended garden.
french: C'est comme un jardin bien entretenu.
russian: С вами город напоминает ухоженный сад.
bulgarian: It is like a well-tended garden.

english: Oh! No one's ever put it like that before...
french: Oh ! Je n'avais encore jamais entendu cette métaphore...
russian: Ой! Никто ещё не делал таких сравнений...
bulgarian: Oh! No one's ever put it like that before...

english: Thank you, Caldarus!
french: Merci, Caldarus !
russian: Спасибо, Кальдарус!
bulgarian: Thank you, Caldarus!

english: Lady Adeline, I have great admiration for your diligence in caring for the town and the people who reside within.
french: Dame Adeline, j'admire profondément votre dévouement, la façon dont vous prenez soin de la ville et de ses habitants.
russian: Леди Аделина, я глубоко восхищаюсь вашей усердной заботой о городе и всех его обитателях.
bulgarian: Lady Adeline, I have great admiration for your diligence in caring for the town and the people who reside within.

english: Just because it's not happening, doesn't mean we can't hang out!
french: Ce n'est pas parce qu'il n'a plus lieu qu'on ne peut pas se promener sur la place !
russian: Ну и что, что его больше нет? Мы можем выбраться поболтать и без Рынка.
bulgarian: Just because it's not happening, doesn't mean we can't hang out!

english: I miss getting my hair done by a pro... Olric gets a little too excited with the scissors.
french: Ça me manque de me faire couper les cheveux par une professionnelle... Olric a le coup de ciseaux facile.
russian: Я соскучился по профессиональной стрижке... Ольрик слишком резво орудует ножницами.
bulgarian: I miss getting my hair done by a pro... Olric gets a little too excited with the scissors.

english: [Ari] and I are working on it!
french: [Ari] et moi allons remédier à cela !
russian: [Ari] и я уже работаем над этим!
bulgarian: [Ari] and I are working on it!

english: Can't wait!
french: J'ai hâte !
russian: Жду не дождусь!
bulgarian: Can't wait!

english: Hi [Ari]! We were just reminiscing about the Saturday Market!
french: Bonjour, [Ari] ! Nous étions en train de parler du marché du samedi !
russian: Привет, [Ari]! Мы тут вспоминаем, что было на Субботнем базаре.
bulgarian: Hi [Ari]! We were just reminiscing about the Saturday Market!

english: It's my pleasure! I'm already planning next season's arrangement.
french: Avec plaisir ! Je suis déjà en train de réfléchir aux fleurs que je planterai la saison prochaine.
russian: Не за что! Мне это только в радость. Я уже планирую рассадку цветов на следующий сезон.
bulgarian: It's my pleasure! I'm already planning next season's arrangement.

english: Nice. I'll have to come take a look.
french: Bien, il faudra que je vienne voir ça.
russian: Отлично, я зайду посмотреть.
bulgarian: Nice. I'll have to come take a look.

english: March likes flowers? I wouldn't have guessed that.
french: March aime les fleurs ? Je n'aurais pas cru.
russian: Март любит цветы? Никогда бы не подумала.
bulgarian: March likes flowers? I wouldn't have guessed that.

english: He makes them out of metal, actually.
french: En fait, il en fait des reproductions en métal.
russian: На самом деле он куёт металлические.
bulgarian: He makes them out of metal, actually.

english: Ah, so they never wilt. That's rather practical, isn't it?
french: Ah, elles ne fanent jamais, alors ? C'est une bonne idée.
russian: О, зато они не завянут. Весьма практично, правда?
bulgarian: Ah, so they never wilt. That's rather practical, isn't it?

english: The manor garden's lovely this season, Celine! Thank you so much for looking after it.
french: Les jardins du manoir sont magnifiques cette saison, Céline ! Merci beaucoup de t'en occuper.
russian: Наш семейный сад выглядит просто чудесно! Спасибо, Селин, что ухаживаешь за ним.
bulgarian: The manor garden's lovely this season, Celine! Thank you so much for looking after it.

english: [Ari] always stops by my cottage, so polite...
french: Et aimable ! [Ari] s'arrête toujours pour un petit coucou à la maison...
russian:
[Ari]

такие внимательные

такая внимательнаятакой внимательныйтакое внимательное, часто

навещают

навещаетнавещаетнавещает меня дома...
bulgarian: [Ari] always stops by my cottage, so polite...

english: [Ari]'s always helping with my postings on the quest board... so helpful...
french: Et serviable avec ça. <she>Elle</she><he>Il</he><they>Iel</they> accepte toujours les requêtes que j'affiche sur le panneau...
russian:
И всегда

помогают

помогаетпомогаетпомогает мне с прошениями, которые я оставляю на доске...
bulgarian: [Ari]'s always helping with my postings on the quest board... so helpful...

english: You're both so shy, it's just between us!
french: Arrêtez de faire les timides, on est entre nous !
russian: Вы такие застенчивые, пускай это будет между нами!
bulgarian: You're both so shy, it's just between us!

english: Hee hee!
french: Hi hi !
russian: Хи-хи!
bulgarian: Hee hee!

english: OH HELLO [ARI]. WE WERE JUST TALKING ABOUT. THE REQUEST BOARD.
french: OH, C'EST TOI, [ARI] ! ON PARLAIT JUSTEMENT... DU PANNEAU DES QUÊTES.
russian: О, ПРИВЕТ, [Ari]. МЫ КАК РАЗ ОБСУЖДАЛИ ДОСКУ ПРОШЕНИЙ.
bulgarian: OH HELLO [ARI]. WE WERE JUST TALKING ABOUT. THE REQUEST BOARD.

english: -is pretty cute, right?
french: ... est trop chou, pas vrai ?
russian:
...очень

приятные

приятнаяприятныйприятное, вам не кажется?
bulgarian: -is pretty cute, right?

english: I sure do! We used to pretend like we were sneaking around castle ramparts.
french: Mais oui ! On faisait semblant que c'était les remparts d'un château.
russian: Я помню! Мы играли, как будто прячемся в укреплениях замка.
bulgarian: I sure do! We used to pretend like we were sneaking around castle ramparts.

english: Wasn't that game your idea, Celine? I saw Dell reinvent it just the other day.
french: Ce n'est pas toi qui avais eu cette idée, Céline ? J'ai vu Dell y jouer l'autre jour.
russian: Это ты предложила такую игру, Селин? Я на днях видела, как Делл снова её придумала.
bulgarian: Wasn't that game your idea, Celine? I saw Dell reinvent it just the other day.

english: Palace infiltration must run in the family!
french: Se faufiler dans un château, c'est un truc de famille !
russian: Талант проникновения в крепости — это семейное!
bulgarian: Palace infiltration must run in the family!

english: Do you remember when we were little and couldn't see over the railing?
french: Vous vous souvenez quand on était petites et qu'on n'arrivait pas à voir par-dessus de la rambarde ?
russian: Помнишь, в детстве мы были слишком маленькие, чтобы заглянуть через перила?
bulgarian: Do you remember when we were little and couldn't see over the railing?

english: So know that I say this with love... You cannot be having coffee after the sun goes down.
french: Alors, sache que je te dis cela avec beaucoup d'affection... mais tu dois arrêter de boire du café après le coucher du soleil.
russian: Так что учти, я говорю это с любовью... Тебе нельзя пить кофе, когда солнце уже зашло.
bulgarian: So know that I say this with love... You cannot be having coffee after the sun goes down.

english: It makes you crazy, girl.
french: Ça ne te réussit pas, ma chérie.
russian: У тебя от него крыша едет.
bulgarian: It makes you crazy, girl.

english: Is this an intervention? It was just the one time, you guys!
french: Mais vous êtes sérieuses ? Ça n'est arrivé qu'une seule fois !
russian: Это что, профилактическая беседа? Ребята, это же всего один раз было!
bulgarian: Is this an intervention? It was just the one time, you guys!

english: Well. Maybe twice.
french: Bon, deux peut-être.
russian: Ну, может, пару раз.
bulgarian: Well. Maybe twice.

english: Thank you for joining us here today, Adeline. You know we're here because we care for you, right?
french: Merci de te joindre à nous aujourd'hui, Adeline. Tu sais que nous sommes là parce que tu comptes beaucoup pour nous, hein ?
russian: Спасибо, что пришла на наше сегодняшнее собрание, Аделина. Ты знаешь, что мы желаем тебе только добра.
bulgarian: Thank you for joining us here today, Adeline. You know we're here because we care for you, right?

english: Of course! You know we're here for you. And honestly, I love seeing what the tide washes in.
french: Avec plaisir ! Tu sais qu'on est là pour toi. Et franchement, j'adore voir ce que le courant ramène sur le rivage.
russian: Пожалуйста! Можешь на нас рассчитывать. К тому же я сама люблю посмотреть на прилив.
bulgarian: Of course! You know we're here for you. And honestly, I love seeing what the tide washes in.

english: If I find a big enough shell, I can turn it into a flower pot!
french: Si je trouve un coquillage assez grand, je pourrai en faire un pot de fleurs !
russian: Если найду большую ракушку, сделаю из неё горшок!
bulgarian: If I find a big enough shell, I can turn it into a flower pot!

english: Thank you both for dragging me away from work. A walk to the Beach was just what I needed!
french: Merci de m'avoir obligée à faire une pause, les filles. J'avais bien besoin d'une petite balade sur la plage !
russian: Спасибо вам обеим, что вытащили меня с работы. Мне как раз не помешает прогулка на пляже!
bulgarian: Thank you both for dragging me away from work. A walk to the Beach was just what I needed!

english: It was so much fun!
french: Qu'est-ce que c'était drôle !
russian: Ага, это было весело!
bulgarian: It was so much fun!

english: After my mom caught us, she made me do extra chores for a week to pay for it...
french: Quand ma mère nous a attrapées, elle m'a donné plein de tâches ménagères pendant une semaine pour la rembourser...
russian: Когда мама нас поймала, она заставила меня неделю помогать по дому в качестве оплаты...
bulgarian: After my mom caught us, she made me do extra chores for a week to pay for it...

english: And now that I think about it, you two never paid me back!
french: Maintenant que j'y repense... vous ne m'avez jamais remboursée, toutes les deux !
russian: Кстати, раз уж вы вспомнили: вы мне это так и не возместили!
bulgarian: And now that I think about it, you two never paid me back!

english: Order whatever you want from the Inn, it's on us!
french: Commande ce que tu veux à l'auberge, c'est nous qui payons !
russian: Любой заказ в трактире — за наш счёт.
bulgarian: Order whatever you want from the Inn, it's on us!

english: I'll even whip it up for you personally!
french: Ce sera même moi qui te préparerai ça !
russian: Я даже состряпаю его тебе сама!
bulgarian: I'll even whip it up for you personally!

english: Hey Celine, remember when we were little and decided to "taste test" all the candy in your family's store?
french: Céline, tu te souviens du jour où on a voulu goûter tous les bonbons du magasin de tes parents, quand on était petites ?
russian: Помнишь, Селин, мы были маленькие и решили «продегустировать» все конфеты в магазине твоих родителей?
bulgarian: Hey Celine, remember when we were little and decided to "taste test" all the candy in your family's store?

english: Celine, Adeline wants to spend time outside her office. You have to say yes!
french: Céline, Adeline veut sortir de son bureau. Tu ne peux pas dire non !
russian: Представляешь, Аделина хочет выйти из офиса? Ты не можешь отказать, Селин!
bulgarian: Celine, Adeline wants to spend time outside her office. You have to say yes!

english: Haha, of course! I'd love the company.
french: Ha ha, mais oui, vous êtes les bienvenues !
russian: Ха-ха, ну разумеется! Я всегда рада компании.
bulgarian: Haha, of course! I'd love the company.

english: Can we go foraging with you some time, Celine? It seems so relaxing, and it would really get me out of the house.
french: Est-ce qu'on pourrait t'accompagner à la cueillette, un de ces jours, Céline ? Ça a l'air si apaisant et ça m'obligerait à sortir de la maison.
russian: Селин, возьми меня как-нибудь с собой пособирать травы? Кажется, это мой шанс выбраться из дома и расслабиться.
bulgarian: Can we go foraging with you some time, Celine? It seems so relaxing, and it would really get me out of the house.

english: I made hair oil from sunflower seeds! I apply it after taking a bath.
french: J'ai fabriqué de l'huile pour cheveux avec des graines de tournesol ! Je l'applique après mon bain.
russian: Я пользуюсь маслом подсолнуха после мытья головы. Сама его сделала!
bulgarian: I made hair oil from sunflower seeds! I apply it after taking a bath.

english: Ooh, I wanna try! Bring it to the Bathhouse next time!
french: Oh, il faut que j'essaie ! Apporte-la aux bains la prochaine fois !
russian: Ух ты, дашь попробовать? Приноси в следующий раз, когда пойдём в купальню!
bulgarian: Ooh, I wanna try! Bring it to the Bathhouse next time!

english: Ugh, my hair gets so frizzy in the rain. What's your secret, Celine?
french: Argh, j'ai les cheveux qui frisent avec la pluie. Quel est ton secret pour que les tiens restent lisses, Céline ?
russian: Ох, у меня от дождя так пушатся волосы! В чём твой секрет, Селин?
bulgarian: Ugh, my hair gets so frizzy in the rain. What's your secret, Celine?

english: I'm glad! It's really pretty, isn't it? I'm so happy you took charge of the manor grounds, Celine!
french: Excellent ! C'est vraiment joli là-bas, hein ? Je suis tellement contente que tu aies décidé de t'occuper des jardins du manoir, Céline !
russian: Очень рада! И правда милое место. Спасибо, Селин, я так довольна, что ты взялась ухаживать за нашим садом!
bulgarian: I'm glad! It's really pretty, isn't it? I'm so happy you took charge of the manor grounds, Celine!

english: It's fun for me, but also... I want it to look extra special the next time a wedding comes around!
french: Ça me plaît beaucoup, et j'ai aussi envie que... ce soit l'endroit idéal pour un prochain mariage !
russian: Мне нравится эта работа... А кроме того, я хочу, чтобы всё сияло в следующий раз, когда здесь будет свадьба!
bulgarian: It's fun for me, but also... I want it to look extra special the next time a wedding comes around!

english: My parents still talk about getting married by the gazebo! They love it out here.
french: Mes parents parlent toujours de se marier devant le kiosque ! Ils adorent cet endroit.
russian: Родители до сих пор рассказывают, как поженились рядом с этой беседкой. Им тут очень нравится.
bulgarian: My parents still talk about getting married by the gazebo! They love it out here.

english: Show that paperwork who's boss!
french: Montre à toute cette paperasse que c'est toi qui commandes !
russian: Давай! Покажи этим бумажкам, кто тут главный!
bulgarian: Show that paperwork who's boss!

english: You guys were right! Work does go faster when your friends are rooting for you!
french: Vous aviez raison ! Ça va plus vite quand on a des amies pour nous encourager !
russian: Вы были правы. Когда друзья за тебя болеют, работается гораздо легче!
bulgarian: You guys were right! Work does go faster when your friends are rooting for you!

english: Go Adeline go! You can do it!
french: Allez, Adeline ! Tu vas y arriver !
russian: Аделина, вперёд! Ты справишься!
bulgarian: Go Adeline go! You can do it!

english: Yeah, it's so cozy!
french: Oui, on est tellement bien installées.
russian: Да, тут так уютно!
bulgarian: Yeah, it's so cozy!

english: Of course! I love the company.
french: Oh, de rien ! J'adore avoir de la compagnie.
russian: Ну что вы, я обожаю работать в компании!
bulgarian: Of course! I love the company.

english: Oh, [Ari]! Do you have bookkeeping to finish up, too? Take a seat!
french: Oh, [Ari] ! Tu as de la comptabilité à faire aussi ? Assieds-toi !
russian: О, [Ari]! У тебя тоже есть незаконченная бумажная работа? Присаживайся!
bulgarian: Oh, [Ari]! Do you have bookkeeping to finish up, too? Take a seat!

english: Thanks for letting us work in here, Adeline!
french: Merci de nous permettre de travailler ici, Adeline !
russian: Спасибо, что дала нам тут поработать, Аделина!
bulgarian: Thanks for letting us work in here, Adeline!

english: I thought it might be helpful for Adeline. Color-coding my notes really helps me keep organized!
french: Je me suis dit que ça pourrait servir à Adeline. Personnellement, je m'y retrouve bien mieux depuis que je mets des codes couleur à mes notes !
russian: Подумала, Аделине может пригодиться. Мне самой очень помогает писать заметки разными цветами!
bulgarian: I thought it might be helpful for Adeline. Color-coding my notes really helps me keep organized!

english: You might have done too good of a job... Adeline's obsessed!
french: Tu as peut-être trop bien travaillé... Ça a viré à l'obsession chez elle !
russian: Возможно, ты перестаралась... Аделина теперь без них жить не может!
bulgarian: You might have done too good of a job... Adeline's obsessed!

english: You guys, my notes are so pretty when I can write them in PINK!
french: Hé regardez, mes notes sont encore plus jolies en ROSE !
russian: Ребята, мои записи теперь РОЗОВЫЕ! Представляете, как красиво!
bulgarian: You guys, my notes are so pretty when I can write them in PINK!

english: I've been experimenting with some berries from around Mistria, extracting pigment for ink.
french: J'ai fait quelques expériences avec des baies que j'ai cueillies dans la région et j'ai réussi à produire différentes encres avec leurs pigments.
russian: Я решила изучить мистрийские ягоды на предмет получения цветных пигментов для туши.
bulgarian: I've been experimenting with some berries from around Mistria, extracting pigment for ink.

english: Truth! No, dare! Actually, wait...
french: Vérité ! Non, action ! Quoique, attends...
russian: Правда! Нет, лучше действие! Погоди...
bulgarian: Truth! No, dare! Actually, wait...

english: Adeline's usually so decisive, but Reina always makes her think twice.
french: Adeline est sûre d'elle d'habitude, mais Reina a le chic pour la faire douter.
russian: Обычно Аделина решительная, но Рейна заставляет её задуматься.
bulgarian: Adeline's usually so decisive, but Reina always makes her think twice.

english: You never know what Reina's going to ask!
french: Parce qu'on ne sait jamais ce qu'elle compte poser comme question !
russian: Никогда не знаешь, что она может попросить!
bulgarian: You never know what Reina's going to ask!

english: So? Truth or dare, Adeline?
french: Alors ? Action ou vérité, Adeline ?
russian: Так что, Аделина, правда или действие?
bulgarian: So? Truth or dare, Adeline?

english: And formulating new potting soil!
french: Et élaborer de nouveaux mélanges de terreau !
russian: И разрабатываем состав земли для горшков!
bulgarian: And formulating new potting soil!

english: And making a new recipe!
french: Et imaginer de nouvelles recettes !
russian: И придумываем новый рецепт!
bulgarian: And making a new recipe!

english: I guess this is a lot of different parties...
french: Ça fait peut-être beaucoup finalement...
russian: Кажется, тут несколько вечеринок в одной...
bulgarian: I guess this is a lot of different parties...

english: Welcome, [Ari]! It's a work party! We're reviewing our paperwork!
french: Bienvenue, [Ari] ! On s'est réunies pour s'occuper de l'administratif toutes ensemble !
russian: Привет, [Ari]! У нас офисная вечеринка: мы перебираем документы!
bulgarian: Welcome, [Ari]! It's a work party! We're reviewing our paperwork!

english: And for watching the kids all day!
french: Et d'avoir gardé les enfants toute la journée !
russian: И за то, что целый день сидела с детьми!
bulgarian: And for watching the kids all day!

english: Which one lets me fight more monsters?
french: Où est-ce que je pourrai combattre le plus de monstres ?
russian: А где чаще надо сражаться с монстрами?
bulgarian: Which one lets me fight more monsters?

english: That's my girl!
french: C'est bien, ma fille !
russian: Так держать, дочка!
bulgarian: That's my girl!

english: It was fun! I think they've all got real futures in civil service.
french: Je me suis bien amusée ! Je pense qu'ils auront un bel avenir dans l'administration.
russian: С ними весело! Думаю, у них есть задатки к государственной службе.
bulgarian: It was fun! I think they've all got real futures in civil service.

english: I do love telling people what to do...
french: C'est vrai, j'adore dire aux gens ce qu'ils doivent faire...
russian: Мне правда нравится отдавать приказы...
bulgarian: I do love telling people what to do...

english: It'd be nice if they had to listen to me!
french: Mais ce serait super s'ils étaient obligés de m'écouter !
russian: Было бы здорово, если бы меня все слушались!
bulgarian: It'd be nice if they had to listen to me!

english: That's not quite-
french: Ce n'est pas tout à fait ce que...
russian: Ну, это не совсем...
bulgarian: That's not quite-

english: If you're looking for an intern at the Museum, just let me know! I wanna help!
french: Si le musée cherche un stagiaire, je suis partant ! Je veux les aider !
russian: Если вам в музее нужен помощник, обращайтесь ко мне! Я готов!
bulgarian: If you're looking for an intern at the Museum, just let me know! I wanna help!

english: I'll talk to Errol, but I see a bright future ahead of you, Luc!
french: J'en parlerai à Errol, mais tu as un bel avenir devant toi, Luc !
russian: Я поговорю с Эрролом на этот счёт. В любом случае, Люк, тебя ждёт блестящее будущее!
bulgarian: I'll talk to Errol, but I see a bright future ahead of you, Luc!

english: How about you Dell? Or would you rather take over the General Store?
french: Et toi, Dell, qu'aimerais-tu faire ? Reprendre le magasin général peut-être ?
russian: А как насчёт Делл? Или ты больше хочешь управлять универмагом?
bulgarian: How about you Dell? Or would you rather take over the General Store?

english: Hmm...
french: Mmm...
russian: Хмм...
bulgarian: Hmm...

english: Thank you for inviting us all over for dinner, Adeline.
french: Merci de nous avoir invités à dîner, Adeline.
russian: Спасибо, что пригласила нас на ужин, Аделина.
bulgarian: Thank you for inviting us all over for dinner, Adeline.

english: Not at all! They actually helped me find some files I'd lost track of. We made it into a game.
french: Pas du tout ! Ils m'ont même aidée à mettre la main sur certains documents que je ne retrouvais pas. On en a fait un jeu.
russian: Вовсе нет! Они даже помогли мне найти папки, которые я потеряла. Мы превратили это в игру.
bulgarian: Not at all! They actually helped me find some files I'd lost track of. We made it into a game.

english: Miss Adeline said she wanted help finding her spy reports!
french: Mademoiselle Adeline a demandé qu'on l'aide à trouver les messages de ses espions !
russian: Мисс Аделина попросила нас помочь отыскать доклады её шпионов!
bulgarian: Miss Adeline said she wanted help finding her spy reports!

english: Spy reports...?
french: Les messages de mes espions...?
russian: Моих шпионов?..
bulgarian: Spy reports...?

english: Oh my! Well, those do sound important.
french: Oh ! Eh bien, ça a l'air important...
russian: Ну и ну! Это и правда ценные сведения.
bulgarian: Oh my! Well, those do sound important.

english: You know Dell, I'm one of Adeline's spies.
french: Tu sais, Dell. Je suis un des espions à la solde d'Adeline.
russian: Знаешь, Делл, ведь один из шпионов Аделины — я.
bulgarian: You know Dell, I'm one of Adeline's spies.

english: Me too!
french: Moi aussi !
russian: И я тоже!
bulgarian: Me too!

english: You've been spying on Dell this whole time? Oh my gosh!
french: Vous espionnez Dell depuis tout ce temps ? Oh là là !
russian: Вы всё это время шпионили за Делл? Боже мой!
bulgarian: You've been spying on Dell this whole time? Oh my gosh!

english: Wow... that's dastardly, Lady Adeline. I'm taking notes!
french: Ouah... c'est sournois, dame Adeline. Je prends des notes !
russian: Ого... какой коварный ход, Леди Аделина. Я себе запишу!
bulgarian: Wow... that's dastardly, Lady Adeline. I'm taking notes!

english: Hope the kids weren't too much of a handful today, Adeline.
french: J'espère que les enfants n'ont pas été trop durs à gérer aujourd'hui, Adeline.
russian: Аделина, надеюсь, дети сегодня не очень мешались.
bulgarian: Hope the kids weren't too much of a handful today, Adeline.

english: Can't complain. Although maybe Ryis can take a look at the sign... I think it's crooked again.
french: Oui. Mais Ryis devrait encore vérifier le panneau... Je crois qu'une fois de plus, il a bougé.
russian: Не жалуюсь. Хотя, может, пора позвать Риза подлатать вывеску. Кажется, снова покосилась...
bulgarian: Can't complain. Although maybe Ryis can take a look at the sign... I think it's crooked again.

english: Is it?
french: Ah bon ?
russian: Разве?
bulgarian: Is it?

english: It does look crooked.
french: C'est vrai qu'il a l'air de travers.
russian: Точно, выглядит косо.
bulgarian: It does look crooked.

english: Stop tilting your head, guys.
french: Arrêtez de pencher la tête !
russian: Потому что вы косите голову!
bulgarian: Stop tilting your head, guys.

english: How's everything at the Inn, Hemlock?
french: Tout va bien à l'auberge, Hemlock ?
russian: Хемлок! Как дела в трактире?
bulgarian: How's everything at the Inn, Hemlock?

english: I should be asking you! Looks like you've picked up some assistants.
french: C'est à toi qu'il faut demander ! Tu as de nouveaux assistants, on dirait.
russian: Это тебя надо спросить! Я смотрю, ты обзавелась помощниками.
bulgarian: I should be asking you! Looks like you've picked up some assistants.

english: That's right! We're helping Lady Adeline!
french: Effectivement ! On aide dame Adeline !
russian: Именно! Мы помогаем леди Аделине.
bulgarian: That's right! We're helping Lady Adeline!

english: And don't expect any special treatment because we're related, papa!
french: Et ce n'est pas parce que tu es mon père que tu auras droit à un traitement de faveur !
russian: И не думай, папа, что всё будет так просто, потому что мы родственники!
bulgarian: And don't expect any special treatment because we're related, papa!

english: Let's talk about your candy supplier...
french: Parlons de votre fournisseur de bonbons...
russian: Давайте-ка обсудим ваших поставщиков конфет...
bulgarian: Let's talk about your candy supplier...

english: Anything new to tell, Holt?
french: Quoi de neuf, Holt ?
russian: Что у тебя нового, Хольт?
bulgarian: Anything new to tell, Holt?

english: Well, someone's got to do it!
french: Il faut bien que quelqu'un s'en occupe !
russian: Но кто-то же должен этим заняться!
bulgarian: Well, someone's got to do it!

english: What about hot chocolate inspection?
french: Dans ce cas, pourquoi pas une inspection des chocolats ?
russian: А кто будет инспектировать горячий шоколад?
bulgarian: What about hot chocolate inspection?

english: Or cake inspection?
french: Ou des gâteaux ?
russian: Или пирожные?
bulgarian: Or cake inspection?

english: Dell, I'm not sure I can assign the Dragonguard to candy inspection.
french: Dell, je ne vais pas charger la Garde des dragons d'une inspection des stocks de bonbons.
russian: Делл, я не уверена, что могу поручить Драконьей страже инспектировать конфеты.
bulgarian: Dell, I'm not sure I can assign the Dragonguard to candy inspection.

english: Yeah! The Dragonguard's doing great. We're helping so many people, and beating up so many bad guys!
french: Oui ! La Garde des dragons assure. On aide les gens et on dégomme plein de méchants !
russian: Так точно! Драконья стража в полном порядке. Мы всем вокруг помогаем и побеждаем всех злодеев!
bulgarian: Yeah! The Dragonguard's doing great. We're helping so many people, and beating up so many bad guys!

english: We're your eyes and ears in town, Lady Adeline! You didn't hear it from me, but I saw Lord Eiland sneak seconds on strawberry shortcake. Pretty suspicious.
french: Nous sommes vos yeux et vos oreilles dans cette ville, dame Adeline ! Ne dites pas que ça vient de moi, mais j'ai vu messire Eiland chiper un morceau de gâteau aux fraises. C'est louche.
russian: Мы ваши глаза и уши, леди Аделина! Я видела, как лорд Эйланд тайком брал добавку клубничного торта. Это крайне подозрительно, но я вам ничего не говорила!
bulgarian: We're your eyes and ears in town, Lady Adeline! You didn't hear it from me, but I saw Lord Eiland sneak seconds on strawberry shortcake. Pretty suspicious.

english: And we're all stocked up on supplies! Lots of sticks, and sweets, and spiders! Want to see my chart?
french: On a aussi fait le plein de provisions ! Des bâtons, des bonbons et des araignées ! Vous voulez voir ma liste ?
russian: И с припасами у нас порядок! Куча палок, конфет и пауков. Я составил график, хотите посмотреть?
bulgarian: And we're all stocked up on supplies! Lots of sticks, and sweets, and spiders! Want to see my chart?

english: Ooh, I love a good chart! Excellent work, Dragonguard!
french: Oh oui, j'adore les listes ! Excellent travail, Garde des dragons !
russian: Ух ты, люблю красивые графики! Отличная работа, Драконья стража!
bulgarian: Ooh, I love a good chart! Excellent work, Dragonguard!

english: You three want to file a report?
french: Vous venez faire votre rapport, les enfants ?
russian: Вы втроём хотите подать отчёт?
bulgarian: You three want to file a report?

english: I suppose I have been spending a lot of time in the office...
french: C'est vrai que j'ai passé beaucoup de temps dans mon bureau...
russian: Я и правда подолгу засиживаюсь у себя в офисе...
bulgarian: I suppose I have been spending a lot of time in the office...

english: Maple can do your job while you're playing with us!
french: Maple peut faire votre travail pendant que vous jouez avec nous !
russian: А пока вы будете с нами играть, Мэйпл возьмёт вашу работу!
bulgarian: Maple can do your job while you're playing with us!

english: I'm good at bossing people around! [Ari], I'll need 150 sticks and 200 rocks by the end of the day! For reasons!
french: Je sais très bien donner des ordres ! [Ari], il me faut 150 brindilles et 200 pierres pour ce soir. Ne traîne pas !
russian: Я отлично раздаю указания! [Ari], собери мне до вечера 150 палок и 200 камней! Для важного дела!
bulgarian: I'm good at bossing people around! [Ari], I'll need 150 sticks and 200 rocks by the end of the day! For reasons!

english: Miss Adeline, you should hang out with us. My big sister Reina says you've been working a lot lately.
french: Mademoiselle Adeline, vous devriez venir vous amuser avec nous. Ma grande sœur Reina dit que vous travaillez beaucoup, en ce moment.
russian: Мисс Аделина, вам надо почаще гулять с нами. Моя сестра Рейна говорит, что вы сейчас много работаете.
bulgarian: Miss Adeline, you should hang out with us. My big sister Reina says you've been working a lot lately.

english: I'm currently consulting with my high council.
french: Je suis actuellement en pleine consultation avec mon haut conseil.
russian: У меня сейчас совещание с моим верховным советом.
bulgarian: I'm currently consulting with my high council.

english: Our top priority should be to begin diplomatic negotiations with the insect kingdom of Aldaria!
french: Notre priorité absolue doit être d'entamer des relations diplomatiques avec le royaume des insectes d'Aldaria !
russian: Нашей главной задачей должно стать установление дипломатических отношений с королевством насекомых Альдарии!
bulgarian: Our top priority should be to begin diplomatic negotiations with the insect kingdom of Aldaria!

english: I disagree! Your royal-ness, we should travel to lands far beyond, to find the coolest stuff so we might bring it back for your most majestic majesty.
french: Certainement pas ! Votre Altesse, nous devrions voyager vers des contrées lointaines pour trouver l'objet le plus cool de tous pour Votre plus majestueuse Majesté.
russian: Протестую! Ваша королевскость, нам следует снарядить поход в дальние земли за самыми крутыми штуками. Мы принесём их в дар вашему великому величеству.
bulgarian: I disagree! Your royal-ness, we should travel to lands far beyond, to find the coolest stuff so we might bring it back for your most majestic majesty.

english: Queen Maple said she was taking over the entry hall to hold court, and I couldn't say no.
french: La reine Maple a voulu réquisitionner le hall d'entrée pour en faire sa cour. Je n'ai pas pu refuser.
russian: Королева Мэйпл сказала, что забирает входной зал для совещания, и я не смогла отказать.
bulgarian: Queen Maple said she was taking over the entry hall to hold court, and I couldn't say no.

english: I mean, she's a queen. I'm outranked!
french: C'est une reine, alors je n'ai pas mon mot à dire !
russian: К тому же она ведь королева, я не смею ослушаться!
bulgarian: I mean, she's a queen. I'm outranked!

english: [Ari]! Welcome! You stand in Queen Maple's royal court!
french: Bienvenue, [Ari] ! Tu es ici à la cour royale de la reine Maple !
russian: [Ari]! Добро пожаловать в придворные покои королевы Мэйпл!
bulgarian: [Ari]! Welcome! You stand in Queen Maple's royal court!

english: I'm so good at the quiet game! Nobody is quieter than me, you'll see!
french: Je suis la meilleure au jeu du silence ! Personne n'est plus calme que moi !
russian: Я лучшая в молчанку! Тише меня никого нет, вот увидите!
bulgarian: I'm so good at the quiet game! Nobody is quieter than me, you'll see!

english: You sound more like the Queen's loudest warrior, Dell.
french: Tu es plutôt la guerrière de la reine la plus agitée, Dell.
russian: Сейчас ты как будто самый громкий рыцарь, Делл.
bulgarian: You sound more like the Queen's loudest warrior, Dell.

english: I royally decree that the quiet game is boring! We are now playing... the screaming game!
french: Je décrète que le jeu du silence m'ennuie royalement ! Passons au... jeu des cris !
russian: Королевским указом объявляю молчанку скучной! Теперь мы будем играть... в кричалку!
bulgarian: I royally decree that the quiet game is boring! We are now playing... the screaming game!

english: Maple, Luc, Dell... I think it's in the country's best interest for us to play the quiet game. Only the Queen's quietest warriors will be rewarded!
french: Maple, Luc, Dell... Je crois qu'il est dans l'intérêt du pays de jouer au jeu du silence. Seuls les guerriers les plus mutiques de la reine seront récompensés !
russian: Мэйпл, Люк, Делл... Думаю, в интересах страны нам нужно поиграть в молчанку. Награда достанется самым тихим рыцарям королевы!
bulgarian: Maple, Luc, Dell... I think it's in the country's best interest for us to play the quiet game. Only the Queen's quietest warriors will be rewarded!

english: They're helping out!
french: Ils m'aident !
russian: Это мои помощники!
bulgarian: They're helping out!

english: We'll need to inspect everything, Mister March.
french: Nous devons tout inspecter, monsieur March.
russian: Мы проводим инспекцию, мистер Март.
bulgarian: We'll need to inspect everything, Mister March.

english: Everything.
french: Absolument tout.
russian: Сейчас всё осмотрим.
bulgarian: Everything.

english: Especially Olric's rock collection! It's so cool!
french: Surtout la collection de pierres d'Olric ! Parce qu'elle est trop cool !
russian: Особенно коллекцию камней Ольрика! Выглядит круто!
bulgarian: Especially Olric's rock collection! It's so cool!

english: What's with the kids?
french: Que font les enfants ?
russian: Почему ты с детьми?
bulgarian: What's with the kids?

english: We can always use more nails, but I don't want to get on March's nerves...
french: On a besoin de clous, mais je n'ai pas envie d'agacer March...
russian: Гвозди никогда лишними не будут, но не хочется напрягать Марта...
bulgarian: We can always use more nails, but I don't want to get on March's nerves...

english: Oh, don't worry Mister Ryis.
french: Oh, vous en faites pas, monsieur Ryis.
russian: Не беспокойтесь, мистер Риз.
bulgarian: Oh, don't worry Mister Ryis.

english: We already got on his nerves.
french: Il est déjà énervé à cause de nous.
russian: Мы уже его напрягли.
bulgarian: We already got on his nerves.

english: We asked for so many nails!
french: On lui a déjà demandé plein de clous !
russian: Мы попросили кучу гвоздей!
bulgarian: We asked for so many nails!

english: Low on any supplies? I can make a note of it.
french: Te manque-t-il quelque chose ? Je peux en prendre note si tu veux.
russian: У вас всего хватает? Если нет, я могу внести в заказ.
bulgarian: Low on any supplies? I can make a note of it.

english: Every day! Mistria never sleeps, Eiland.
french: Oui, tous les jours ! Mistria ne dort jamais, Eiland.
russian: Каждый день! Мистрия не спит, Эйланд!
bulgarian: Every day! Mistria never sleeps, Eiland.

english: I sleep, personally.
french: Moi, oui.
russian: Я лично сплю.
bulgarian: I sleep, personally.

english: You update the quest board? Every day?
french: Tu actualises le panneau des quêtes ? Tous les jours ?
russian: Ты что, обновляешь доску прошений каждый день?
bulgarian: You update the quest board? Every day?

english: Happy to help! Don't hesitate to call on your brother when you need a hand, okay?
french: Je t'en prie, ce n'est rien ! Ton frère est là si tu as besoin d'aide, d'accord ?
russian: Рад стараться! Не стесняйся просить брата, когда нужна помощь, хорошо?
bulgarian: Happy to help! Don't hesitate to call on your brother when you need a hand, okay?

english: Thanks for helping me out today, Eiland. I should be back on track by tomorrow!
french: Merci de m'avoir aidée, Eiland. Je devrais pouvoir repartir du bon pied dès demain !
russian: Спасибо за помощь, Эйланд! Теперь точно управлюсь к завтрашнему дню.
bulgarian: Thanks for helping me out today, Eiland. I should be back on track by tomorrow!

english: I could do some paperwork by the Beach, too. There's that picnic bench that overlooks the sand.
french: Et moi, je pourrais faire de l'administratif à la plage. Il y a une table de pique-nique.
russian: Я бы тоже могла заняться бумагами на пляже. Там есть скамеечка с видом на песчаную полосу...
bulgarian: I could do some paperwork by the Beach, too. There's that picnic bench that overlooks the sand.

english: Oh you two, you don't need an excuse to go to the Beach in the summer!
french: Vous savez que vous n'avez pas besoin de prétextes pour aller à la plage en été !
russian: Да что вы стесняетесь! Чтобы сходить летом на пляж, повод не нужен!
bulgarian: Oh you two, you don't need an excuse to go to the Beach in the summer!

english: I suppose I could do some excavations on the Beach. For, ah, research purposes.
french: J'aimerais aller à la plage pour effectuer quelques fouilles. Euh, c'est pour mes recherches.
russian: Возможно, мне стоит провести раскопки на пляже. Ммм... В исследовательских целях.
bulgarian: I suppose I could do some excavations on the Beach. For, ah, research purposes.

english: Very exciting might be overselling it...
french: Sensationnels, c'est peut-être exagéré...
russian: «Крайне занимательных» — это ты загнула...
bulgarian: Very exciting might be overselling it...

english: Ah, you just haven't had enough wine yet Eiland. Go on, pour yourself another!
french: C'est parce que tu n'as pas encore assez bu, Eiland. Vas-y, ressers-toi un verre de vin !
russian: Видно, ты просто недостаточно выпил, Эйланд! Возьми ещё вина!
bulgarian: Ah, you just haven't had enough wine yet Eiland. Go on, pour yourself another!

english: Hello [Ari]! We were just talking about some very exciting changes to the civic code that I'd like to propose.
french: Bonjour, [Ari] ! Nous discutions de quelques changements sensationnels que j'aimerais apporter au règlement de la ville.
russian: Привет, [Ari]! Мы тут обсуждали мой проект крайне занимательных поправок в гражданский кодекс.
bulgarian: Hello [Ari]! We were just talking about some very exciting changes to the civic code that I'd like to propose.

english: Awww!
french: C'est gentil !
russian: Как мило!
bulgarian: Awww!

english: Wait, aren't we your only niece and nephew?
french: Mais, tu n'as pas d'autres neveux et nièces...
russian: Погоди, разве мы не единственные твои племянник и племянница?
bulgarian: Wait, aren't we your only niece and nephew?

english: My favorite niece and nephew! Tell me about your day. Regale me!
french: Mon neveu et ma nièce préférés ! Alors, qu'avez-vous fait aujourd'hui ? Racontez-moi tout !
russian: Мои любимые племянник и племянница! Расскажите, как у вас дела? Порадуйте меня!
bulgarian: My favorite niece and nephew! Tell me about your day. Regale me!

english: Oh! We could stop by the Inn and see what the special is.
french: On n'a qu'à aller à l'auberge pour voir le plat du jour.
russian: О! Можем пойти в трактир и посмотреть, что там за блюдо дня.
bulgarian: Oh! We could stop by the Inn and see what the special is.

english: Sounds splendid, dessert's on me!
french: Excellente idée. J'offre le dessert !
russian: Звучит отлично, а я позабочусь о десерте!
bulgarian: Sounds splendid, dessert's on me!

english: What would you two like to do for lunch?
french: Qu'est-ce qui vous tente pour le déjeuner ?
russian: Чем вы хотели бы пообедать?
bulgarian: What would you two like to do for lunch?

english: Certainly! Thank you, Lady Adeline!
french: Avec plaisir ! Merci, dame Adeline !
russian: Не откажусь! Спасибо, леди Аделина!
bulgarian: Certainly! Thank you, Lady Adeline!

english: And you, Eiland?
french: Et toi, Eiland ?
russian: А ты, Эйланд?
bulgarian: And you, Eiland?

english: No, thank you! I'm saving that room for seconds of dessert.
french: Non, merci ! Je reprendrai plutôt du dessert.
russian: Нет, спасибо! Лучше оставлю место для добавки десерта.
bulgarian: No, thank you! I'm saving that room for seconds of dessert.

english: Would you like seconds, Errol?
french: Je vous ressers, Errol ?
russian: Хочешь добавки, Эррол?
bulgarian: Would you like seconds, Errol?

english: Of course! Wait, no this is the pepper.
french: Oui, bien sûr ! Ah, c'est le poivre.
russian: Держи! Нет, погоди, это перец.
bulgarian: Of course! Wait, no this is the pepper.

english: Hm, and this is the hot sauce.
french: Mmm, et ça, c'est la sauce piquante.
russian: Хмм, у меня острый соус.
bulgarian: Hm, and this is the hot sauce.

english: I think I've got the sugar.
french: Et moi, je crois que j'ai le sucre.
russian: Кажется, у меня сахар.
bulgarian: I think I've got the sugar.

english: This is a house of condiments, it seems.
french: C'est la foire aux condiments ici.
russian: Я смотрю, у вас полный дом приправ.
bulgarian: This is a house of condiments, it seems.

english: Ah, and the salt's right here.
french: Ah, le sel est là.
russian: А, кстати, вот и соль.
bulgarian: Ah, and the salt's right here.

english: Can someone pass the salt?
french: Est-ce que quelqu'un peut me passer le sel ?
russian: Передайте, пожалуйста, соль.
bulgarian: Can someone pass the salt?

english: Really? What was it like?
french: Ah bon ? À quoi ressemblait-il avant ?
russian: Правда? А как тут было прежде?
bulgarian: Really? What was it like?

english: A fixer-upper, if memory serves. But the Baron was quite comfortable rolling his sleeves up.
french: Il était délabré si je me souviens bien, mais le baron aimait se retrousser les manches.
russian: Весьма запущенно, насколько я помню. Но барон был не против грязной работы.
bulgarian: A fixer-upper, if memory serves. But the Baron was quite comfortable rolling his sleeves up.

english: I visited that summer, and I remember Wiscar, Landen and Errol all standing shoulder to shoulder as they worked.
french: Je suis venue ici un été, et je me souviens encore d'avoir vu Wiscar, Landen et Errol travailler ensemble.
russian: Я заезжала тем летом. Помню, Вискар, Ланден и Эррол работали вместе, плечом к плечу.
bulgarian: I visited that summer, and I remember Wiscar, Landen and Errol all standing shoulder to shoulder as they worked.

english: My father told me stories about that summer! The Baron would come to the Clinic at twilight almost every day, with more and more unlikely injuries.
french: Mon père m'a parlé de cet été-là ! Le baron venait à la clinique presque chaque soir avec des blessures de plus en plus improbables.
russian: Отец рассказывал мне про то лето! Барон едва ли не каждый день приходил в клинику с новыми травмами в невероятных местах.
bulgarian: My father told me stories about that summer! The Baron would come to the Clinic at twilight almost every day, with more and more unlikely injuries.

english: Ohhhh. I guess that's why mom was always hiding the tool box!
french: Oh... Ça explique pourquoi ma mère cachait toujours la boîte à outils !
russian: Вот оно что! Значит, поэтому мать прятала от меня ящик с инструментами.
bulgarian: Ohhhh. I guess that's why mom was always hiding the tool box!

english: I must say, the manor has come a long way from when the Baron and Baroness first moved in.
french: Le manoir a beaucoup changé depuis l'époque où le baron et la baronne s'y sont installés.
russian: Должен сказать, ваш особняк преобразился с тех пор, как приехали барон и баронесса.
bulgarian: I must say, the manor has come a long way from when the Baron and Baroness first moved in.

english: He did not! Was this one of his "hiking excursions"?
french: Ça ne me dit rien. Était-ce lors de l'une de ses célèbres « excursions » ?
russian: Не рассказывал! Это был один из ваших «турпоходов»?
bulgarian: He did not! Was this one of his "hiking excursions"?

english: I think I remember this story! Valen's father was looking for a particular herb, is that right?
french: Moi, ça me rappelle quelque chose ! Le père de Valen cherchait une herbe bien précise, c'est ça ?
russian: Кажется, я знаю эту историю! Отец Вален искал какое-то растение, да?
bulgarian: I think I remember this story! Valen's father was looking for a particular herb, is that right?

english: But then a snowstorm blocked the path back down?
french: Et une tempête de neige leur a barré la route au retour, non ?
russian: А потом метель завалила проход назад?
bulgarian: But then a snowstorm blocked the path back down?

english: The Baroness single-handedly dug a tunnel all the way up the mountain to bring you three home!
french: La baronne a creusé elle-même un tunnel jusqu'au sommet pour vous récupérer !
russian: Баронесса в одиночку прокопала туннель к вершине горы, чтобы вызволить вас троих!
bulgarian: The Baroness single-handedly dug a tunnel all the way up the mountain to bring you three home!

english: She really saved our hides! If it wasn't for her, we'd still be popsicles up on that mountain top!
french: Elle nous a sauvé la vie ! Sans elle, on aurait été transformés en statues de glace et on y serait toujours !
russian: Да, она спасла наши шкуры! Если бы не она, мы бы торчали там как ледышки.
bulgarian: She really saved our hides! If it wasn't for her, we'd still be popsicles up on that mountain top!

english: Did your father ever tell you about the time he and I got stuck on the summit in the dead of winter? Baron Wiscar was with us, too.
french: Est-ce que ton père t'a raconté la fois où on s'est retrouvés coincés dans la montagne en plein hiver, lui et moi ? Le baron Wiscar était là aussi.
russian: А твой отец рассказывал, как мы с ним застряли на Вершине в зимние холода? С нами ещё барон Вискар был.
bulgarian: Did your father ever tell you about the time he and I got stuck on the summit in the dead of winter? Baron Wiscar was with us, too.

english: Oh, I really shouldn't.
french: Oh non, je ne devrais pas.
russian: Ох, мне правда не стоит.
bulgarian: Oh, I really shouldn't.

english: Well... one more.
french: Bon, allez... un dernier pour la route.
russian: Ну, может, один бокальчик.
bulgarian: Well... one more.

english: Juniper, don't feel obliged to keep pace with Aunt Elsie.
french: Juniper, ne te sens pas obligée de suivre ma tante Elsie.
russian: Джунипер, тебе не обязательно держать темп тётушки Элси.
bulgarian: Juniper, don't feel obliged to keep pace with Aunt Elsie.

english: Yes, keep pace with me and have another round of dessert!
french: Oui, fais plutôt comme moi et reprends du dessert !
russian: Точно, лучше держи мой темп и возьми добавку дессерта.
bulgarian: Yes, keep pace with me and have another round of dessert!

english: Have some more wine, Juniper!
french: Ressers-toi un peu de vin, Juniper !
russian: Выпей ещё вина, Джунипер!
bulgarian: Have some more wine, Juniper!

english: I'm delighted to hear it. The Museum has developed nicely under Lord Eiland's watchful eye.
french: Merci, je suis ravi d'entendre ça. Le musée évolue bien sous la supervision de messire Eiland.
russian: Радостно слышать. Музей быстро наполняется под чутким надзором лорда Эйланда.
bulgarian: I'm delighted to hear it. The Museum has developed nicely under Lord Eiland's watchful eye.

english: You're giving me too much credit, Errol. The Museum would be nothing without you.
french: C'est m'accorder bien trop d'importance, Errol. Le musée ne serait rien sans vous.
russian: Ты переоцениваешь меня, Эррол! Вот без тебя бы музей точно не справился.
bulgarian: You're giving me too much credit, Errol. The Museum would be nothing without you.

english: Nor you, [Ari]. Thanks for all your help.
french: Ni toi, [Ari]. Merci pour ton aide.
russian: Как и без тебя, [Ari]. Спасибо тебе за помощь.
bulgarian: Nor you, [Ari]. Thanks for all your help.

english: I've been chatting with the townsfolk, and they're all in love with the Museum. Wonderful work, you two.
french: J'ai discuté un peu avec les habitants, et tout le monde adore le musée. Vous avez fait du bon travail, tous les deux.
russian: Я пообщалась с людьми — все просто обожают музей. Отличная работа, ребята.
bulgarian: I've been chatting with the townsfolk, and they're all in love with the Museum. Wonderful work, you two.

english: Relax, Eiland. I'm here to enjoy the Museum!
french: Pas du tout, Eiland. Je viens profiter du musée !
russian: Расслабься, Эйланд. Я просто пришла посмотреть на музей.
bulgarian: Relax, Eiland. I'm here to enjoy the Museum!

english: How nice! Please enjoy yourself!
french: Ah, merveilleux ! Bonne visite, alors !
russian: Замечательно! Смотрите с удовольствием!
bulgarian: How nice! Please enjoy yourself!

english: Oh, you're here Adeline! Did I forget to file some paperwork?
french: Oh, c'est toi, Adeline ! Aurais-je oublié de remplir des papiers ?
russian: Ой, привет, Аделина! Я забыл подать какие-то отчёты?
bulgarian: Oh, you're here Adeline! Did I forget to file some paperwork?

english: It's not that I'm unhappy to see you enjoying the fruits of our labors, but...
french: Je suis ravi que vous appréciiez notre travail, mais...
russian: Я, конечно, рад, что вам по душе плоды наших трудов, но...
bulgarian: It's not that I'm unhappy to see you enjoying the fruits of our labors, but...

english: I suppose we should go over whatever you wanted to discuss, Adeline.
french: Venons-en au fait. De quoi voulais-tu nous parler, Adeline ?
russian: Думаю, пора обсудить, зачем ты нас собрала, Аделина.
bulgarian: I suppose we should go over whatever you wanted to discuss, Adeline.

english: Or maybe my favorite was the horse that looked like a dog?
french: À moins que ce ne soit le cheval qui ressemblait à un chien !
russian: Или всё-таки лучшей была лошадь, выглядящая как собака?
bulgarian: Or maybe my favorite was the horse that looked like a dog?

english: That old tome you showed me was so cute, Errol. All that marginalia... I think the cat dragon playing the lute was my favorite!
french: J'ai beaucoup aimé le vieil ouvrage que vous m'avez montré, Errol. Avec tous ces petits croquis... Je crois que mon préféré, c'était le dragon chat qui jouait du luth !
russian: Старинная книга, которую ты мне показывал, Эррол, такая занимательная. С этими рисунками на полях... Больше всего мне понравилась кошка-дракон, играющая на лютне.
bulgarian: That old tome you showed me was so cute, Errol. All that marginalia... I think the cat dragon playing the lute was my favorite!

english: It's not that bad!
french: Allons, n'exagère pas !
russian: Да не настолько же!
bulgarian: It's not that bad!

english: It's a dig site of its own, Lord Eiland.
french: C'est un site de fouille en soi, messire Eiland.
russian: Тоже своего рода место для раскопок, лорд Эйланд.
bulgarian: It's a dig site of its own, Lord Eiland.

english: Your storage room is... so disorganized... I feel faint.
french: Ta réserve est... si désorganisée... que j'en ai des frissons.
russian: Твоя кладовка так завалена... Я сейчас в обморок упаду.
bulgarian: Your storage room is... so disorganized... I feel faint.

english: For sure! But I'll need references.
french: Évidemment ! Mais pour ça, il me faut des références.
russian: Разумеется! Но тогда мне нужны образцы.
bulgarian: For sure! But I'll need references.

english: I've pulled some from the Museum archive for just that reason. Have a look!
french: Justement, j'ai sorti ces plans des archives du musée. Tu peux les consulter !
russian: Как раз за этим я достал их из музейного архива. Вот, взгляни!
bulgarian: I've pulled some from the Museum archive for just that reason. Have a look!

english: When you're doing repairs around town, it would be nice to preserve some of the historical details.
french: Si tu fais des restaurations en ville, ce serait bien de conserver les spécificités historiques.
russian: Было бы славно сохранить исторические детали, когда вы проводите реставрацию городских зданий.
bulgarian: When you're doing repairs around town, it would be nice to preserve some of the historical details.

english: It's not a big deal right now, but it helps to know if we need to do repairs down the line.
french: Ce n'est pas grave si je ne sais pas pour l'instant, mais ça pourra m'être utile le jour où il faudra faire des réparations.
russian: Сейчас это не важно, но это понадобится, когда придёт пора ремонтировать эти здания.
bulgarian: It's not a big deal right now, but it helps to know if we need to do repairs down the line.

english: Fascinating. Do you think it was imported? I can start combing through the town building records.
french: C'est fascinant. Tu penses qu'on le faisait venir d'ailleurs ? Je pourrais peut-être éplucher les permis de construire de l'époque.
russian: Потрясающе. Думаешь, это импортная древесина? Давай я начну исследовать записи о строительстве города.
bulgarian: Fascinating. Do you think it was imported? I can start combing through the town building records.

english: Sounds good, Eiland! In the meantime, I'll contact Celine. If the wood came from Mistria, she'll know the tree!
french: Bonne idée, Eiland ! Et moi, je vais contacter Céline. Si le bois venait de Mistria, elle connaîtra sûrement l'essence !
russian: Звучит здорово, Эйланд. А я пока свяжусь с Селин. Она точно сможет опознать породу, если древесина из Мистрии.
bulgarian: Sounds good, Eiland! In the meantime, I'll contact Celine. If the wood came from Mistria, she'll know the tree!

english: I've been trying to identify the type of wood used to build some of the older buildings around town. Even Uncle Landen seemed a bit stumped.
french: J'essaie de savoir quel type de bois ils ont utilisé pour les bâtiments les plus anciens. Même oncle Landen semble perdu.
russian: Я пытаюсь определить породу дерева, из которой сделаны некоторые старые здания. Даже дядя Ланден зашёл в тупик.
bulgarian: I've been trying to identify the type of wood used to build some of the older buildings around town. Even Uncle Landen seemed a bit stumped.

english: Oh yes, and so well too.
french: Oh oui. Et si bien, avec ça.
russian: О, да, и ещё как сработало.
bulgarian: Oh yes, and so well too.

english: That [Ari] is something special, don't you think? I never would have guessed <he>he</he><she>she</she><they>they</they><it>it</it><none>[Ari]</none> would be so proactive.
french: [Ari] est vraiment quelqu'un de spécial, tu ne trouves pas ? Jamais je ne n'aurais imaginé qu'<he>il</he><she>elle</she><they>iel</they> en fasse autant.
russian:
Эти

ЭтаЭтотЭто [Ari] — просто необыкновенный человек. Никогда бы не подумала, что

они будут такие инициативные

она будет такая инициативнаяон будет такой инициативныйоно будет такое инициативное.
bulgarian: That [Ari] is something special, don't you think? I never would have guessed <he>he</he><she>she</she><they>they</they><it>it</it><none>[Ari]</none> would be so proactive.

english: <he>He's</he><she>She's</she><they>They're</they><it>It's</it><none>[Ari]'s</none> so reliable! We got really lucky.
french: On peut vraiment compter sur <he>lui</he><she>elle</she><they>ellui</they> ! Nous avons eu beaucoup de chance.
russian:
И

такие надёжные

такая надёжнаятакой надёжныйтакое надёжное! Нам с

ними

нейнимним повезло.
bulgarian: <he>He's</he><she>She's</she><they>They're</they><it>It's</it><none>[Ari]'s</none> so reliable! We got really lucky.

english: I'm so thrilled Mistria's farm initiative worked out!
french: Je suis si contente que notre projet de reprise de la ferme de Mistria ait porté ses fruits !
russian: Я безумно рада, что наше предложение земли под ферму в Мистрии сработало!
bulgarian: I'm so thrilled Mistria's farm initiative worked out!

english: They have, and yet the memory of every dalliance brings to mind another that I'd forgotten.
french: Oui, d'autant plus qu'un souvenir en fait ressurgir un que j'avais oublié et ainsi de suite.
russian: Ещё как! И за каждой интрижкой в памяти всплывает другая, почти уже забытая.
bulgarian: They have, and yet the memory of every dalliance brings to mind another that I'd forgotten.

english: My notes are quite extensive!
french: J'ai déjà beaucoup de notes !
russian: Но мои заметки весьма богаты!
bulgarian: My notes are quite extensive!

english: Your memoirs have really been coming along, Aunt Elsie!
french: Tu as bien avancé sur tes mémoires, tante Elsie !
russian: Вижу, работа над мемуарами идёт бодрым темпом, тётя Элси!
bulgarian: Your memoirs have really been coming along, Aunt Elsie!

english: Swimmingly! Which is to say, I've reached the chapter where I dated the captain of the Aldaria national swim team.
french: Tout baigne ! Autrement dit, j'en suis au chapitre où je raconte mon histoire avec le capitaine de l'équipe de natation d'Aldaria.
russian: Плавным ходом. То есть я дошла до главы, когда стала встречаться с капитаном сборной Альдарии по плаванью.
bulgarian: Swimmingly! Which is to say, I've reached the chapter where I dated the captain of the Aldaria national swim team.

english: How are your memoirs coming along, Great Aunt Elsie?
french: Tu t'en sors avec tes mémoires, grand-tante Elsie ?
russian: Как продвигаются мемуары, тётя Элси?
bulgarian: How are your memoirs coming along, Great Aunt Elsie?

english: Oh, that's kind of them to say. I should plan an encore tour!
french: Oh, c'est gentil de dire ça. Je devrais peut-être envisager une tournée d'adieu !
russian: Мило с их стороны. Надо мне запланировать повторное турне!
bulgarian: Oh, that's kind of them to say. I should plan an encore tour!

english: I still remember hearing you sing at the opera house in the Capital! Mother and Father wrote saying it hasn't been the same since you retired.
french: Je me souviens encore de cette fois où je suis allée t'écouter à l'opéra de la capitale ! Papa et maman disent que ce n'est plus pareil depuis que tu as pris ta retraite.
russian: До сих пор помню, как ты пела в столичной опере! Мама с папой писали, что после твоего ухода опера уже не та.
bulgarian: I still remember hearing you sing at the opera house in the Capital! Mother and Father wrote saying it hasn't been the same since you retired.

english: Rainy days are for living, dear girl! Put that pen down and join me for some wine.
french: Profite des jours de pluie, ma fille ! Pose donc ce stylo et viens prendre un petit verre de vin avec moi.
russian: Родная моя, в дождливые дни надо отдыхать! Отложи перо и садись ко мне выпить вина.
bulgarian: Rainy days are for living, dear girl! Put that pen down and join me for some wine.

english: I do really need to get through this paperwork so we can keep the rebuilding process going. These approvals won't sign off on themselves.
french: Je dois absolument terminer ces papiers pour que la reconstruction avance. Les autorisations ne vont pas se signer toutes seules.
russian: Мне правда надо завершить работу с этими документами, чтобы продолжить восстановление города. Разрешения на строительство не появятся сами собой.
bulgarian: I do really need to get through this paperwork so we can keep the rebuilding process going. These approvals won't sign off on themselves.

english: You were sensational, just like my father had said.
french: Tu étais sensationnelle. Mon père m'avait prévenue.
russian: «Это было грандиозно», как любил говорить мой отец.
bulgarian: You were sensational, just like my father had said.

english: Oh, that's so sweet! Your father was a big supporter of the opera.
french: Oh, c'est adorable ! Ton père était un grand amateur d'opéra.
russian: О, как чудесно! Твой отец был большим ценителем оперы.
bulgarian: Oh, that's so sweet! Your father was a big supporter of the opera.

english: And he took very good care of me when I had a spill coming off the stage.
french: Et c'est lui qui m'a soignée le jour où je suis tombée en sortant de scène.
russian: И он отлично позаботился обо мне, когда я однажды споткнулась при спуске со сцены.
bulgarian: And he took very good care of me when I had a spill coming off the stage.

english: You knew Valen's father?
french: Tu as connu le père de Valen ?
russian: Не думала, что ты была знакома с отцом Вален!
bulgarian: You knew Valen's father?

english: I as well! A most esteemed fellow, with a dry wit.
french: Moi aussi ! C'était un homme honnête et très intelligent.
russian: Я тоже знал его! Весьма почтенный человек с тонким чувством юмора.
bulgarian: I as well! A most esteemed fellow, with a dry wit.

english: You're the very image of him, Valen.
french: Tu lui ressembles comme deux gouttes d'eau, Valen.
russian: Ты вся в него, Вален.
bulgarian: You're the very image of him, Valen.

english: You know Elsie, I saw one of your shows when I was studying in the Capital.
french: Tu sais, j'ai vu une de tes représentations quand j'étudiais à la capitale, Elsie.
russian: Знаешь, Элси, я однажды была на твоём представлении, когда училась в столице.
bulgarian: You know Elsie, I saw one of your shows when I was studying in the Capital.

english: The Countess didn't give me flowers until the morning after! Can you believe it? It was so memorable... so roguish of her.
french: La comtesse ne m'a offert des fleurs que le lendemain matin ! Vous y croyez, vous ? C'était mémorable... et tellement espiègle de sa part.
russian: Графиня заставила меня ждать цветов до следующего утра, представляете? Это было так смело, так... кокетливо с её стороны.
bulgarian: The Countess didn't give me flowers until the morning after! Can you believe it? It was so memorable... so roguish of her.

english: Wow, haha... this cauldron sure is fascinating, isn't it?!
french: Waouh, ha ha... Ce chaudron est fascinant, n'est-ce pas ?!
russian: Ух, ха-ха... Какой занимательный тут котёл, да?..
bulgarian: Wow, haha... this cauldron sure is fascinating, isn't it?!

english: Elsie's telling us about some of her exploits in the Capital... she's SUCH a role model.
french: Elsie nous racontait ses exploits dans la capitale... Cette femme est un exemple pour nous toutes.
russian: Когда Элси рассказывает о своих похождениях в столице, я думаю: вот образец для подражания!
bulgarian: Elsie's telling us about some of her exploits in the Capital... she's SUCH a role model.

english: Oh! Thank you.
french: Oh ! Merci.
russian: О, спасибо!
bulgarian: Oh! Thank you.

english: And where is your dungeon?
french: Mais où se trouve votre donjon ?
russian: А где же твоя темница?
bulgarian: And where is your dungeon?

english: A dungeon? Um... we don't have one.
french: Mon... donjon ? Hum... Nous n'en avons pas.
russian: Темница? Эм... У нас её нет.
bulgarian: A dungeon? Um... we don't have one.

english: I doubt this is what Seridia is after... but when you were little, you and Eiland nicknamed the cellar to "the grape dungeon".
french: Je ne pense pas que ce soit ce à quoi pense Seridia, mais quand vous étiez petits, Eiland et toi appeliez la cave le « donjon aux raisins ».
russian: Сомневаюсь, что Серидию это устроит, но... В детстве вы с Эйландом называли погреб «подземельем винограда».
bulgarian: I doubt this is what Seridia is after... but when you were little, you and Eiland nicknamed the cellar to "the grape dungeon".

english: Eiland still calls it that...
french: Eiland l'appelle toujours comme ça...
russian: Эйланд до сих пор его так зовёт...
bulgarian: Eiland still calls it that...

english: You possess a handsome estate, Adeline.
french: Vous possédez un domaine magnifique, Adeline.
russian: У тебя впечатляющее поместье, Аделина.
bulgarian: You possess a handsome estate, Adeline.

english: Really? I rather like your decor.
french: Vraiment ? J'aime bien votre intérieur.
russian: Правда? Мне вполне нравится нынешний вид.
bulgarian: Really? I rather like your decor.

english: But I might make a few changes. For instance, you could hang your ceremonial battleaxe over the mantle.
french: Mais j'y apporterais en effet quelques changements. Vous pourriez par exemple accrocher votre hache de cérémonie au-dessus de la cheminée.
russian: Хотя кое-что я бы поменяла. Например, над камином можно повесить церемониальный топор.
bulgarian: But I might make a few changes. For instance, you could hang your ceremonial battleaxe over the mantle.

english: And raise a chandelier of bone in the kitchen.
french: Ou suspendre un chandelier d'ossements dans la cuisine.
russian: А в кухне повесить люстру из костей.
bulgarian: And raise a chandelier of bone in the kitchen.

english: And perhaps a few swords scattered about the bedroom. That always adds a little thrill.
french: Et peut-être quelques épées ici ou là dans la chambre à coucher. Ça fait toujours sensation.
russian: И парочку мечей где-то в спальне. Мечи всегда производят впечатление.
bulgarian: And perhaps a few swords scattered about the bedroom. That always adds a little thrill.

english: It certainly does!
french: Je confirme !
russian: Это точно!
bulgarian: It certainly does!

english: You know, I think I'm going to leave everything as it is!
french: Vous savez quoi, je crois que je ne vais toucher à rien !
russian: Знаете, думаю, я лучше всё-таки оставлю как есть!
bulgarian: You know, I think I'm going to leave everything as it is!

english: I've been thinking about redecorating the Manor House...
french: Je songeais à redécorer le manoir...
russian: Я подумываю поменять в особняке отделку...
bulgarian: I've been thinking about redecorating the Manor House...

english: Thank you, Adeline, for giving me a place to rest my head in Mistria.
french: Merci de m'héberger ici, à Mistria, Adeline.
russian: Аделина, спасибо тебе, что дала мне пристанище в Мистрии.
bulgarian: Thank you, Adeline, for giving me a place to rest my head in Mistria.

english: Oh, don't even mention it. You're family, and I wouldn't have it any other way!
french: Oh, je t'en prie. Tu es de la famille, je ne voudrais pas qu'il en soit autrement !
russian: Ой, ну что ты. Мы же семья, по-другому и быть не может!
bulgarian: Oh, don't even mention it. You're family, and I wouldn't have it any other way!

english: It may be an act of kindness, but care of your elders is also a recognition of their wisdom.
french: Certes, c'est un acte de bonté, mais prendre soin des personnes âgées est également une manière de rendre hommage à leur sagesse.
russian: Возможно, это жест доброты, но также, заботясь о старших, мы признаём их мудрость.
bulgarian: It may be an act of kindness, but care of your elders is also a recognition of their wisdom.

english: And Lady Elsie is wise indeed.
french: Et dame Elsie est on ne peut plus sage.
russian: А леди Элси поистине мудра.
bulgarian: And Lady Elsie is wise indeed.

english: From the Witch Queen's lips to your ear! Cheers to that, Seridia.
