french: Je parie qu'ils en savent plus sur l'histoire de Mistria que les grandes personnes !
russian: Небось, историю Мистрии знают уже получше взрослых.
bulgarian: I bet they know more about Mistria's history than us grown-ups!

english: That museum of Eiland's is coming along nicely.
french: Le musée d'Eiland commence à prendre forme.
russian: Дела у Эйланда в музее идут хорошо.
bulgarian: That museum of Eiland's is coming along nicely.

english: Mm! It's delicious.
french: Mmm ! C'est délicieux.
russian: Ммм... Объедение.
bulgarian: Mm! It's delicious.

english: Oh, this reminds me of something I ate in the Capital, at a little cafe tucked away behind the market.
french: Oh, ça me rappelle un plat que j'ai mangé à la capitale, dans un petit café niché derrière le marché.
russian: О, напоминает еду из одного маленького кафе на задворках рынка в столице.
bulgarian: Oh, this reminds me of something I ate in the Capital, at a little cafe tucked away behind the market.

english: You sound nostalgic, Balor.
french: Ça a l'air de te rappeler de bons souvenirs, Balor.
russian: Воспоминания накатили, Балор?
bulgarian: You sound nostalgic, Balor.

english: Not quite. Reina's done the dish better!
french: Pas vraiment. La recette de Reina est bien meilleure !
russian: Да нет, у Рейны вышло даже лучше.
bulgarian: Not quite. Reina's done the dish better!

english: Okay, everyone! Tell me what you think!
french: Allez ! Dites-moi tous ce que vous en pensez !
russian: Ну что, ребята? Расскажите, как вам?
bulgarian: Okay, everyone! Tell me what you think!

english: Don't try and psyche me out, Balor.
french: Arrête d'essayer de me déstabiliser, Balor.
russian: Не пытайся на меня давить, Балор.
bulgarian: Don't try and psyche me out, Balor.

english: Sorry pal, you definitely have a tell.
french: Désolé, l'ami, mais ça se voit.
russian: Прости, приятель, но правда видно.
bulgarian: Sorry pal, you definitely have a tell.

english: It's really obvious, actually.
french: Comme le nez au milieu de la figure.
russian: Вообще не сложно догадаться.
bulgarian: It's really obvious, actually.

english: You've got a tell, March.
french: Tu as une mauvaise main, March.
russian: У тебя по лицу всё видно, Март.
bulgarian: You've got a tell, March.

english: I'm in.
french: Je suis.
russian: Играю!
bulgarian: I'm in.

english: Me too. And I'll raise.
french: Moi aussi. Et je relance.
russian: Я тоже. И повышу.
bulgarian: Me too. And I'll raise.

english: Oho. I'll match that, March.
french: Ho ho. Je te suis, March.
russian: Ого! Но я не сдамся, Март.
bulgarian: Oho. I'll match that, March.

english: Looks like we've got ourselves a game!
french: Eh bien, c'est une belle partie.
russian: Вот это партия у нас вырисовывается!
bulgarian: Looks like we've got ourselves a game!

english: And one more card on the table makes the riverbank. Now, how's the table feeling in this last go around?
french: Et voilà la dernière carte pour faire la rivière. Alors, vous en êtes où après ça ?
russian: Итак, ривер на столе. Как чувствуют себя наши игроки?
bulgarian: And one more card on the table makes the riverbank. Now, how's the table feeling in this last go around?

english: A pity. A curiosity like that would fetch a pretty penny in the Capital.
french: Dommage. Un objet aussi singulier s'arracherait à prix d'or à la capitale.
russian: Очень жаль. За такую диковинку в столице дали бы отличные деньги.
bulgarian: A pity. A curiosity like that would fetch a pretty penny in the Capital.

english: It doesn't matter how much you offer me, Balor. My crystal ball isn't for sale.
french: Peu importe le prix que tu me proposes, Balor, ma boule de cristal n'est pas à vendre.
russian: Не важно, сколько ты предлагаешь, Балор. Мой хрустальный шар не продаётся.
bulgarian: It doesn't matter how much you offer me, Balor. My crystal ball isn't for sale.

english: Focus, Balor. I'm looking for dog treats.
french: Voyons, Balor. Je parlais de friandises pour chien.
russian: Соберись, Балор, мне нужны лакомства для собак.
bulgarian: Focus, Balor. I'm looking for dog treats.

english: You want a gift for Dozy? Might I suggest this uncut emerald? It makes quite the statement.
french: Tu cherches un cadeau pour Dozy ? Que dirais-tu de cette émeraude brute ? Elle a de l'allure.
russian: Тебе нужен подарок для Дрёмы? Смею предложить вот этот неогранёный изумруд. Такой подарок говорит сам за себя.
bulgarian: You want a gift for Dozy? Might I suggest this uncut emerald? It makes quite the statement.

english: He doesn't, but he deserves the best.
french: Pas du tout, mais il mérite ce qu'il y a de mieux.
russian: Это не вкус, просто он заслуживает лучшего.
bulgarian: He doesn't, but he deserves the best.

english: These are the premium gold star treats you asked for, Juniper. I didn't know Dozy had such fancy tastes.
french: Voici les friandises de premier choix que tu m'as demandées, Juniper. Je ne savais pas que Dozy avait des goûts de luxe.
russian: Вот твои звёздные собачьи лакомства премиум класса, Джунипер. Не знал, что у Дрёмы такой изысканный вкус.
bulgarian: These are the premium gold star treats you asked for, Juniper. I didn't know Dozy had such fancy tastes.

english: It would make a killing in the right markets.
french: J'ai des clients chez qui ça aura du succès.
russian: У меня есть выход на рынки, где его с руками оторвут.
bulgarian: It would make a killing in the right markets.

english: A lady's got to retain some of her mystique, Balor.
french: Une femme se doit de garder une part de mystère, Balor.
russian: Дама имеет право хранить свои загадки, Балор.
bulgarian: A lady's got to retain some of her mystique, Balor.

english: I don't suppose you'd share the supplier for your nail polish, would you?
french: Je suppose que tu ne me dirais pas chez qui tu te fournis en vernis à ongles.
russian: Полагаю, ты не склонна делиться поставщиком своего лака для ногтей, да ведь?
bulgarian: I don't suppose you'd share the supplier for your nail polish, would you?

english: Hmph. My concoctions are priceless.
french: Mmpf. Mes préparations n'ont pas de prix.
russian: Пф. Мои смеси бесценны!
bulgarian: Hmph. My concoctions are priceless.

english: You sure you don't want to export your bath oils? I'll give you a good price.
french: Tu es sûre que tu ne veux pas commercialiser tes huiles de bain ? Elles te rapporteraient pas mal.
russian: Ты уверена, что не хочешь торговать маслами для ванны? Я дам хорошую цену.
bulgarian: You sure you don't want to export your bath oils? I'll give you a good price.

english: Trade secret.
french: C'est un secret professionnel.
russian: Секрет фирмы.
bulgarian: Trade secret.

english: How do you come up with so many different aromas at the Bathhouse? Your cabinet of scented oils must be bottomless.
french: Comment arrives-tu à proposer autant de parfums pour les bains ? Je n'imagine pas la taille de ton armoire à huiles de bain.
russian: Как у тебя получается изобретать столько разных ароматов для своей купальни? У тебя, должно быть, бездонный шкаф ароматических масел.
bulgarian: How do you come up with so many different aromas at the Bathhouse? Your cabinet of scented oils must be bottomless.

english: No, I want you to sell my soap in the Capital. I've got a bathhouse to run.
french: Non, je veux que, toi, tu vendes mon savon là-bas. Moi, j'ai des bains à faire tourner.
russian: Нет уж, я хочу, чтобы ты продавал моё мыло в столице. У меня ещё целая купальня.
bulgarian: No, I want you to sell my soap in the Capital. I've got a bathhouse to run.

english: You want to sell your soap in the Capital?
french: Tu veux vendre ton savon dans la capitale ?
russian: Хочешь продавать своё мыло в столице?
bulgarian: You want to sell your soap in the Capital?

english: You can't run trials on my patients, Juniper. I won't allow it.
french: Mes patients ne sont pas des cobayes, Juniper. C'est hors de question.
russian: Джунипер, на моих пациентах экспериментировать нельзя. Я не позволю.
bulgarian: You can't run trials on my patients, Juniper. I won't allow it.

english: So YOU drink it!
french: Tu n'as qu'à essayer pour voir !
russian: Тогда САМА выпей!
bulgarian: So YOU drink it!

english: We can share it, if you like.
french: On fait moitié moitié si tu veux.
russian: Если так хочешь, выпьем вместе.
bulgarian: We can share it, if you like.

english: Would you two be quiet? I'm trying to recover here!
french: Vous pourriez la fermer ? J'essaie de guérir !
russian: Можно потише? Я тут выздоравливать пытаюсь!
bulgarian: Would you two be quiet? I'm trying to recover here!

english: Valen won't let me give Balor one of my potions. He'd be up and about right away if he drank it. Probably.
french: Valen refuse que je donne une de mes potions à Balor. Pourtant, ça le requinquerait en moins de deux. Enfin... normalement.
russian: Вален не разрешает мне дать Балору моё зелье. Оно бы его сразу на ноги подняло. Скорее всего.
bulgarian: Valen won't let me give Balor one of my potions. He'd be up and about right away if he drank it. Probably.

english: Music to my ears!
french: Ah, ça me fait vraiment plaisir !
russian: Музыка для моих ушей!
bulgarian: Music to my ears!

english: I've recognized your work on more than one occasion around the Capital. The nobility seem quite attached to your craftsmanship.
french: J'ai reconnu ta patte plusieurs fois dans la capitale. La haute société semble vraiment apprécier ton travail.
russian: Я не раз встречал твои работы в столице. Кажется, твоё ремесло популярно среди знати.
bulgarian: I've recognized your work on more than one occasion around the Capital. The nobility seem quite attached to your craftsmanship.

english: Sometimes he'll sit out on the porch and watch the birds over morning coffee.
french: Le matin, il s'assied parfois sur le porche, un café à la main, et observe les oiseaux.
russian: Иногда по утрам он садится на крыльцо и пьёт кофе, наблюдая за птицами.
bulgarian: Sometimes he'll sit out on the porch and watch the birds over morning coffee.

english: Sounds like a perfect piece of morning quiet.
french: Ça a l'air parfait pour commencer la journée en douceur.
russian: Звучит, как идеальное спокойное утро.
bulgarian: Sounds like a perfect piece of morning quiet.

english: I like having a place just outside of town! Ryis especially seems to like it.
french: Je suis heureux de vivre à l'extérieur de la ville ! Ryis semble beaucoup apprécier cet endroit aussi.
russian: Мне нравится наш дом на окраине. И Риз его очень любит.
bulgarian: I like having a place just outside of town! Ryis especially seems to like it.

english: You're a dozen seasons too early to get one over on me, sonny!
french: Tu es encore à des années-lumière de pouvoir gagner contre moi, fiston !
russian: Хочешь меня обыграть — потренируйся ещё лет десять!
bulgarian: You're a dozen seasons too early to get one over on me, sonny!

english: I still can't believe I lost all my chips to you. I thought I had a winning hand!
french: Je n'arrive toujours pas à croire que tu aies gagné tous mes jetons. Je pensais avoir une bonne main !
russian: Поверить не могу, что я тебе все фишки проиграл. У меня была выигрышная рука!
bulgarian: I still can't believe I lost all my chips to you. I thought I had a winning hand!

english: I can't do it myself, but... well, I suppose I've seen enough of my wagon on bad days to pick up a thing or two.
french: Je ne peux rien réparer moi-même, mais... mon chariot a subi tellement de dégâts que j'ai retenu deux ou trois choses.
russian: Сам я не справляюсь, но... Я и правда не раз бывал с ним в передрягах, так что пару вещей выучил.
bulgarian: I can't do it myself, but... well, I suppose I've seen enough of my wagon on bad days to pick up a thing or two.

english: You're getting pretty knowledgeable about wagon repair, Balor!
french: Tu commences à t'y connaître en réparation de chariot, Balor !
russian: Ты уже неплохо разбираешься в ремонте фургонов, Балор!
bulgarian: You're getting pretty knowledgeable about wagon repair, Balor!

english: Oh, that's flattering! But no, I'm retired.
french: Oh, c'est très flatteur, mais non, j'ai pris ma retraite.
russian: Ох, это очень лестно! Но нет, я уже на пенсии.
bulgarian: Oh, that's flattering! But no, I'm retired.

english: Still, let me know if any really good requests come in.
french: Ceci dit, n'hésite pas à venir me voir si certaines commandes sont particulièrement intéressantes.
russian: Но ты на всякий случай дай мне знать, если будут какие-нибудь очень хорошие заказы.
bulgarian: Still, let me know if any really good requests come in.

english: You know, I still get requests from the Capital for your furniture, Landen.
french: Des gens de la capitale me demandent toujours des meubles fabriqués par Landen.
russian: Знаешь, Ланден, мне до сих пор приходят заказы на твою мебель из столицы.
bulgarian: You know, I still get requests from the Capital for your furniture, Landen.

english: Maybe I just like your company, old-timer.
french: C'est peut-être aussi parce que j'apprécie ta compagnie, l'ancien.
russian: Может, мне просто нравится твоя компания, старина.
bulgarian: Maybe I just like your company, old-timer.

english: Do you need some tips on how to take care of your wagon, Balor? I never met someone who needed repairs as often as you.
french: Tu veux que je t'explique comment entretenir ton chariot, Balor. C'est la première fois que je vois quelqu'un dont le chariot casse si souvent.
russian: Балор, может, тебе дать совет, как содержать свой фургон? Я не встречал ещё человека, которому так часто нужен ремонт.
bulgarian: Do you need some tips on how to take care of your wagon, Balor? I never met someone who needed repairs as often as you.

english: Oh, no need to explain... I'm happy to leave this kind of work to the experts.
french: Oh, inutile de m'expliquer... Je vais laisser faire les experts.
russian: Да можешь не объяснять. Я лучше предоставлю это дело профессионалам.
bulgarian: Oh, no need to explain... I'm happy to leave this kind of work to the experts.

english: Better pull up a chair, Balor. Uncle Landen's only getting started!
french: Prends une chaise, Balor. Oncle Landen ne fait que commencer !
russian: Усаживайся поудобнее, Балор. Дядя Ланден только начал!
bulgarian: Better pull up a chair, Balor. Uncle Landen's only getting started!

english: Now listen here, Balor. To get an angle like that, you need a proper smoothing plane and a spokeshave, and...
french: Écoute, Balor. Pour obtenir cet angle, tu as besoin d'un rabot bien affûté, d'une dégauchisseuse et...
russian: Вот смотри, Балор. Чтобы сделать такой угол, нужно взять подходящий рубанок и стружок, а затем...
bulgarian: Now listen here, Balor. To get an angle like that, you need a proper smoothing plane and a spokeshave, and...

english: Another? You're single-handedly keeping our woodshop open, Balor.
french: Encore ? Tu fais tourner notre boutique à toi tout seul, Balor.
russian: Ещё одно? Наше дело ещё на плаву только благодаря тебе, Балор.
bulgarian: Another? You're single-handedly keeping our woodshop open, Balor.

english: I'll pay double if you keep your jokes to yourself.
french: Je paierai double si tu gardes tes remarques pour toi.
russian: Готов доплатить, если вы оставите шутки при себе.
bulgarian: I'll pay double if you keep your jokes to yourself.

english: Regular price it is.
french: On reste sur le prix normal.
russian: Что ж, значит, без доплаты.
bulgarian: Regular price it is.

english: He needs a new wagon wheel, Uncle.
french: Il a besoin d'une nouvelle roue pour son chariot, oncle Landen.
russian: Дядя, ему нужно новое колесо.
bulgarian: He needs a new wagon wheel, Uncle.

english: Noted.
french: Je le note.
russian: Понял.
bulgarian: Noted.

english: I had to ship an anvil once. Never again.
french: Une fois, j'ai dû livrer une enclume. Plus jamais ça.
russian: Однажды мне пришлось доставлять наковальню. Больше не собираюсь.
bulgarian: I had to ship an anvil once. Never again.

english: Not a problem. In fact, there's some detail work I could do to make it even more authentic looking than the original.
french: Sans aucun problème. D'ailleurs, je peux même retravailler certaines parties pour que ça ait l'air plus authentique que l'original.
russian: Без проблем. Могу даже добавить тонкой работы: будет выглядеть аутентичнее оригинала.
bulgarian: Not a problem. In fact, there's some detail work I could do to make it even more authentic looking than the original.

english: So can you replicate the style of the piece? I'll pay handsomely, and I'll supply the gems for the settings.
french: Alors, tu peux forger des objets dans le même style ? Je paie bien et je fournis les pierres.
russian: Значит, ты можешь воспроизвести узор? Я щедро заплачу и предоставлю камни для украшения.
bulgarian: So can you replicate the style of the piece? I'll pay handsomely, and I'll supply the gems for the settings.

english: Oh, absolutely not. That sounds exhausting.
french: Non, sans façon. C'est trop physique pour moi.
russian: Определённо нет. Звучит утомительно.
bulgarian: Oh, absolutely not. That sounds exhausting.

english: Happy to leave it to the expert.
french: Je préfère laisser ça aux experts.
russian: Лучше доверю профессионалу.
bulgarian: Happy to leave it to the expert.

english: You ever wanted to learn how to do your own repairs, Balor? I could teach you, if you want.
french: Tu n'as jamais voulu apprendre à réparer ton chariot toi-même, Balor ? Je pourrais te montrer, si tu veux.
russian: Не хочешь научиться сам ремонтировать свои вещи, Балор? Я могу научить.
bulgarian: You ever wanted to learn how to do your own repairs, Balor? I could teach you, if you want.

english: I don't understand. Are you sure? With your skill, finding you a steady stream of clients from the Capital would be easy.
french: Je ne comprends pas. Tu es sûr ? Vu ton talent, je pourrais facilement te trouver des clients dans la capitale.
russian: Не понимаю тебя. Точно нет? С твоими навыками легко будет наладить поток клиентов из столицы.
bulgarian: I don't understand. Are you sure? With your skill, finding you a steady stream of clients from the Capital would be easy.

english: March would love doing all that fancy stuff, but as much as he complains about making nails, I know my bro... Mistria comes first. He's always been like that!
french: March adorerait construire des objets plus sophistiqués, mais même s'il en a marre de fabriquer des clous, je connais mon frère... Mistria a la priorité. Il est comme ça !
russian: Март бы с радостью ковал всякие вычурные штучки. Но я своего бро знаю: хоть он и жалуется, что вечно делает гвозди, Мистрия для него в приоритете. Он всегда такой был!
bulgarian: March would love doing all that fancy stuff, but as much as he complains about making nails, I know my bro... Mistria comes first. He's always been like that!

english: No thanks, Balor. I'm good for now.
french: Merci, Balor. Ça va comme ça.
russian: Спасибо, Балор, мне пока не нужно.
bulgarian: No thanks, Balor. I'm good for now.

english: That can't be right. There's always something wrong with the wagon.
french: C'est bizarre. D'habitude, il a toujours un souci.
russian: Не может быть. С твоим фургоном всегда что-то не так.
bulgarian: That can't be right. There's always something wrong with the wagon.

english: Yeah, you don't have to lie to us, Balor. We're happy to do the work.
french: Oui, ne nous mens pas, Balor. Ça ne nous dérange pas de regarder.
russian: Не надо нам врать, Балор. Мы с радостью возьмёмся за работу.
bulgarian: Yeah, you don't have to lie to us, Balor. We're happy to do the work.

english: The wagon's looking pretty good, actually. But thanks for checking in, boys.
french: Le chariot est en bon état, mais merci d'avoir demandé, les gars.
russian: Фургон в полном порядке. Но спасибо за заботу, ребята.
bulgarian: The wagon's looking pretty good, actually. But thanks for checking in, boys.

english: Hey, no cutting! He's working on my fish hooks right now!
french: Ne va pas le déranger ! Il fabrique mes hameçons, là !
russian: Эй, в очередь! У него сейчас по плану мои рыболовные крючки.
bulgarian: Hey, no cutting! He's working on my fish hooks right now!

english: Not to interrupt, but I really need those nails, March.
french: Désolé de t'embêter, March, mais j'ai vraiment besoin de ces clous.
russian: Не хочу вас прерывать, но мне правда сейчас нужны гвозди, Март.
bulgarian: Not to interrupt, but I really need those nails, March.

english: No one's getting anything if you all don't shut it. I can barely concentrate!
french: Personne n'aura rien si vous n'arrêtez pas de discuter. Je n'arrive pas à me concentrer !
russian: Никто ничего не получит, пока не замолчите! Я не могу сосредоточиться.
bulgarian: No one's getting anything if you all don't shut it. I can barely concentrate!

english: What do you think, March? Can you make me a new axle for my wagon?
french: Alors, March ? Tu peux me fabriquer un nouvel essieu pour le chariot ?
russian: Что думаешь, Март? Сможешь сделать новую ось для моего фургона?
bulgarian: What do you think, March? Can you make me a new axle for my wagon?

english: He's definitely getting tired. Take a break, March!
french: Oui, il commence à fatiguer. Fais une pause, March !
russian: Он явно начал уставать. Сделай перерыв, Март!
bulgarian: He's definitely getting tired. Take a break, March!

english: Oh, I think he heard us. Look, he's hammering faster.
french: Oh, je crois qu'il nous a entendus. Regardez, il tape encore plus vite.
russian: Ой, кажется, он нас услышал. Вон, смотрите, ещё быстрее застучал.
bulgarian: Oh, I think he heard us. Look, he's hammering faster.

english: [Ari], please tell those gossips that they can warm themselves by the forge only if they're quiet!
french: [Ari], tu peux dire à ces commères qu'elles peuvent se réchauffer près de la forge si elles se taisent.
russian: [Ari], передай этим зевакам, пожалуйста, что у кузницы им разрешается греться только молча!
bulgarian: [Ari], please tell those gossips that they can warm themselves by the forge only if they're quiet!

english: What do you think? He's been swinging that hammer for a while now.
french: Vous en pensez quoi ? Ça fait un moment qu'il tape avec son marteau là.
russian: Ну, что думаешь? Он там уже давно молотом стучит.
bulgarian: What do you think? He's been swinging that hammer for a while now.

english: I brought a deck! I can deal.
french: J'ai apporté les miennes ! Je distribue.
russian: У меня с собой колода! Я раздам.
bulgarian: I brought a deck! I can deal.

english: All that's left is a card table! March, we're going to need your anvil.
french: Il ne nous manque plus qu'une table ! March, on va avoir besoin de ton enclume.
russian: Осталось только найти стол! Март, мы позаимствуем твою наковальню.
bulgarian: All that's left is a card table! March, we're going to need your anvil.

english: I'm working here!
french: Mais je travaille, là !
russian: Я здесь работаю!
bulgarian: I'm working here!

english: Looks like we've got a group. Should we get a game of cards going?
french: Je crois que nous sommes assez nombreux pour une partie de cartes ?
russian: Кажется, собралась компания. Может, сыграем в карты?
bulgarian: Looks like we've got a group. Should we get a game of cards going?

english: It was a ruby, back in the Capital. Big as Hayden's fist, and a red so dark and deep you could lose yourself in it.
french: C'était un rubis, à la capitale. Il était aussi gros que le poing d'Hayden, et d'un rouge sombre et profond, presque hypnotisant.
russian: Рубин, ещё в столице. Размером с кулак Хейдена, тёмно-красный и такой глубокий, что взгляд теряется.
bulgarian: It was a ruby, back in the Capital. Big as Hayden's fist, and a red so dark and deep you could lose yourself in it.

english: Between you and me, though, I think there's probably a bigger gem waiting in Mistria's mines. Seems like it's full of mysteries!
french: Mais entre nous, je suis sûr que les mines de Mistria renferment une pierre encore plus grosse. Elles sont pleines de secrets !
russian: Но, между нами, я думаю, в шахтах Мистрии скрываются камни и побольше. Кажется, здесь полно загадок!
bulgarian: Between you and me, though, I think there's probably a bigger gem waiting in Mistria's mines. Seems like it's full of mysteries!

english: What's the biggest gem you ever saw, Balor? An emerald? A sapphire?
french: Quelle est la plus grosse pierre précieuse que tu aies jamais vue, Balor ? Une émeraude ? Un saphir ?
russian: Какой самый большой драгоценный камень ты видел, Балор? Изумруд? Сапфир?
bulgarian: What's the biggest gem you ever saw, Balor? An emerald? A sapphire?

english: I did, and I don't like that third clause about unsold stock...
french: Oui, et je n'aime pas la troisième clause concernant les invendus...
russian: Да, и мне очень не нравится третий пункт про нераспроданные остатки...
bulgarian: I did, and I don't like that third clause about unsold stock...

english: Have them strike it, and tell them Balor says hello. They'll get the message.
french: Dis-leur de la supprimer et ajoute que Balor leur passe le bonjour. Ils comprendront.
russian: Пускай вычёркивают, скажи им: «Балор передаёт привет». Они всё поймут.
bulgarian: Have them strike it, and tell them Balor says hello. They'll get the message.

english: Did you have a chance to look at that supplier's contract, Balor?
french: Balor, tu as pu jeter un œil au contrat proposé par ce fournisseur ?
russian: Тебе удалось посмотреть на договор с постащиком, Балор?
bulgarian: Did you have a chance to look at that supplier's contract, Balor?

english: All credit to the folks who fill their shipping bins! I'm simply the courier.
french: C'est parce que les gens remplissent leurs boîtes d'expédition ! Moi, je ne fais que livrer.
russian: Всё благодаря людям, заполняющим ящики! Я лишь выполняю доставку.
bulgarian: All credit to the folks who fill their shipping bins! I'm simply the courier.

english: This shipping system has worked out well, Balor. It seems like you've always got something for us to stock.
french: Ton système d'envoi fonctionne bien, Balor. J'ai l'impression que tu as toujours ce qui nous manque.
russian: Система отгрузочных ящиков исправно работает, Балор. У тебя, кажется, всегда что-нибудь для нас есть.
bulgarian: This shipping system has worked out well, Balor. It seems like you've always got something for us to stock.

english: Oh, I love it. Opening that box makes every day a surprise.
french: Oh, j'adore. C'est comme ouvrir une pochette surprise tous les jours.
russian: Это чудесная работа! Каждый раз удивляюсь, когда открываю этот ящик.
bulgarian: Oh, I love it. Opening that box makes every day a surprise.

english: Thank you again for making all the pickups from [Ari]'s shipping bin. That was my father's job, once upon a time.
french: Merci encore d'aller récupérer tout ce que [Ari] laisse dans sa boîte d'expédition. C'est mon père qui s'en chargeait avant.
russian:
Ещё раз спасибо, что забрал всё из ящика, который

поставили

поставилапоставилпоставило [Ari]. Когда-то этим занимался мой отец.
bulgarian: Thank you again for making all the pickups from [Ari]'s shipping bin. That was my father's job, once upon a time.

english: I'm glad she's picking up the family business, but to what end...
french: Je suis contente qu'elle s'intéresse à notre petite entreprise, mais je ne sais pas ce que ça donnera si elle le reprend...
russian: Я рада, что она интересуется семейным бизнесом, но с такой целью...
bulgarian: I'm glad she's picking up the family business, but to what end...

english: Maybe it's time for Dell to learn about sword taxes.
french: Il est temps qu'on explique à Dell qu'il y a des taxes sur les armes.
russian: Возможно, Делл пора рассказать про налоги на мечи.
bulgarian: Maybe it's time for Dell to learn about sword taxes.

english: You know... I think you're onto something.
french: Mais oui... Je crois que tu as raison.
russian: А знаешь... Возможно, ты дело говоришь.
bulgarian: You know... I think you're onto something.

english: Lately, Dell's been asking me why our family doesn't have a sword budget.
french: Ces temps-ci, Dell n'arrête pas de me demander pourquoi notre famille ne consacre pas une part du budget à l'achat d'épées.
russian: Недавно Делл стала донимать меня вопросами, почему мы в семье не откладываем средств на мечи.
bulgarian: Lately, Dell's been asking me why our family doesn't have a sword budget.

english: All of them, man! It's so fun seeing all the different jobs in Mistria.
french: Je les aime tous ! C'est génial de s'essayer à tous les boulots qui existent à Mistria.
russian: Да тут всё моё! В Мистрии здорово пробовать разные занятия.
bulgarian: All of them, man! It's so fun seeing all the different jobs in Mistria.

english: March says I'm an Olric of all trades!
french: March dit que je suis polyvalent !
russian: Март говорит, я Ольрик на все руки!
bulgarian: March says I'm an Olric of all trades!

english: I've noticed that you work a lot of odd jobs around town, Olric. Very enterprising of you. Have any clicked for you?
french: J'ai vu que tu faisais plein de petits boulots en ville, Olric. Tu fais preuve de beaucoup d'initiative. Il y en a un qui te plaît en particulier ?
russian: Я заметил, что ты берёшь много разных работ по городу, Ольрик. Весьма предприимчиво. Нашёл что-нибудь своё?
bulgarian: I've noticed that you work a lot of odd jobs around town, Olric. Very enterprising of you. Have any clicked for you?

english: C'mon, Balor! Nothing stops those two when they set their mind to something.
french: Attends, Balor ! Tu sais que quand ces deux-là ont une idée en tête, rien ne peut les arrêter.
russian: О чём ты, Балор! Знаешь же, этих двоих ничто не остановит, если они захотят как следует.
bulgarian: C'mon, Balor! Nothing stops those two when they set their mind to something.

english: And you're helping too, right [Ari]? The Market's totally coming back!
french: Et puis, tu y contribues toi aussi, pas vrai, [Ari] ? Donc, c'est sûr et certain que le marché va reprendre !
russian: [Ari], ты ведь тоже помогаешь? Базар точно скоро вернётся!
bulgarian: And you're helping too, right [Ari]? The Market's totally coming back!

english: I came out to Mistria for the Saturday Market, among other reasons. I sure hope Adeline and Nora can get it sorted out.
french: Si je me suis installé à Mistria, c'est en partie pour le marché du samedi. J'espère qu'Adeline et Nora arriveront à le relancer.
russian: Я приехал в Мистрию, помимо прочего, из-за Субботнего базара. Надеюсь, у Аделины с Норой получится его вернуть.
bulgarian: I came out to Mistria for the Saturday Market, among other reasons. I sure hope Adeline and Nora can get it sorted out.

english: Ooh, that sounds so interesting! I bet that makes it feel kind of grown-up.
french: Oooh, c'est très intrigant ! Ça doit donner une boisson moins enfantine.
russian: Ооо, как интересно! Наверное, получается уже не такой детский напиток.
bulgarian: Ooh, that sounds so interesting! I bet that makes it feel kind of grown-up.

english: Kind of like when Hemlock puts a splash of whiskey in his cocoa!
french: Un peu comme quand Hemlock met une goutte de whisky dans son chocolat !
russian: Как когда Хемлок разбавляет своё какао виски!
bulgarian: Kind of like when Hemlock puts a splash of whiskey in his cocoa!

english: That's a little different, but I take your point.
french: C'est légèrement différent, mais je vois ce que tu veux dire.
russian: Это не совсем то же самое, но я поняла сравнение.
bulgarian: That's a little different, but I take your point.

english: You know, I had $Hot Chocolate$ with some kind of pepper in it, once. That was unforgettable.
french: Une fois, j'ai bu un $chocolat chaud$ dans lequel on avait mis du poivre. C'était incroyable.
russian: Знаете, однажды я попробовал $горячий шоколад$ с каким-то перцем. Незабываемое впечатление.
bulgarian: You know, I had $Hot Chocolate$ with some kind of pepper in it, once. That was unforgettable.

english: Another one?
french: Encore un ?
russian: Ещё одну?
bulgarian: Another one?

english: Um, I finished the last one already...
french: Hum, j'ai déjà fini le précédent...
russian: Эм, прошлую я уже дочитала...
bulgarian: Um, I finished the last one already...

english: I'll see what I can do.
french: Je vais voir ce que je peux faire.
russian: Посмотрю, что можно сделать.
bulgarian: I'll see what I can do.

english: Hey Balor, do you think you could pick up another book for me next time you're in the Capital?
french: Dis, Balor, tu crois que tu pourrais me prendre un nouveau livre la prochaine fois que tu iras à la capitale ?
russian: Слушай, Балор, не мог бы ты привезти мне ещё одну книгу, когда в следующий раз будешь в столице?
bulgarian: Hey Balor, do you think you could pick up another book for me next time you're in the Capital?

english: Oh, it's nothing at all! We appreciate the business!
french: Oh, ce n'est rien du tout ! On est ravis de t'avoir parmi nous !
russian: Ой, да это не проблема! Ты же наш клиент!
bulgarian: Oh, it's nothing at all! We appreciate the business!

english: Your family's quite kind to let me post up in that room for so long.
french: C'est très gentil à ta famille de m'avoir laissé m'installer cette chambre pendant tout ce temps.
russian: Спасибо большое твоим родителям, что позволяют мне так долго занимать комнату.
bulgarian: Your family's quite kind to let me post up in that room for so long.

english: I've got a whole list going! Maple does, too.
french: J'ai préparé une liste ! Et Maple aussi.
russian: У меня целый список! И у Мэйпл тоже.
bulgarian: I've got a whole list going! Maple does, too.

english: Please don't use Maple's list.
french: Mais ne t'occupe pas la sienne, s'il te plaît.
russian: Только не используй список Мэйпл, пожалуйста.
bulgarian: Please don't use Maple's list.

english: I'm heading to the Capital soon. Can you think of anything the Inn is running low on?
french: Je repars bientôt pour la capitale. Vous avez besoin de quelque chose pour l'auberge ?
russian: Я скоро поеду в столицу. Придумали что-нибудь, чего в трактире не хватает?
bulgarian: I'm heading to the Capital soon. Can you think of anything the Inn is running low on?

english: Not really, but we could make it look faster if we painted it red, I guess.
french: Pas vraiment, mais on pourrait donner l'impression qu'il va plus vite en le peignant en rouge.
russian: Не думаю. Но можно покрасить его красным, тогда он будет быстрее на вид.
bulgarian: Not really, but we could make it look faster if we painted it red, I guess.

english: Ooh, I like it. And how about flames?
french: Oh, cette idée me plaît bien. Avec des flammes aussi ?
russian: О, отличная идея! И, может, нарисовать огонь?
bulgarian: Ooh, I like it. And how about flames?

english: Haha, have you been talking to Dell?
french: Ha ha, tu as discuté avec Dell, ou quoi ?
russian: Ха-ха, тебя что, Делл покусала?
bulgarian: Haha, have you been talking to Dell?

english: I'm just wondering if there's some way to modify my wagon, to increase performance.
french: Je me demande si on ne pourrait pas rendre mon chariot plus performant.
russian: Я вот думаю: можно как-то улучшить конструкцию фургона, чтобы повысить скорость?
bulgarian: I'm just wondering if there's some way to modify my wagon, to increase performance.

english: Don't sell me short, my Lady! I can procure almost anything, given enough coin. And you're nothing if not a generous customer.
french: Ne me sous-estimez pas, gente dame ! Je peux me procurer presque tout ce qui existe, tant que la somme est suffisante. Et vous êtes justement une cliente généreuse.
russian: Не недооценивайте меня, госпожа! Я могу добыть почти что угодно за соответствующую плату. А вы — необычайно щедрая покупательница.
bulgarian: Don't sell me short, my Lady! I can procure almost anything, given enough coin. And you're nothing if not a generous customer.

english: Whatever it is, I can get it! I guarantee it!
french: Peu importe de quoi il s'agit, je peux l'obtenir ! Je vous le garantis !
russian: Что бы это ни было, я это достану! Я вам гарантирую!
bulgarian: Whatever it is, I can get it! I guarantee it!

english: In that case...
french: Dans ce cas...
russian: В таком случае...
bulgarian: In that case...

english: I need twenty skulls.
french: Il me faudrait vingt crânes.
russian: Мне нужно двадцать черепов.
bulgarian: I need twenty skulls.

english: Let's back things up.
french: Je reviens sur ce que j'ai dit.
russian: Давайте сбавим обороты.
bulgarian: Let's back things up.

english: Merchant Balor. I am in need of an item, but it is likely outside your realm of abilities to produce.
french: Balor, vous qui êtes marchand... j'ai besoin d'objets précis, mais les matérialiser est sans doute au-delà de mes capacités.
russian: Купец Балор. Я кое в чём нуждаюсь, но, вероятно, добыть это выше твоих возможностей.
bulgarian: Merchant Balor. I am in need of an item, but it is likely outside your realm of abilities to produce.

english: Fetch me a pair, dear merchant.
french: Je vous prie de vous en procurer deux pour moi, cher marchand.
russian: Достанешь для меня парочку, милый купец?
bulgarian: Fetch me a pair, dear merchant.

english: A Greater Mammoth? I've heard Eiland talk about them...
french: Un mammouth géant ? J'ai entendu Eiland en parler...
russian: Великого мамонта? Я слышал, Эйланд о них рассказывал...
bulgarian: A Greater Mammoth? I've heard Eiland talk about them...

english: Haven't they been extinct for... oh, I don't know, several thousand years?
french: Ce n'est pas une espèce éteinte depuis... plusieurs milliers d'années, c'est ça ?
russian: Они разве не вымерли где-то... Не знаю, пару тысяч лет назад?
bulgarian: Haven't they been extinct for... oh, I don't know, several thousand years?

english: Ah. I see much has transpired while I was indisposed.
french: Ah. Je vois que de nombreux événements se sont produits en mon absence.
russian: А. Вижу, многое изменилось, пока я была не у дел.
bulgarian: Ah. I see much has transpired while I was indisposed.

english: In that case... bring me a necromancer.
french: Dans ce cas... faites venir à moi un nécromancien.
russian: В таком случае... приведи мне некроманта.
bulgarian: In that case... bring me a necromancer.

english: I am considering commissioning a new throne. For such an endeavor, I require the tusks of a Greater Mammoth.
french: J'ai l'intention de passer commande pour un nouveau trône. Pour cela, il me faudrait les défenses d'un mammouth géant.
russian: Я задумываюсь о приобретении нового трона. Для этого предприятия мне требуются бивни великого мамонта.
bulgarian: I am considering commissioning a new throne. For such an endeavor, I require the tusks of a Greater Mammoth.

english: Anything you need, esteemed customer!
french: Tout ce qu'il vous faudra, chère cliente !
russian: Что вам угодно, глубокоуважаемая клиентка?
bulgarian: Anything you need, esteemed customer!

english: I am in need of an extra-planar living flame. I am not picky, any sort of living flame will do.
french: Il me faut une flamme animée venant d'une autre dimension. Je ne saurais être trop exigeante, n'importe quel type de flamme animée fera l'affaire.
russian: Мне нужно экстрапланарное живое пламя. Не стану капризничать, любое живое пламя пойдёт.
bulgarian: I am in need of an extra-planar living flame. I am not picky, any sort of living flame will do.

english: A living flame... I'm not sure how I'd go about procuring that.
french: Une flamme animée... Je ne sais pas trop comment en obtenir une.
russian: Живое пламя... Я с трудом представляю, как это достать.
bulgarian: A living flame... I'm not sure how I'd go about procuring that.

english: In that case, an infernal star. Certainly something so mundane is trivial to find in this age.
french: Dans ce cas, il me faudrait un astre infernal. Il est certainement très facile de se procurer quelque chose d'aussi commun, à cette époque.
russian: В таком случае инфернальная звезда. Настолько обыденные вещи уж точно должны водиться в эту эпоху.
bulgarian: In that case, an infernal star. Certainly something so mundane is trivial to find in this age.

english: I don't know about that...
french: Je n'y mettrais pas ma main à couper...
russian: Я бы не был так уверен...
bulgarian: I don't know about that...

english: You negotiate well, merchant. Fine, I'll make do with a minor fire elemental.
french: Vous êtes dur en affaires, marchand. Très bien, alors je me contenterai d'un élémentaire de feu inférieur.
russian: Хорошо торгуешься, купец. Ладно, сойдёт и младший огненный элементаль.
bulgarian: You negotiate well, merchant. Fine, I'll make do with a minor fire elemental.

english: Any color of fire will do... except for blue. That would be a dealbreaker.
french: De n'importe quelle couleur... sauf bleu. Ce serait tout à fait rédhibitoire.
russian: Цвет пламени любой... кроме синего. Это решающий фактор.
bulgarian: Any color of fire will do... except for blue. That would be a dealbreaker.

english: Merchant! I am in need of your services.
french: Marchand ! J'ai besoin de vos services.
russian: Купец! Я нуждаюсь в твоих услугах.
bulgarian: Merchant! I am in need of your services.

english: Medicine's never any trouble, Valen. You never know who might need it... it could even be me!
french: Je ne rechigne jamais à la tâche quand il s'agit de médicaments, Valen. Quelqu'un pourrait en avoir besoin à tout moment... moi y compris !
russian: С лекарствами не бывает хлопот, Вален. Никогда не знаешь, кому понадобится... Может, даже и мне!
bulgarian: Medicine's never any trouble, Valen. You never know who might need it... it could even be me!

english: I appreciate you getting these medicines in from the Capital. I hope it wasn't too much trouble.
french: Merci d'avoir rapporté ces médicaments de la capitale. J'espère que ce n'était pas trop fastidieux.
russian: Спасибо, что привёз эти лекарства из столицы. Надеюсь, это тебе не доставило хлопот.
bulgarian: I appreciate you getting these medicines in from the Capital. I hope it wasn't too much trouble.

english: Travel keeps me healthy! But I hear you, doc.
french: Les voyages, c'est la santé ! Mais d'accord, docteure.
russian: Путешествия оздоровляют! Но я вас услышал, док.
bulgarian: Travel keeps me healthy! But I hear you, doc.

english: You really should come by the Clinic for a checkup, Balor. You're on the road quite a bit.
french: Tu devrais vraiment venir faire un check-up à la clinique, Balor. Tu passes ta vie sur les routes.
russian: Тебе, кстати, правда пора бы на осмотр, Балор. Ты много времени проводишь в дороге.
bulgarian: You really should come by the Clinic for a checkup, Balor. You're on the road quite a bit.

english: Even before the earthquake, your shrine was overgrown and blocked.
french: Et même avant le tremblement de terre, votre autel était envahi par la végétation et donc hors de portée.
russian: Даже до землетрясения в твой храм не было прохода из-за зарослей.
bulgarian: Even before the earthquake, your shrine was overgrown and blocked.

english: The Dragon Priestesses cultivated those flowers carefully to ensure their hardiness.
french: Les prêtresses dragon cultivaient ces fleurs avec soin pour les rendre robustes.
russian: Жрицы дракона тщательно культивировали эти цветы, чтобы привить им выносливость.
bulgarian: The Dragon Priestesses cultivated those flowers carefully to ensure their hardiness.

english: If not for their diligence, those pale blossoms may not have survived to today.
french: Sans une telle minutie, ces plantes si délicates n'auraient pas survécu jusqu'à aujourd'hui.
russian: Если бы не их усердный труд, этот бледный цветок вряд ли бы дожил до наших дней.
bulgarian: If not for their diligence, those pale blossoms may not have survived to today.

english: Really? Well, I'll take up their efforts so future Mistrians can appreciate them as well!
french: Vraiment ? Alors je vais poursuivre leurs efforts pour que les générations suivantes d'habitants de Mistria puissent également les apprécier !
russian: Правда? Значит, я продолжу их дело, чтобы будущие мистрийцы тоже могли на него полюбоваться!
bulgarian: Really? Well, I'll take up their efforts so future Mistrians can appreciate them as well!

english: You know, I'd never seen a $Temple Flowers$ in person until the Deep Woods were re-opened!
french: Vous savez, je n'avais jamais vu de $plumerias$ de mes propres yeux jusqu'à ce que Boissombre soit à nouveau accessible !
russian: Знаешь, я никогда не видела $храмовые цветы$ вживую, пока не открылся проход в Глубокую чащу.
bulgarian: You know, I'd never seen a $Temple Flowers$ in person until the Deep Woods were re-opened!

english: Oh... thank you, Celine. Simply holding the tea warms my hands, and your kindness warms my spirit.
french: Oh... merci Céline. Le simple fait de tenir le thé me réchauffe les mains, et votre gentillesse me réchauffe le cœur.
russian: О... Спасибо, Селин. Этот сосуд уже согревает мне руки, а твоя забота согревает мой дух.
bulgarian: Oh... thank you, Celine. Simply holding the tea warms my hands, and your kindness warms my spirit.

english: You have some too, [Ari]! It's a homemade blend!
french: Sers-toi aussi, [Ari] ! J'ai préparé le mélange moi-même.
russian: Ты тоже попробуй, [Ari]! Это мой домашний сбор!
bulgarian: You have some too, [Ari]! It's a homemade blend!

english: Aren't you chilly, Caldarus? I brought a flask of tea if you'd like to warm up!
french: Vous n'avez pas froid, Caldarus ? J'ai apporté une gourde remplie de thé, si vous avez besoin de vous réchauffer !
russian: Кальдарус, тебе не холодно? Я принесла термос с чаем, если хочешь согреться!
bulgarian: Aren't you chilly, Caldarus? I brought a flask of tea if you'd like to warm up!

english: I do not consider myself alone in a place colored so deeply by memories.
french: Dans un lieu imprégné de tant de souvenirs, je n'ai pas l'impression d'être seul.
russian: Я не чувствую одиночества в месте, столь наполненном памятью.
bulgarian: I do not consider myself alone in a place colored so deeply by memories.

english: And the woods are neither lonely nor empty... I am surrounded on all sides by the hum of life.
french: Les bois n'inspirent pas la solitude ni l'isolement... De tous côtés, je suis entouré par le ronronnement de la vie.
russian: И эта чаща вовсе не пуста и нелюдима... Со всех сторон вокруг меня гудит жизнь.
bulgarian: And the woods are neither lonely nor empty... I am surrounded on all sides by the hum of life.

english: Perhaps I could be convinced, some day...
french: Je me laisserais peut-être convaincre, un jour...
russian: Возможно, когда-нибудь меня можно будет переубедить...
bulgarian: Perhaps I could be convinced, some day...

english: But for the moment, I am content where I am.
french: Mais pour le moment, je suis heureux de vivre ici.
russian: Но в настоящее время я доволен своим обиталищем.
bulgarian: But for the moment, I am content where I am.

english: Caldarus, have you ever thought about moving to town? Don't you get lonely living in the Deep Woods by yourself?
french: Caldarus, avez-vous déjà songé à vous installer en ville ? Vous devez vous sentir isolé, seul à Boissombre.
russian: Кальдарус, ты не думал переехать в город? Тебе не одиноко жить одному в Глубокой чаще?
bulgarian: Caldarus, have you ever thought about moving to town? Don't you get lonely living in the Deep Woods by yourself?

english: Haunted with the ghosts of the formerly living? That I could not say...
french: Hantés par les fantômes des vivants d'autrefois ? Je ne saurais le dire...
russian: Ты имеешь в виду призраки людей, отживших свой век? О таком мне неизвестно...
bulgarian: Haunted with the ghosts of the formerly living? That I could not say...

english: However, with age comes power... and the spirit of the living forest has endured many an age.
french: Toutefois, la force s'acquiert avec l'âge... et l'esprit de cette forêt bien vivante a résisté au fil de nombreuses ères.
russian: Однако с годами приходит сила... А дух живого леса прожил уже много веков.
bulgarian: However, with age comes power... and the spirit of the living forest has endured many an age.

english: Although it does not have what one might call eyes and ears, it is quite aware of our presence, and it will acknowledge us in its own way.
french: Même si elle n'est pas douée de la vue ou de l'ouïe, elle est tout à fait consciente de notre présence et reconnaît notre existence à sa façon.
russian: У него нет глаз или ушей в привычном понимании, однако он чувствует наc и по-своему это выражает.
bulgarian: Although it does not have what one might call eyes and ears, it is quite aware of our presence, and it will acknowledge us in its own way.

english: Does that put your heart at ease?
french: Cela apaise-t-il vos craintes ?
russian: Я развеял твои тревоги?
bulgarian: Does that put your heart at ease?

english: Not at all!
french: Absolument pas !
russian: Ни капельки!
bulgarian: Not at all!

english: When I was little, everyone said the Deep Woods were haunted! It's not true, is it?
french: Quand j'étais petite, tout le monde disait que Boissombre était hanté ! Ça n'est pas vrai, hein ?
russian: Когда я была маленькая, все говорили, что в Глубокой чаще водятся духи. Это же неправда?
bulgarian: When I was little, everyone said the Deep Woods were haunted! It's not true, is it?

english: Ah...
french: Ah...
bulgarian: Ah...

english: I apologize, Celine.
french: Je vous demande pardon, Céline.
russian: Прошу прощения, Селин.
bulgarian: I apologize, Celine.

english: You remind me of someone I once knew, that is all.
french: C'est simplement que vous me rappelez quelqu'un que j'ai connu autrefois.
russian: Ты напомнила мне человека, которого я когда-то знал, вот и всё.
bulgarian: You remind me of someone I once knew, that is all.

english: Oh! Is that a good thing or a bad thing?
french: Oh ! C'est un bon ou un mauvais souvenir ?
russian: Ой! Это хорошо или плохо?
bulgarian: Oh! Is that a good thing or a bad thing?

english: Worry not... it is a comfort.
french: Ne vous inquiétez pas... c'est réconfortant.
russian: Не беспокойся... Это спокойное чувство.
bulgarian: Worry not... it is a comfort.

english: Is everything alright, Caldarus? You seem lost in thought.
french: Tout va bien, Caldarus ? Vous semblez perdu dans vos pensées.
russian: Всё в порядке, Кальдарус? У тебя потерянный вид.
bulgarian: Is everything alright, Caldarus? You seem lost in thought.

english: Oh, that makes sense! When farmers came to settle here, they brought crops from their homelands.
french: Oh, je n'en doute pas ! Lorsque les fermiers sont venus s'installer ici, ils ont apporté avec eux des cultures de leurs terres natales.
russian: О, это можно объяснить! Когда фермеры приехали на эту землю, они привезли с собой разные культуры.
bulgarian: Oh, that makes sense! When farmers came to settle here, they brought crops from their homelands.

english: And I'm sure some wild seeds traveled along as well, stuck to their belongings.
french: Et je suis certaine que des semences de plantes sauvages ont également fait le voyage dans leurs affaires.
russian: И вдобавок с ними наверняка приехали дикие семена, прицепившиеся к одежде.
bulgarian: And I'm sure some wild seeds traveled along as well, stuck to their belongings.

english: Yes, I am familiar with this mode of propagation...
french: Oui, cette méthode de propagation ne m'est pas inconnue...
russian: Да, мне знаком такой метод распространения...
bulgarian: Yes, I am familiar with this mode of propagation...

english: When you favor long robes, you commit to picking seed burrs from your hem several times a day.
french: Lorsqu'on porte des vêtements longs, des graines ont tendance à se prendre dans l'ourlet plusieurs fois par jour.
russian: Когда носишь длинное одеяние, приходится по несколько раз за день снимать колючки с подола.
bulgarian: When you favor long robes, you commit to picking seed burrs from your hem several times a day.

english: It has been interesting to become re-acquainted with Mistria after waking. Much of the flora differs from my era.
french: Il a été très intéressant pour moi de me réhabituer à Mistria depuis mon réveil. La flore est très différente de celle de mon époque.
russian: После пробуждения было занимательно узнавать Мистрию заново. Многие растения не такие, как в мою эпоху.
bulgarian: It has been interesting to become re-acquainted with Mistria after waking. Much of the flora differs from my era.

english: With all these plants, it is as though the outside is inside. I find it pleasing.
french: Avec toutes ces plantes, cela donne la sensation d'être à l'extérieur tout en étant à l'intérieur. C'est très agréable.
russian: Со всеми этими растениями кажется, будто двор внутри. Мне это по душе.
bulgarian: With all these plants, it is as though the outside is inside. I find it pleasing.

english: Oh, I'm so glad you like it!
french: Oh, je suis contente que ça vous plaise !
russian: Ой, я рада, что тебе нравится.
bulgarian: Oh, I'm so glad you like it!

english: Your house is quite comfortable, Celine.
french: On se sent bien chez vous, Céline.
russian: У тебя очень уютный дом, Селин.
bulgarian: Your house is quite comfortable, Celine.

english: Your hospitality is appreciated. I would very much enjoy a cup of tea.
french: J'apprécie votre hospitalité. Je prendrais volontiers une tasse de thé.
russian: Я ценю твоё гостеприимство. С удовольствием выпью чашечку.
bulgarian: Your hospitality is appreciated. I would very much enjoy a cup of tea.

english: Oh, great! I have green, black, jasmine, chamomile, lemon, apple...
french: Parfait ! Je peux vous proposer du thé vert, du thé noir, du thé au jasmin, à la camomille, au citron, à la pomme...
russian: О, замечательно! У меня есть зелёный, чёрный, жасминовый, ромашковый, лимонный, яблочный...
bulgarian: Oh, great! I have green, black, jasmine, chamomile, lemon, apple...

english: Apple cinnamon, apple ginger, apple honey...
french: À la pomme et à la cannelle, à la pomme et au gingembre, à la pomme et au miel...
russian: Яблоко с корицей, яблоко с имбирём, яблоко с мёдом...
bulgarian: Apple cinnamon, apple ginger, apple honey...

english: Lavender, rose, lavender rose and... mint!
french: À la lavande, à la rose, un mélange de lavande et de rose, et... à la menthe !
russian: Лаванда, роза, лаванда с розой и... мятный!
bulgarian: Lavender, rose, lavender rose and... mint!

english: You know, I have always considered myself close to nature...
french: Vous savez, j'ai toujours considéré que j'étais moi-même proche de la nature...
russian: Знаешь, я всегда считал, что я близок к природе...
bulgarian: You know, I have always considered myself close to nature...

english: But I had no idea so much of it could become tea.
french: Mais j'ignorais qu'on pouvait faire du thé avec tellement de choses qui en proviennent.
russian: Но я даже не думал, что так много природы можно уместить в чай.
bulgarian: But I had no idea so much of it could become tea.

english: Can I offer you anything, Caldarus? Tea?
french: Je peux vous offrir quelque chose, Caldarus ? Un peu de thé ?
russian: Что тебе предложить, Кальдарус? Чаю?
bulgarian: Can I offer you anything, Caldarus? Tea?

english: Please come and explore any time you like. The forest belongs to everyone.
french: Je vous en prie, venez explorer les lieux à votre guise. La forêt appartient à tout le monde.
russian: Пожалуйста, заходи погулять, когда захочешь. Этот лес принадлежит всем.
bulgarian: Please come and explore any time you like. The forest belongs to everyone.

english: I'm so glad the $Deep Woods$ are accessible again... I missed getting lost in those trees.
french: Je suis si contente de pouvoir revenir à $Boissombre$... J'ai toujours aimé me perdre parmi ces arbres.
russian: Я так рада, что снова могу попасть в $Глубокую чащу$... Давно не блуждала среди этих деревьев.
bulgarian: I'm so glad the $Deep Woods$ are accessible again... I missed getting lost in those trees.

english: That's where I fell into the water chasing a frog!
french: C'est là où je suis tombée dans l'eau en pourchassant une grenouille !
russian: Место, где я упала в воду, когда погналась за лягушкой!
bulgarian: That's where I fell into the water chasing a frog!

english: Perhaps you can teach me how you make these powerful faces.
french: Peut-être pourriez-vous m'apprendre à faire cette « tête » aux pouvoirs si redoutables.
russian: Ты сможешь научить меня строить эффектные лица?
bulgarian: Perhaps you can teach me how you make these powerful faces.

english: Like true Dragonguards, Maple and I went in after her. In case she needed help with the frog.
french: En tant que dignes membres de la Garde des dragons, Maple et moi l'avons suivie, pour voir si elle avait besoin d'aide pour attraper la grenouille.
russian: Как подобает Драконьей страже, Мэйпл и я прыгнули вслед за Делл. На случай, если бы ей потребовалась помощь с лягушкой.
bulgarian: Like true Dragonguards, Maple and I went in after her. In case she needed help with the frog.

english: Afterwards Miss Juniper even let us clean off all the mud in the Bathhouse!
french: Et après, mademoiselle Juniper nous a même permis de nous baigner pour nous laver de toute la boue.
russian: Затем мисс Джунипер даже разрешила нам отмыть грязь в своей купальне!
bulgarian: Afterwards Miss Juniper even let us clean off all the mud in the Bathhouse!

english: She was gonna kick us out... but lucky for us I had been practicing making my cutest faces!
french: Elle allait nous mettre dehors... mais heureusement pour nous, je m'étais entraînée à faire ma tête qui fait craquer tout le monde !
russian: Она собиралась выставить нас за дверь, но, к счастью, я как раз тогда тренировалась делать жалобное лицо!
bulgarian: She was gonna kick us out... but lucky for us I had been practicing making my cutest faces!

english: To manipulate grown-ups.
french: C'est comme ça que je manipule les adultes.
russian: Чтобы манипулировать взрослыми.
bulgarian: To manipulate grown-ups.

english: Jo and I owed Juniper a week's worth of dinners for the amount of mud they tracked around.
french: Jo et moi avons dû offrir le dîner à Juniper une semaine durant pour la dédommager de toute la boue qu'ils avaient apportée.
russian: Мы с Джо обещали Джунипер неделю бесплатных обедов за такую грязь.
bulgarian: Jo and I owed Juniper a week's worth of dinners for the amount of mud they tracked around.

english: Not a bad trade, if you ask me.
french: On ne s'en est pas si mal tirés, si vous voulez mon avis.
russian: И, по-моему, это был хороший обмен.
bulgarian: Not a bad trade, if you ask me.

english: I see... In this town, one can barter a slight inconvenience for free meals.
french: Je vois... Dans cette ville, la moindre petite contrariété peut se marchander contre des repas gratuits.
russian: Ясно... В этом городе можно отплатить за неудобства бесплатной едой.
bulgarian: I see... In this town, one can barter a slight inconvenience for free meals.

english: Thank you. This is excellent knowledge to have. And Maple...
french: Merci. Ce sont là des informations très précieuses. Et Maple...
russian: Спасибо. Это замечательный урок. Мэйпл...
bulgarian: Thank you. This is excellent knowledge to have. And Maple...

english: And over there, that's an important Mistrian landmark...
french: Et là-bas, c'est un lieu important de Mistria...
russian: А вон там находится важная мистрийская достопримечательность...
bulgarian: And over there, that's an important Mistrian landmark...

english: Is it because you two are arch rivals, and it's your destiny to always beat each other up?
french: C'est parce que vous êtes ennemis jurés et que votre destin est de vous affronter ?
russian: Это потому, что вы заклятые враги и вечно драться предначертано вам судьбой?
bulgarian: Is it because you two are arch rivals, and it's your destiny to always beat each other up?

english: Or is it because one of you is a traitor who can never ever be forgiven?
french: Ou bien parce que l'un d'entre vous est un traître dont les actes sont impardonnables ?
russian: Или потому что один из вас предатель, которому никогда не видать прощения?
bulgarian: Or is it because one of you is a traitor who can never ever be forgiven?

english: Caldarus, speaking as an old pro of letting bygones be bygone...
french: Caldarus, je sais ce que c'est que de laisser le passé derrière soi...
russian: Кальдарус, я, как мастер отпускать старые дрязги, дам тебе совет...
bulgarian: Caldarus, speaking as an old pro of letting bygones be bygone...

english: You don't have to answer that.
french: Vous n'avez pas besoin de répondre.
russian: Можешь им не отвечать.
bulgarian: You don't have to answer that.

english: Ah... then for the sake of brevity, I shall abstain.
french: Ah... Dans ce cas, pour ne pas me perdre en explications interminables, je préfère m'abstenir.
russian: А... в таком случае краткости ради я воздержусь.
bulgarian: Ah... then for the sake of brevity, I shall abstain.

english: Sure... but don't hesitate to tell me later, okay?
french: Je comprends... mais n'hésitez pas à me le raconter plus tard, d'accord ?
russian: Хорошо... Но мне-то потом расскажи, ладно?
bulgarian: Sure... but don't hesitate to tell me later, okay?

english: Mister Caldarus, why don't you and Miss Seridia get along?
french: Monsieur Caldarus, pourquoi vous ne vous entendez pas bien avec mademoiselle Seridia ?
russian: Мистер Кальдарус, почему вы не дружите с мисс Серидией?
bulgarian: Mister Caldarus, why don't you and Miss Seridia get along?

english: Dad, I want to run around in the snow without shoes like Mister Caldarus!
french: Papa, je veux aller me balader dans la neige pieds nus, comme monsieur Caldarus !
russian: Папа, я хочу бегать по снегу босиком, как Кльдарус!
bulgarian: Dad, I want to run around in the snow without shoes like Mister Caldarus!

english: Luc, it's freezing out. You have to keep your shoes on.
french: Luc, il fait un froid de canard. Garde tes chaussures, s'il te plaît.
russian: Люк, на улице мороз. Без ботинок — никуда.
bulgarian: Luc, it's freezing out. You have to keep your shoes on.

english: Dad, I like my shoes and don't want to take them off.
french: Papa, moi, j'aime bien mes chaussures et je ne veux pas les enlever.
russian: Папа, а мне нравятся мои ботинки, я их снимать не хочу.
bulgarian: Dad, I like my shoes and don't want to take them off.

english: Thank goodness.
french: Encore heureux.
russian: Ну и славно.
bulgarian: Thank goodness.

english: But... I would like to formally petition for Dell and Luc's right to not wear shoes.
french: Mais... je tiens à formuler une demande officielle pour accorder à Dell et Luc le droit de ne pas porter les leurs.
russian: Но... Я ходатайствую о том, чтобы обеспечить Делл и Люку право не носить обувь.
bulgarian: But... I would like to formally petition for Dell and Luc's right to not wear shoes.

english: I apologize, Hemlock. Though unwitting, I have brought calamity upon your household.
french: Je vous prie de m'excuser, Hemlock. J'ai attiré le malheur sur cette maisonnée bien malgré moi.
russian: Извини меня, Хемлок. Не имея злого умысла, я всё же принёс в твой дом раздор.
bulgarian: I apologize, Hemlock. Though unwitting, I have brought calamity upon your household.

english: Mister Caldarus, why don't you wear shoes? My mom and dad make me wear shoes every day!
french: Monsieur Caldarus, pourquoi vous ne portez pas de chaussures ? Mes parents m'obligent à en mettre tous les jours !
russian: Мистер Кальдарус, почему вы не носите обувь? Мама с папой каждый день заставляют меня надевать ботинки.
bulgarian: Mister Caldarus, why don't you wear shoes? My mom and dad make me wear shoes every day!

english: Not at all. I am happy to answer any questions that I can.
french: Pas du tout. Je suis ravi de répondre à toutes les questions, si j'ai la réponse.
russian: Вовсе нет. Я с удовольствием расскажу всё, что знаю.
bulgarian: Not at all. I am happy to answer any questions that I can.

english: I still have so many questions for you... I hope I'm not taking too much of your time!
french: J'ai encore tant de questions à vous poser... J'espère que je n'abuse pas de votre temps !
russian: У меня ещё осталось столько вопросов... Надеюсь, я не отнял у тебя слишком много времени!
bulgarian: I still have so many questions for you... I hope I'm not taking too much of your time!

english: I have many questions forming, but I will save them until after I am done reading the things I have borrowed.
french: De nombreuses questions me viennent, mais je préfère lire tout ce que j'ai emprunté avant de vous interroger.
russian: У меня возникает много вопросов, но я оставлю их до поры, когда завершу чтение.
bulgarian: I have many questions forming, but I will save them until after I am done reading the things I have borrowed.

english: I'm thrilled to hear it! And ask me any time... I'm at your disposal!
french: Je suis heureux de l'apprendre ! Et n'hésitez pas à me les poser quand vous le voudrez... Je suis à votre disposition !
russian: Очень рад слышать! Если нужно, спрашивай... я к твоим услугам!
bulgarian: I'm thrilled to hear it! And ask me any time... I'm at your disposal!

english: Thank you for loaning me your history books, Eiland. I am beginning to get a fuller picture of the time I missed.
french: Merci de m'avoir laissé emprunter vos livres d'histoire, Eiland. Je commence à mieux comprendre toute la période qui me fait défaut.
russian: Спасибо, что одолжил мне книги по истории, Эйланд. У меня начинает складываться картина того, что я успел пропустить.
bulgarian: Thank you for loaning me your history books, Eiland. I am beginning to get a fuller picture of the time I missed.

english: I am used to scrolls, you see. Books are, in many respects, easier to manipulate. I am warming up to this style of reading.
french: Je suis plutôt habitué aux parchemins, voyez-vous. Les livres sont, par de nombreux aspects, plus faciles à manipuler. Je commence à aimer cette technique de lecture.
russian: Дело в том, что мне привычнее свитки. С книгами во многих отношениях проще обращаться. Пока что я приучаю себя к такому способу чтения.
bulgarian: I am used to scrolls, you see. Books are, in many respects, easier to manipulate. I am warming up to this style of reading.

english: The books you have loaned me are quite illuminating, although reading them has required... practice.
french: J'apprends beaucoup dans les ouvrages que vous m'avez prêtés, même si... leur lecture demande un certain entraînement.
russian: Я просвещаюсь книгами, что ты одолжил, но, чтобы их читать, мне требуется... тренировка.
bulgarian: The books you have loaned me are quite illuminating, although reading them has required... practice.

english: Yes! It's a local design, seen on pottery dating back to the beginning of our recorded history.
french: En effet ! Il s'agit d'un symbole de la région découvert sur des poteries qui remontent aux premières traces écrites de notre histoire.
russian: Верно! Этот местный мотив встречается на керамике, восходящей к истокам известной нам истории.
bulgarian: Yes! It's a local design, seen on pottery dating back to the beginning of our recorded history.

english: It's singularly Mistrian, while also being easy to replicate by an embroiderer! I like to commission them as embellishments.
french: C'est caractéristique de Mistria, tout en étant facile à reproduire pour quelqu'un qui sait broder ! J'aime demander à ce qu'on en décore mes vêtements.
russian: Он отличительно мистрийский и при этом простой в вышивке! Я люблю заказывать его в качестве украшения.
bulgarian: It's singularly Mistrian, while also being easy to replicate by an embroiderer! I like to commission them as embellishments.

english: I recall such a design, from long ago... it was called the wheat pattern, and it had auspicious meanings.
french: Ce motif fait remonter des souvenirs chez moi... On l'appelait le symbole du blé, et il était de bon augure.
russian: Я помню этот мотив с древних времён... Его называли «пшеничный узор» и считали, что он сулит удачу.
bulgarian: I recall such a design, from long ago... it was called the wheat pattern, and it had auspicious meanings.

english: I'm glad to hear it... I'd have to update my entire wardrobe if it was inauspicious!
french: Vous m'en voyez ravi... S'il avait porté malchance, il aurait fallu que je renouvelle toute ma garde-robe !
russian: Приятно слышать... Если бы он сулил неудачу, мне пришлось бы сменить весь гардероб!
bulgarian: I'm glad to hear it... I'd have to update my entire wardrobe if it was inauspicious!

english: Eiland, I have noted your attire frequently sports an old motif. A line of chevrons, separated by dots.
french: Eiland, j'ai remarqué que votre tenue était souvent décorée d'un motif ancien : une ligne de chevrons séparés par des points.
russian: Эйланд, я заметил на твоей одежде один старинный узор. Линия из чередующихся уголков и горошин.
bulgarian: Eiland, I have noted your attire frequently sports an old motif. A line of chevrons, separated by dots.

english: Who knew that finding your statue on <he>his</he><she>her</she><they>their</they><it>its</it><none>[Ari]'s</none> farm would be the beginning of such an adventure!
french: Qui aurait pu prédire que la découverte de la statue sur sa ferme allait marquer le début d'une telle aventure !
russian:
Когда мы нашли твою статую на

их

еёегоего ферме, я и представить не мог, что это будет целое приключение!
bulgarian: Who knew that finding your statue on <he>his</he><she>her</she><they>their</they><it>its</it><none>[Ari]'s</none> farm would be the beginning of such an adventure!

english: I owe a deep debt of gratitude to <he>him</he><she>her</she><they>them</they><it>it</it><none>[Ari]</none>, and to you, for my shrine's restoration.
french: J'ai une énorme dette envers <he>lui</he><she>elle</she><they>ellui</they>, et envers vous, pour avoir restauré mon autel.
russian:
Я в долгу перед

ними

нейнимним и перед тобой за восстановление моего святилища.
bulgarian: I owe a deep debt of gratitude to <he>him</he><she>her</she><they>them</they><it>it</it><none>[Ari]</none>, and to you, for my shrine's restoration.

english: It's a good thing [Ari] was able to fix your statue... otherwise, I was going to keep that stone head in my office...
french: Si [Ari] n'avait pas pu réparer la statue à votre effigie... j'aurais conservé cette tête de pierre dans mon bureau...
russian:
Хорошо, что [Ari]

восстановили

восстановилавосстановилвосстановило твою статую... Иначе я бы забрал каменную голову себе в офис...
bulgarian: It's a good thing [Ari] was able to fix your statue... otherwise, I was going to keep that stone head in my office...

english: For preservation's sake, of course!
french: Pour la préserver, cela va de soi !
russian: В целях сохранения, разумеется!
bulgarian: For preservation's sake, of course!

english: You and [Ari] have both been through so much! To think, this whole time I was working alongside the Dragonsworn...
french: [Ari] et vous avez traversé tellement d'épreuves ! Quand je pense que depuis tout ce temps, je faisais équipe avec le paladin du dragon...
russian: И ты, и [Ari] пережили так много всего! Подумать только: всё это время я работал под боком у драконоверного...
bulgarian: You and [Ari] have both been through so much! To think, this whole time I was working alongside the Dragonsworn...

english: I hope our modest little town pleases you! It may not be a great kingdom, but I'm very proud of what we've built here.
french: J'espère que notre humble petite ville est à votre goût ! Nous ne sommes certes pas un grand royaume, mais je suis fier de ce que nous avons bâti ici.
russian: Надеюсь, в нашем скромном городке тебе не скучно! Это, конечно, не великое королевство, но я горжусь тем, что нам удалось создать.
bulgarian: I hope our modest little town pleases you! It may not be a great kingdom, but I'm very proud of what we've built here.

english: I treasure Mistria, Eiland.
french: Mistria est un lieu cher à mon cœur, Eiland.
russian: Мистрия мне очень дорога, Эйланд.
bulgarian: I treasure Mistria, Eiland.

english: Kingdoms or towns... no matter the size, their greatness lies within their people.
french: Il en va pour les villes comme pour les royaumes... La taille ne fait pas la grandeur. Cela ne peut venir que de ses habitants.
russian: В королевствах или в маленьких городках... величие происходит от людей, населяющих землю, а не от территории.
bulgarian: Kingdoms or towns... no matter the size, their greatness lies within their people.

english: You've seen so many things, Caldarus... so much history.
french: Vous avez assisté à tellement de choses, Caldarus... à tant d'événements historiques.
russian: Ты столько всего повидал, Кальдарус... застал историю.
bulgarian: You've seen so many things, Caldarus... so much history.

english: Let me think back. Yes, it was all remarkably... green.
french: Laissez-moi me replonger dans cette époque. Oui, tout était remarquablement... vert.
russian: Дай-ка вспомнить. Точно, он был невероятно... зелёный.
bulgarian: Let me think back. Yes, it was all remarkably... green.

english: Ah, so you witnessed the birth of a new nation!
french: Ah, alors vous avez été témoin de la naissance d'une nouvelle nation !
russian: А, значит, ты застал рождение новой нации!
bulgarian: Ah, so you witnessed the birth of a new nation!

english: Oh no, it was all old growth. If I were to compare it to the modern era, I would say there were many more coniferous trees.
french: Oh non, il s'agissait d'une flore ancienne. Si je devais la comparer à cette époque moderne, je dirais qu'il y avait bien davantage de conifères.
russian: О, нет, это были древние насаждения. По сравнению с нынешней эпохой, я бы сказал, было сильно больше хвойных.
bulgarian: Oh no, it was all old growth. If I were to compare it to the modern era, I would say there were many more coniferous trees.

english: Ahem, Lord Caldarus... perhaps you can tell us what regulatory systems were like at the time.
french: Hum, Seigneur Caldarus... Pouvez-vous nous en dire plus sur le système de réglementation de cette époque ?
russian: Кхм, лорд Кальдарус... Может, у вас получится рассказать нам  про социальный климат тех времён?
bulgarian: Ahem, Lord Caldarus... perhaps you can tell us what regulatory systems were like at the time.

english: Certainly. There was a span when the autumns were unusually mild, so river fishing was quite excellent during that period.
french: Certainement. Durant une certaine période, les automnes furent exceptionnellement doux, ce qui était idéal pour la pêche en rivière.
russian: Разумеется. Много лет подряд была необычно тёплая осень, так что рыба в реке ловилась просто превосходно.
bulgarian: Certainly. There was a span when the autumns were unusually mild, so river fishing was quite excellent during that period.

english: Caldarus, I'm terribly curious... what did the political landscape look like during your Draconic Age?
french: Caldarus, quelque chose pique ma curiosité... Qu'en était-il du paysage politique, durant votre ère draconique ?
russian: Кальдарус, мне крайне любопытно... Как выглядел политический ландшафт в эпоху драконов?
bulgarian: Caldarus, I'm terribly curious... what did the political landscape look like during your Draconic Age?

english: I suppose one could call it dramatic. I had my own interpersonal conflicts, of course, but the most dramatic event of that young era...
french: D'aucuns diront que ce fut terrible, en effet. J'avais moi-même des conflits relationnels à gérer, mais je dirais que l'événement le plus marquant de cette période encore jeune...
russian: Да, можно назвать его и захватывающим. Конечно, у меня были личные ссоры, но самым впечатляющим событием этой молодой эпохи было...
bulgarian: I suppose one could call it dramatic. I had my own interpersonal conflicts, of course, but the most dramatic event of that young era...

english: Yes?
french: Oui ?
russian: Да-да?
bulgarian: Yes?

english: Not far from this very landmass...
french: Non loin de cette île...
russian: Неподалёку от этого островка...
bulgarian: Not far from this very landmass...

english: An underwater volcano was born!
french: Un volcan sous-marin a émergé !
russian: Родился подводный вулкан!
bulgarian: An underwater volcano was born!

english: It never blossomed into a land mass... but I believe the geothermal activity that followed is what heats Mistria's very own bathhouse!
french: Ce n'est jamais devenu un continent... mais je crois que son activité géothermique est ce qui produit la chaleur des bains de Mistria !
russian: Он так и не вышел на поверхность... Но, по-моему, именно его геотермальная активность сейчас согревает мистрийскую купальню!
bulgarian: It never blossomed into a land mass... but I believe the geothermal activity that followed is what heats Mistria's very own bathhouse!

english: Oh, that is interesting indeed!
french: Oh, voilà qui est en effet très intéressant !
russian: О, это и вправду весьма занимательно!
bulgarian: Oh, that is interesting indeed!

english: Caldarus, what was the world like before the Witch Queen's ascension? From what few documents remain, it sounds dramatic!
french: Caldarus, à quoi ressemblait le monde avant l'avènement de la Reine-sorcière ? D'après le peu de documents dont nous disposons encore, cela avait l'air terrible !
russian: Кальдарус, расскажи, как выглядел мир до прихода королевы-ведьмы? Судя по немногим сохранившимся свидетельствам, это было захватывающее время!
bulgarian: Caldarus, what was the world like before the Witch Queen's ascension? From what few documents remain, it sounds dramatic!

english: Ah... as dragons are largely solitary creatures, I believe many customs are created and kept on an individual basis.
french: Ah... Les dragons étant principalement des créatures solitaires, je crois que de nombreuses traditions sont observées à titre individuel.
russian: А... Драконы по большей части живут в одиночку. Полагаю, из-за этого многие обычаи формируются и поддерживаются отдельными личностями.
bulgarian: Ah... as dragons are largely solitary creatures, I believe many customs are created and kept on an individual basis.

english: I have spent much of my life observing the cycles of nature in relative seclusion, so I may not be the most ideal dragon to survey.
french: J'ai passé une grande partie de ma vie à voir défiler les cycles de la nature dans un isolement relatif, je ne suis peut-être donc pas le dragon le mieux placé pour apporter une réponse.
russian: Я провёл значительную часть своей жизни, наблюдая за природой в относительном уединении. Так что я, вероятно, не самый лучший дракон для таких вопросов.
bulgarian: I have spent much of my life observing the cycles of nature in relative seclusion, so I may not be the most ideal dragon to survey.

english: However, if I were pressed, I might say a dragon's most ideal food is... the $Seafood Boil$ at the Sleeping Dragon Inn.
french: Toutefois, si je devais en formuler une, je dirais que la nourriture parfaite pour un dragon est... le plat de $fruits de mer à la cajun$ de l'auberge du Dragon qui dort.
russian: Но, если задуматься, я могу сказать, что любимая пища дракона...=Смесь морепродуктов= в трактире «Спящий дракон».
bulgarian: However, if I were pressed, I might say a dragon's most ideal food is... the $Seafood Boil$ at the Sleeping Dragon Inn.

english: I see that dragons have excellent taste.
french: Je vois que les dragons ont très bon goût.
russian: Вижу, у драконов отменное чувство вкуса.
bulgarian: I see that dragons have excellent taste.
