french: Oui. J'ai même trouvé comment je vais utiliser les dernières pommes de terre du cellier.
russian: Очень неплохо! Я даже нашла применение остаткам картофеля в подвале.
bulgarian: Pretty good! I even figured out how to use up the last of the potatoes in the cellar.

english: What about your plans for the manor garden?
french: Et toi, tu as des idées pour les jardins du manoir ?
russian: А как твоя планировка сада особняка?
bulgarian: What about your plans for the manor garden?

english: They're coming along. Take a look at the arrangement I sketched out!
french: Oui, ça prend forme. Regarde l'agencement que j'ai dessiné !
russian: Успешно продвигается. Я начертила план рассадки, вот, взгляни!
bulgarian: They're coming along. Take a look at the arrangement I sketched out!

english: How's your seasonal menu coming along, Reina?
french: Tu as pu avancer sur ton menu de saison, Reina ?
russian: Как твоё сезонное меню, Рейна?
bulgarian: How's your seasonal menu coming along, Reina?

english: No! You have to tell me if I start doing it! We're friends, right?
french: Ah non ! Au contraire, préviens-moi si je prends la même voie que lui ! On est amies, pas vrai ?
russian: Нет уж! Обязательно скажи мне, если вдруг заметишь! Мы же подруги, правда?
bulgarian: No! You have to tell me if I start doing it! We're friends, right?

english: I'm just saying, if you start making puns like your dad, I won't judge you. You can't help who you are, Celine.
french: Pour info, sache que je ne te jugerai pas si tu commences à faire des blagues comme ton père. On ne peut pas renier ses origines, Céline.
russian: Просто уточняю: я не буду осуждать, если ты начнёшь каламбурить, как отец. От наследственности не уйдёшь, Селин!
bulgarian: I'm just saying, if you start making puns like your dad, I won't judge you. You can't help who you are, Celine.

english: Coming up with new recipes is tough when I'm stuck using last year's potatoes!
french: Ce n'est pas évident de varier les recettes avec les pommes de terre de l'année dernière pour seul ingrédient !
russian: Трудновато придумать новые рецепты, когда у тебя в запасе только прошлогодний картофель!
bulgarian: Coming up with new recipes is tough when I'm stuck using last year's potatoes!

english: Have you tried foraging for fiddleheads? Spring is the perfect season for them!
french: Tu as essayé de cueillir des pousses de fougère ? C'est la saison au printemps !
russian: А ты пробовала поискать побеги папоротника? Их как раз хорошо собирать весной.
bulgarian: Have you tried foraging for fiddleheads? Spring is the perfect season for them!

english: Ooh!
french: Ah !
russian: Ого!
bulgarian: Ooh!

english: It's been hard getting my hands on my usual ingredients since the earthquake. Merchants can't get to Mistria since the bridge collapsed.
french: Depuis le tremblement de terre, j'ai du mal à obtenir mes ingrédients habituels. Les marchands ne peuvent plus venir à Mistria depuis que le pont s'est effondré.
russian: После емлетрясения некоторые ингредиенты стало трудно достать. Без моста торговцы не могут доехать до Мистрии.
bulgarian: It's been hard getting my hands on my usual ingredients since the earthquake. Merchants can't get to Mistria since the bridge collapsed.

english: I just know I'll love it, Reina! Roasted tea is perfect when it's chilly out!
french: Je sais que je vais adorer, Reina ! Le thé torréfié réchauffe quand il fait froid !
russian: Я и так знаю, что мне понравится. Рейна! Обжаренный чай идельно пьётся в холодную погоду!
bulgarian: I just know I'll love it, Reina! Roasted tea is perfect when it's chilly out!

english: I took that tea you left with me and toasted it just a smidge! Let me know what you think.
french: J'ai légèrement torréfié le thé que tu m'avais laissé ! Tu me diras ce que tu en penses.
russian: Я решила слегка обжарить чай, который ты у меня оставила в прошлый раз. Расскажешь потом, как тебе.
bulgarian: I took that tea you left with me and toasted it just a smidge! Let me know what you think.

english: I brought cocoa powder, Celine.
french: J'ai apporté de la poudre de cacao, Céline.
russian: Я принесла какао, Селин.
bulgarian: I brought cocoa powder, Celine.

english: Ohhh that sounds great!
french: Oh, c'est encore mieux !
russian: О, звучит просто замечательно!
bulgarian: Ohhh that sounds great!

english: I'll get some water going for tea!
french: Je vais faire chauffer de l'eau pour le thé !
russian: Я поставлю воду на чай!
bulgarian: I'll get some water going for tea!

english: It's not much, but please make yourself comfortable!
french: Ma maison est modeste, mais mettez-vous à l'aise !
russian: Он у меня скромный, но ты можешь располагаться поудобнее!
bulgarian: It's not much, but please make yourself comfortable!

english: Hm.
french: Mmm.
russian: Хм.
bulgarian: Hm.

english: I would normally call an abode such as this a hovel...
french: Autrefois, j'aurais appelé une demeure comme celle-ci un taudis...
russian: Обычно я бы назвала подобное жилище конурой...
bulgarian: I would normally call an abode such as this a hovel...

english: But your care and your very presence imbue it with... joy.
french: Mais votre simple présence et votre attention à mon égard rendent l'endroit... gai.
russian: Но твоя забота и само твоё присутствие наполняют его... радостью.
bulgarian: But your care and your very presence imbue it with... joy.

english: And joy has power. Even I cannot deny it.
french: Et la gaieté renferme un pouvoir. Même moi, je ne peux le nier.
russian: А в радости есть сила. Даже я не стану этого отрицать.
bulgarian: And joy has power. Even I cannot deny it.

english: Aw! That's so sweet of you to say!
french: Oh, comme c'est gentil de votre part !
russian: Ой! Как мило слышать это от тебя!
bulgarian: Aw! That's so sweet of you to say!

english: I think?
french: Parce que c'est... gentil, hein ?
russian: Наверное.
bulgarian: I think?

english: I'm glad you visit me at my cottage, Seridia.
french: Je suis heureuse que vous veniez me rendre visite chez moi, Seridia.
russian: Я рада, что ты решила навестить мой домик, Серидия.
bulgarian: I'm glad you visit me at my cottage, Seridia.

english: He... he is?
french: Vrai... vraiment ?
russian: Он... Разве?
bulgarian: He... he is?

english: Oh yes. His puns are a most exquisite torture.
french: Tout à fait. Ses jeux de mots sont comme une forme de torture exquise.
russian: О да! Его каламбуры — это крайне изысканная пытка.
bulgarian: Oh yes. His puns are a most exquisite torture.

english: I should like to learn from him one day.
french: J'aimerais beaucoup qu'il m'enseigne sa technique, un jour.
russian: Когда-нибудь мне надо будет у него поучиться.
bulgarian: I should like to learn from him one day.

english: Your father is quite an evil man, Celine.
french: Votre père est un homme maléfique, Céline.
russian: Твой отец крайне зловредный человек, Селин.
bulgarian: Your father is quite an evil man, Celine.

english: Sometimes when we chat, you get this far away look in your eyes.
french: Parfois, quand nous discutons, votre regard semble très lointain.
russian: Иногда, когда мы общаемся, я замечаю, что твой взгляд обращён куда-то вдаль.
bulgarian: Sometimes when we chat, you get this far away look in your eyes.

english: Like you're looking at me, but seeing something else entirely.
french: C'est comme si vous étiez en train de me fixer, mais en voyant quelque chose de tout à fait différent.
russian: Как будто ты смотришь на меня, а видишь что-то совершенно иное.
bulgarian: Like you're looking at me, but seeing something else entirely.

english: Do I?
french: Ah oui ?
russian: Правда?
bulgarian: Do I?

english: Pay it no mind, Celine.
french: N'y prêtez pas attention, Céline.
russian: Не обращай внимания, Селин.
bulgarian: Pay it no mind, Celine.

english: You know, Seridia...
french: Vous savez, Seridia...
russian: Знаешь, Серидия...
bulgarian: You know, Seridia...

english: To grow flowers! So I can share them with the people I love!
french: Pour faire pousser des fleurs et les partager avec ceux que j'aime !
russian: Чтобы выращивать цветы! И делиться ими с любимыми людьми!
bulgarian: To grow flowers! So I can share them with the people I love!

english: Ugh!
french: Argh !
russian: Фу!
bulgarian: Ugh!

english: What a waste...
french: Quel gâchis...
russian: Как бесполезно...
bulgarian: What a waste...

english: You have imbued much power into this little plot of land, Celine. To what end?
french: Vous avez insufflé un pouvoir considérable à ce petit bout de terrain, Céline. Dans quel but ?
russian: Ты вложила в этот небольшой участок земли много своей силы, Селин. С какой целью?
bulgarian: You have imbued much power into this little plot of land, Celine. To what end?

english: Like, unbelievably old?
french: Vous êtes donc extrêmement âgée, c'est ça ?
russian: Прямо невероятно старая?
bulgarian: Like, unbelievably old?

english: Excuse me?
french: Je vous demande pardon ?
russian: Прошу прощения?
bulgarian: Excuse me?

english: I've been studying archaic flora in the Codex Mistria, so I've been wondering if maybe you've seen any of them firsthand!
french: J'étudie la flore de l'ancien temps grâce au Codex Mistria, alors je me disais que vous aviez peut-être vu certains de ces spécimens de vos propres yeux !
russian: Я изучала архаичную флору в «Кодексе Мистрии» и подумала, вдруг ты видела что-нибудь лично!
bulgarian: I've been studying archaic flora in the Codex Mistria, so I've been wondering if maybe you've seen any of them firsthand!

english: Can you think of any flowers from back then that are extinct now?
french: Y a-t-il des fleurs de l'époque qui ont maintenant disparu ?
russian: Можешь вспомнить какие-нибудь цветы, которые сейчас уже вымерли?
bulgarian: Can you think of any flowers from back then that are extinct now?

english: I am about to make YOU extinct, gardener.
french: J'en connais une qui va disparaître, de jolie fleur.
russian: Сейчас ТЫ у меня вымрешь, садовница.
bulgarian: I am about to make YOU extinct, gardener.

english: Haha, you're so funny!
french: Ha ha, vous êtes si drôle !
russian: Ха-ха, это так смешно!
bulgarian: Haha, you're so funny!

english: Hold on, let me get my notebook ready! I don't want to miss any details.
french: Une seconde, je vais chercher mon carnet, je ne veux rater aucun détail.
russian: Погоди минутку, я достану блокнот! Хочу записать все подробности.
bulgarian: Hold on, let me get my notebook ready! I don't want to miss any details.

english: Seridia, you're really really ancient, right?
french: Seridia, vous venez d'une époque très lointaine, non ?
russian: Серидия, ты же очень-очень древняя, правда?
bulgarian: Seridia, you're really really ancient, right?

english: Do you want to try planting something, Seridia?
french: Ça vous dirait de planter quelque chose, Seridia ?
russian: Хочешь сама попробовать что-нибудь посадить, Серидия?
bulgarian: Do you want to try planting something, Seridia?

english: Do not be ridiculous. I am not the nurturing type.
french: Ne soyez pas ridicule. Il n'est pas dans ma nature de prendre soin de quelque chose.
russian: Не смеши меня. Выращивание противно моей природе.
bulgarian: Do not be ridiculous. I am not the nurturing type.

english: Oh. So you're here because you want to be friends?
french: Oh. Alors si vous êtes là, c'est parce que vous voulez qu'on soit amies ?
russian: А. Значит, ты пришла, чтобы подружиться?
bulgarian: Oh. So you're here because you want to be friends?

english: I am here because watching one of your bloodline scrabble in the dirt amuses me.
french: Je suis là parce que voir les gens de votre espèce se débattre dans la boue m'amuse beaucoup.
russian: Я пришла потому, что мне нравится смотреть, как твой род копается в грязи.
bulgarian: I am here because watching one of your bloodline scrabble in the dirt amuses me.

english: So you ARE lonely...
french: Donc vous êtes TRÈS seule, c'est ce que je disais...
russian: Так ты в самом деле одинока...
bulgarian: So you ARE lonely...

english: Stop that.
french: Il suffit.
russian: Прекрати.
bulgarian: Stop that.

english: You're always coming by and watching me work in the garden.
french: Vous venez toujours me regarder travailler au jardin.
russian: Ты часто приходишь посмотреть, как я работаю в саду.
bulgarian: You're always coming by and watching me work in the garden.

english: I think we've misplaced it. I'm sorry!
french: Je crois qu'elle a été égarée. Je suis désolée !
russian: Кажется, я его потеряла. Прости, пожалуйста!
bulgarian: I think we've misplaced it. I'm sorry!

english: Hm? Oh, no. I simply teleported it directly to my lair when I saw it was ready.
french: Hm ? Oh, non. Je l'ai simplement téléportée directement vers mon antre lorsque j'ai vu qu'elle était prête.
russian: Хм? А, нет. Я лишь телепортировала его прямо в своё логово, когда заметила, что он готов.
bulgarian: Hm? Oh, no. I simply teleported it directly to my lair when I saw it was ready.

english: Oh! Oh.
french: Oh ! Oh.
russian: Ой! А.
bulgarian: Oh! Oh.

english: So that's... alright then.
french: Donc... tout va bien.
russian: Так значит... Всё хорошо.
bulgarian: So that's... alright then.

english: Seridia, about your last order from the General Store...
french: Seridia, je voulais vous parler de votre dernière commande au magasin général.
russian: Серидия, насчёт твоего последнего заказа в универмаге...
bulgarian: Seridia, about your last order from the General Store...

english: So be thankful that I have chosen to take this form instead.
french: Vous devriez me remercier d'apparaître sous cette forme.
russian: Так что будь благодарна, что я выбрала это обличье.
bulgarian: So be thankful that I have chosen to take this form instead.

english: Th... thank you?
french: M... Merci ?
russian: С-спасибо?
bulgarian: Th... thank you?

english: Are you going to buy anything?
french: Vous comptez acheter quelque chose ?
russian: Ты будешь что-нибудь покупать?
bulgarian: Are you going to buy anything?

english: In my draconic state, the contents of this General Store would scarcely be a morning meal.
french: Sous ma forme de dragon, l'ensemble des marchandises de cette boutique n'aurait constitué qu'un maigre petit-déjeuner.
russian: Будь я в драконьем обличье, товаров в этом универмаге едва хватило бы мне на завтрак!
bulgarian: In my draconic state, the contents of this General Store would scarcely be a morning meal.

english: Oh my gosh, I never even thought about it! What would I do?
french: Oh, ça ne m'avait jamais effleuré l'esprit ! Comment je ferais si ça devait arriver ?
russian: Божечки, я и не задумывалась об этом! Как бы я жила?
bulgarian: Oh my gosh, I never even thought about it! What would I do?

english: Well, you'd just come and see me, of course.
french: Eh bien, tu viendrais me voir, pour commencer.
russian: Ну, для начала, ты бы просто пришла ко мне.
bulgarian: Well, you'd just come and see me, of course.

english: You know Celine, you're lucky you don't have allergies.
french: Tu as de la chance de ne pas souffrir d'allergies, Céline.
russian: Значешь, Селин, тебе повезло, что у тебя нет аллергии.
bulgarian: You know Celine, you're lucky you don't have allergies.

english: The Codex Mistria does cover water flora, but I don't see anything familiar in this chapter.
french: Le Codex Mistria aborde bien la flore aquatique, mais je ne me souviens pas avoir lu quoi que ce soit à ce sujet.
russian: В «Кодексе Мистрии» есть раздел про водные растения, но я совсем не могу их узнать.
bulgarian: The Codex Mistria does cover water flora, but I don't see anything familiar in this chapter.

english: Oh, but these do have structures similar to contemporary plants! Perhaps they're related?
french: Oh, mais celles-ci ont des traits communs avec les plantes contemporaines ! Elles sont peut-être apparentées ?
russian: О, вот это по строению напоминает современные растения! Может, они родственные?
bulgarian: Oh, but these do have structures similar to contemporary plants! Perhaps they're related?

english: Does your big book there have anything to say about the medicinal properties of aquatic plants?
french: Est-ce que ta grosse encyclopédie contient des informations sur les vertus médicinales des plantes aquatiques ?
russian: В твоей большой книге что-нибудь написано про лечебные свойства водных растений?
bulgarian: Does your big book there have anything to say about the medicinal properties of aquatic plants?

english: =Nettle= has a long history of being used to treat muscle and joint pain, as well as problems of the skin.
french: Les =orties= servent depuis longtemps à soulager les douleurs musculaires et l'arthrose, et à traiter les problèmes de peau.
russian: На протяжении многих веков =крапиву= использовали при болях в мышцах и суставах, а также при проблемной коже.
bulgarian: =Nettle= has a long history of being used to treat muscle and joint pain, as well as problems of the skin.

english: The Deep Woods have been blocked since the earthquake. Looks like I'll have to keep importing it from the Capital for now!
french: Mais comme Boissombre est inaccessible depuis le tremblement de terre, je vais devoir m'en faire livrer de la capitale !
russian: После землетрясения в Глубокую чащу не пройти. Видимо, пока мне придётся заказывать её из столицы!
bulgarian: The Deep Woods have been blocked since the earthquake. Looks like I'll have to keep importing it from the Capital for now!

english: Nettle grows everywhere in Mistria, but you're most likely to find them in the Deep Woods, Valen. Why do you ask?
french: Les orties poussent partout à Mistria, mais on en trouve surtout à Boissombre. Pourquoi veux-tu savoir ça, Valen ?
russian: Крапива в Мистрии растёт везде, но больше всего — в Глубокой чаще. А почему ты спрашиваешь, Вален?
bulgarian: Nettle grows everywhere in Mistria, but you're most likely to find them in the Deep Woods, Valen. Why do you ask?

english: Oh, I'm glad you like it! You're always welcome to join me, Valen.
french: Je suis contente que l'endroit te plaise ! N'hésite pas à m'accompagner, Valen.
russian: Рада, что тебе нравится! Ты всегда можешь посидеть тут со мной, Вален!
bulgarian: Oh, I'm glad you like it! You're always welcome to join me, Valen.

english: What a lovely place for reading. The scents of the garden really clear the mind, too.
french: C'est l'endroit idéal pour lire ici. Et les parfums des plantes permettent de vraiment se vider l'esprit.
russian: Замечательное место для чтения! И запах садовых цветов так помогает развеяться.
bulgarian: What a lovely place for reading. The scents of the garden really clear the mind, too.

english: A princess who's also a master swordsman!
french: Oui, une histoire de princesse avec son maître d'armes !
russian: Про принцессу — мастера меча!
bulgarian: A princess who's also a master swordsman!

english: With a praying mantis familiar!
french: Et qui a une mante religieuse comme animal de compagnie !
russian: С фамильяром-богомолом!
bulgarian: With a praying mantis familiar!

english: My, my! Such imaginations! Are you sure you don't want to tell me a story instead?
french: Eh bien, vous en avez de l'imagination ! Vous ne voulez pas plutôt me raconter une histoire, tous les trois ?
russian: Ну и ну! Вот это вы навыдумывали! Может, лучше тогда вы расскажете мне историю?
bulgarian: My, my! Such imaginations! Are you sure you don't want to tell me a story instead?

english: I want to hear a story about a princess!
french: Je veux une histoire de princesse !
russian: Я хочу послушать историю про принцессу!
bulgarian: I want to hear a story about a princess!

english: Is that a queen? She has a crown!
french: C'est une reine, là ? Elle porte une couronne !
russian: Это королева? У неё на голове корона!
bulgarian: Is that a queen? She has a crown!

english: What's this language? It looks like branches!
french: C'est en quelle langue ? On dirait des branches !
russian: Что за странный язык? Выглядит, как веточки!
bulgarian: What's this language? It looks like branches!

english: Is that a dragon? So cool!
french: Et ça, c'est un dragon ? C'est génial !
russian: Это что, дракон? Круто!
bulgarian: Is that a dragon? So cool!

english: Wow! Is it blowing fire all over the place?
french: Waouh ! Il crache du feu partout ?
russian: Ух ты! Он что, выдыхает огонь во все стороны?
bulgarian: Wow! Is it blowing fire all over the place?

english: Olric, aren't you supposed to be giving this tour with me?
french: Olric, je te rappelle que tu es censé commenter la visite avec moi !
russian: Ольрик, ты вроде бы проводишь экскурсию вместе со мной.
bulgarian: Olric, aren't you supposed to be giving this tour with me?

english: And these are the remains of an ancient pot, depicting events from a past age!
french: Et voici les fragments d'un ancien récipient sur lequel sont gravés des récits du passé !
russian: А вот останки древнего кувшина с изображением исторических событий.
bulgarian: And these are the remains of an ancient pot, depicting events from a past age!

english: The Queen seeks a royal steed. Show us your finest riding animals!
french: La reine veut acquérir une monture royale. Montrez-nous vos plus beaux spécimens !
russian: Её величеству требуется королевский скакун. Покажите нам ваших лучших скакунов!
bulgarian: The Queen seeks a royal steed. Show us your finest riding animals!

english: Oh! Well actually, I think they're all fine animals. I don't think I could play favorites.
french: Oh ! Ben, tous mes animaux sont magnifiques. Je ne crois pas pouvoir en choisir un plutôt qu'un autre.
russian: Ого! Вообще-то, они все у меня самые лучшие. Боюсь, я не смогу помочь с выбором.
bulgarian: Oh! Well actually, I think they're all fine animals. I don't think I could play favorites.

english: Your politicking is most clever, Mister Hayden. Queen Maple is pleased to have such cunning subjects.
french: Vous êtes dur en affaires, monsieur Hayden. La reine Maple est heureuse de pouvoir compter sur des sujets aussi rusés.
russian: Весьма ловкая уклончивость, мистер Хейден. Королева Мэйпл одобряет столь изворотливых подданных.
bulgarian: Your politicking is most clever, Mister Hayden. Queen Maple is pleased to have such cunning subjects.

english: Make way, make way! I'm the captain of Queen Maple's royal guard! Her Majesty is here to inspect your farm, Mister Hayden.
french: Poussez-vous ! Je suis la capitaine de la garde royale ! La reine Maple vient inspecter votre ferme, monsieur Hayden.
russian: Дорогу, дорогу! Я капитан стражи королевы Мэйпл! Её величество прибыло на вашу ферму с инспекцией, мистер Хейден.
bulgarian: Make way, make way! I'm the captain of Queen Maple's royal guard! Her Majesty is here to inspect your farm, Mister Hayden.

english: This one's so round! And look, the symmetry...
french: Celle-là est parfaitement ronde ! Et symétrique...
russian: А эта такая круглая! И такая симметричная...
bulgarian: This one's so round! And look, the symmetry...

english: And this pumpkin's so orange! Mister Hayden, how'd you get them so big and round and orange?
french: Et celle-ci est hyper orange ! Monsieur Hayden, vous faites comment pour que vos citrouilles soient aussi grosses, rondes et orange ?
russian: А эта такая рыжая! Мистер Хейден, как вам удаётся выращивать такие большие круглые рыжие тыквы?
bulgarian: And this pumpkin's so orange! Mister Hayden, how'd you get them so big and round and orange?

english: Well now, that's a farmer's secret!
french: Ah ça, c'est mon secret de fermier !
russian: Ну-ну, это мой фермерский секрет!
bulgarian: Well now, that's a farmer's secret!

english: Look at this pumpkin! It's so big!
french: Regardez cette citrouille ! Elle est géante !
russian: Смотрите, какая тыква! Просто огромная!
bulgarian: Look at this pumpkin! It's so big!

english: I dub this pumpkin... Lucretia!
french: Et moi, je nomme celle-ci... Lucrèce !
russian: Я нарекаю эту тыкву... Лукреция!
bulgarian: I dub this pumpkin... Lucretia!

english: Behold... Gary!
french: Moi, je vous présente... Gary !
russian: Узрите... Гарри!
bulgarian: Behold... Gary!

english: Who wants to bake their new friends into a pie?
french: Vous avez envie de faire une tarte avec vos nouvelles copines ?
russian: Ну-ка, кто хочет испечь пирог из своих новых друзей?
bulgarian: Who wants to bake their new friends into a pie?

english: Yaaaay!
french: Ouaiiis !
russian: Дааа!
bulgarian: Yaaaay!

english: I'm naming this pumpkin Mortimer.
french: Je vais appeler cette citrouille Mortimer.
russian: Я назову эту тыкву Мортимер.
bulgarian: I'm naming this pumpkin Mortimer.

english: This one looks just like Mister Landen.
french: Et celle-ci me fait penser à monsieur Landen.
russian: А эта выглядит, как мистер Ланден.
bulgarian: This one looks just like Mister Landen.

english: This one looks like you, Mister Hayden!
french: Celle-ci, on dirait que c'est vous, monsieur Hayden !
russian: А эта похожа на вас, мистер Хейден.
bulgarian: This one looks like you, Mister Hayden!

english: So it does! Nature's got a funny sense of humor, don't she?
french: C'est vrai ! La nature a le sens de l'humour, hein, les enfants ?
russian: И правда! У природы местами странное чувство юмора.
bulgarian: So it does! Nature's got a funny sense of humor, don't she?

english: GYA HA HA!
french: GAH HA HA !
russian: ГА-ХА-ХА!
bulgarian: GYA HA HA!

english: That pumpkin looks kind of like Mister Errol, it's so shiny!
french: Cette citrouille ressemble un peu à monsieur Errol !
russian: Эта тыква похожа на мистера Эррола, она вся блестит!
bulgarian: That pumpkin looks kind of like Mister Errol, it's so shiny!

english: Bradley's really good at hiding, though. We've been searching forever!
french: Mais Bradley s'est trop bien caché. Ça fait des heures qu'on le cherche !
russian: Но Брэдли очень хорошо прячется. Мы всё никак не можем его найти.
bulgarian: Bradley's really good at hiding, though. We've been searching forever!

english: Bradley is a Winterpillar...
french: Bradley est une chenille de givre...
russian: Брэдли — это же морозная гусеница...
bulgarian: Bradley is a Winterpillar...

english: We're going to find you, Bradley!
french: On va te trouver, Bradley !
russian: Мы найдём тебя, Брэдли!
bulgarian: We're going to find you, Bradley!

english: Unless you've already undergone metamorphosis... a scenario I had not considered!
french: À moins que tu ne te sois déjà métamorphosé... Mince, je n'avais pas pensé à ça !
russian: Если только ты не превратился в бабочку... О таком развитии событий я не подумал.
bulgarian: Unless you've already undergone metamorphosis... a scenario I had not considered!

english: We're playing hide and seek with Luc's friend, Bradley!
french: On joue à cache-cache avec Bradley, le copain de Luc !
russian: Мы играем в прятки с Брэдли, приятелем Люка.
bulgarian: We're playing hide and seek with Luc's friend, Bradley!

english: So let us know if you see anything suspicious.
french: Dis-nous si tu vois quelque chose d'anormal.
russian: Так что сообщи, если увидишь что-то подозрительное.
bulgarian: So let us know if you see anything suspicious.

english: Or if you see anything fun, like a really big pile of snow.
french: Ou quelque chose d'amusant... comme un gros tas de neige.
russian: Или что-то забавное, или просто большущий сугроб.
bulgarian: Or if you see anything fun, like a really big pile of snow.

english: Definitely let them know if you see something fun.
french: Oui, préviens-les si tu vois quelque chose d'amusant.
russian: Если найдёшь что-то забавное, обязательно им сообщи.
bulgarian: Definitely let them know if you see something fun.

english: Hi, [Ari]! The Dragonguard is on winter patrol!
french: Salut, [Ari] ! La Garde des dragons fait sa ronde hivernale !
russian: Привет, [Ari]! У Драконьей стражи сейчас зимний патруль.
bulgarian: Hi, [Ari]! The Dragonguard is on winter patrol!

english: I know that's not the real ending, but I like your endings better, Dad!
french: Je sais que c'est pas la vraie fin, mais je préfère la tienne, papa !
russian: Я знаю, что сказка заканчивается по-другому, но твой финал мне больше нравится, папа!
bulgarian: I know that's not the real ending, but I like your endings better, Dad!

english: And so, the knight and the dragon and the princess all became friends and lived happily ever after. The end!
french: Et c'est ainsi que le chevalier, le dragon et la princesse devinrent tous amis et vécurent heureux jusqu'à la fin des temps. Et voilà, c'est fini !
russian: И так рыцарь, дракон и принцесса подружились и жили вместе долго и счастливо. Конец!
bulgarian: And so, the knight and the dragon and the princess all became friends and lived happily ever after. The end!

english: I will not...
french: Il est interdit...
russian: Я не буду...
bulgarian: I will not...

english: Drink out of the Bathhouse cauldron...
french: De boire le contenu du chaudron...
russian: Пить из котла в купальне...
bulgarian: Drink out of the Bathhouse cauldron...

english: Unless it's an emergency!
french: Sauf en cas d'urgence !
russian: Если это не экстренная ситуация!
bulgarian: Unless it's an emergency!

english: Very good.
french: Très bien.
russian: Отлично.
bulgarian: Very good.

english: Wait a minute...
french: Euh, attends un peu...
russian: Погодите, что?
bulgarian: Wait a minute...

english: Repeat after me, children. "I will not drink out of the Bathhouse cauldron."
french: Répétez après moi, les enfants : « Il est interdit de boire le contenu du chaudron. »
russian: Повторяйте за мной, дети: «Я не буду пить из котла в купальне».
bulgarian: Repeat after me, children. "I will not drink out of the Bathhouse cauldron."

english: Lots of stuff!
french: Plein de choses !
russian: Да много в какой!
bulgarian: Lots of stuff!

english: Such as?
french: Comme ?
russian: Например?
bulgarian: Such as?

english: Well... what if I need powers?
french: Eh bien... Imaginons que j'ai besoin de pouvoirs ?
russian: Ну... Может, мне нужны волшебные силы?
bulgarian: Well... what if I need powers?

english: Like what? The power of bad breath?
french: Lequel ? Celui de l'haleine fétide ?
russian: Это какие? Сила вонючего дыхания?
bulgarian: Like what? The power of bad breath?

english: What emergency could possibly warrant drinking out of the cauldron, Dell?
french: Quel genre d'urgence justifierait que tu boives le contenu du chaudron, Dell ?
russian: В какой экстренной ситуации может быть необходимость пить из котла, Делл?
bulgarian: What emergency could possibly warrant drinking out of the cauldron, Dell?

english: But I'm helping!
french: Mais je suis en train de vous aider !
russian: Но я же помогаю!
bulgarian: But I'm helping!

english: She's helping, Miss Juniper.
french: Elle vous aide, mademoiselle Juniper.
russian: Она помогает, мисс Джунипер.
bulgarian: She's helping, Miss Juniper.

english: She's sooo helpful!

bulgarian: But your bubbling cauldron is so toasty, Miss Juniper!

english: It's the perfect temperature for warming up after our snow patrol!

russian: Идеальной температуры, чтобы согреться после зимнего патруля.

french: Ça permet de mieux voir dans le noir.
russian: Оно помогает видеть в темноте. Это правда.
bulgarian: It will help me see in the dark. Superiorly.

english: Why does it smell like that?

russian: А почему оно так пахнет?

russian: Это сера.
bulgarian: That's the sulfur.

english: And are you going to DRINK it?
french: Vous allez boire ça ?
russian: И вы что, будете его пить?!
bulgarian: And are you going to DRINK it?

english: No.
french: Non.
russian: Нет.
bulgarian: No.

english: Can *I* drink it?
french: Moi, je peux ?
russian: А можно МНЕ его выпить?
bulgarian: Can *I* drink it?

english: Tempting, but your mother would absolutely kill me.

russian: Заманчивое предложение, но твоя мать меня точно убьёт.

english: What are you doing Miss Juniper?
french: Vous faites quoi, mademoiselle Juniper ?
russian: Что вы делаете, мисс Джунипер?
bulgarian: What are you doing Miss Juniper?

french: Bien dit, Luc. Maintenant, Garde des dragons... on se réchauffe !
russian: Отличная работа, Люк. А теперь, Драконья стража... Всем греться!
bulgarian: Good work, Luc. Now, Dragonguard... get yourselves warmed up!

english: There's no need to commandeer my belongings, children. I'm not going to stop you from thawing yourselves out.
french: Inutile de réquisitionner mon chaudron, les enfants. Je ne vais pas vous empêcher de vous réchauffer.

russian: Нет уж, простите, этот котёл теперь — наше имущество.
bulgarian: Sorry, this cauldron is definitely ours now.

english: In the name of the Dragonguard, we're commandeering this cauldron!
french: Au nom de la Garde des dragons, nous réquisitionnons ce chaudron !
russian: Именем Драконьей стражи, мы реквизируем этот котёл!
bulgarian: In the name of the Dragonguard, we're commandeering this cauldron!

french: Elles sont très jolies !
russian: Выглядят красиво!
bulgarian: They look pretty!

english: I bet it's because they look cool!
french: Je suis sûre que c'est parce que ça donne du style !
russian: Наверняка дело в том, что это круто!
bulgarian: I bet it's because they look cool!

russian: Дети, не докучайте леди Серидии...
bulgarian: Children, don't bother Lady Seridia...

bulgarian: Ah, but the child is correct. It is because they look... cool.

russian: Мисс Серидия, мне стало любопытно... В чём эволюционное преимущество красных когтей?
bulgarian: Miss Seridia, I've been wondering... what's the evolutionary advantage for having red claws?

russian: Можно сделать каждого драконом, или мы все можем собираться в одного большого дракона!
bulgarian: We could each be a dragon, or we could combine into one big dragon!

english: Only if Miss Seridia approves, of course!

english: Oh, I approve.

russian: О, я согласна.
bulgarian: Oh, I approve.

russian: У меня нет зелья драконьей формы, но зато... Дети, вы любите лошадей?
bulgarian: I don't have a dragon potion, but tell me... how do you feel about horses?

french: Mademoiselle Juniper, vous pourriez nous faire une potion pour transformer les membres de la Garde des dragons en vrais dragons ?
russian: Мисс Джунипер, вы можете сделать зелье, чтобы превратить Драконью стражу в настоящих драконов?
bulgarian: Miss Juniper, can you make a potion to turn the Dragonguard into real dragons?

russian: Моя послушница... это правда?
bulgarian: My disciple... is this true?

english: NO... certainly not...
french: NON ! Absolument pas...
russian: НЕТ... Конечно же нет...
bulgarian: NO... certainly not...

bulgarian: So yes!

english: This is so tasty! Your sister is really good at food, guys! Can she be the Dragonguard's official chef?
french: Miam, c'est trop bon ! Votre sœur cuisine vraiment trop bien, les copains ! Est-ce qu'on pourrait la nommer cuisinière officielle de la Garde des dragons ?
russian: Как вкусно! Твоя сестра отлично готовит! Ребята, может, назначим её официальным поваром Драконьей стражи?
bulgarian: This is so tasty! Your sister is really good at food, guys! Can she be the Dragonguard's official chef?

english: What about all kinds of pancakes? Maybe that's the same!
french: Et plein de pancakes, ça marche aussi ?
russian: Может, подойдут просто разные виды блинов? Вдруг тоже сработает!
bulgarian: What about all kinds of pancakes? Maybe that's the same!

english: Come on Luc, let's run a pancake experiment! For science!
french: Allez, Luc, faisons l'expérience avec les pancakes ! Au nom de la science !
russian: Давай проведём блинный эксперимент, Люк! Ради науки!
bulgarian: Come on Luc, let's run a pancake experiment! For science!

english: Dell, you have to eat all kinds of foods if you want to grow up big and strong. It's been proven. By science.
french: Dell, tu dois manger de tout si tu veux devenir grande et forte. Ça a été prouvé. Scientifiquement.
russian: Делл, чтобы вырасти большой и сильной, надо есть разнообразную еду. Это доказано наукой.
bulgarian: Dell, you have to eat all kinds of foods if you want to grow up big and strong. It's been proven. By science.

english: Last time they all got loose in the Inn and Mom and Dad had us chasing frogs in the kitchen until bedtime.
french: La dernière fois, elles se sont échappées dans l'auberge. Papa et maman nous ont obligés à les chercher dans la cuisine jusqu'à l'heure du coucher.
russian: В прошлый раз они разбежались по трактиру, и мама с папой заставили нас до ночи гоняться за лягушками.
bulgarian: Last time they all got loose in the Inn and Mom and Dad had us chasing frogs in the kitchen until bedtime.

english: But what's the point of pockets if they don't have frogs in them?
french: Ça sert à quoi, des poches, si ce n'est pas pour mettre des grenouilles dedans ?
russian: Зачем тогда вообще карманы, если в них нельзя класть лягушек?
bulgarian: But what's the point of pockets if they don't have frogs in them?

english: [Ari], please tell Dell she's not allowed to put more frogs in her pockets.
french: [Ari], tu peux dire à Dell qu'elle n'a plus le droit de mettre des grenouilles dans ses poches.
russian: [Ari], скажи Делл, пожалуйста, что ей нельзя больше складывать лягушек в карманы.
bulgarian: [Ari], please tell Dell she's not allowed to put more frogs in her pockets.

english: Grown-ups are so unreasonable.
french: Les adultes ne sont vraiment pas logiques.
russian: Взрослые ведут себя совершенно нелогично.
bulgarian: Grown-ups are so unreasonable.

english: Seriously! Pumpkin is a vegetable!
french: C'est vrai, la citrouille est un légume !
russian: Действительно! Ведь тыква — это овощ!
bulgarian: Seriously! Pumpkin is a vegetable!

english: I don't see why we can't have pumpkin pie for dinner.
french: Je vois pas pourquoi on ne pourrait pas manger que de la tarte à la citrouille pour le dîner.
russian: Не понимаю, почему нельзя пообедать тыквенным пирогом.
bulgarian: I don't see why we can't have pumpkin pie for dinner.

english: We can't only defend Mistria when it's nice out... what kind of protectors would we be!
french: Si nous ne défendions Mistria que quand il fait beau... quel genre de gardes serions-nous ?
russian: Мы же не можем охранять Мистрию только в хорошую погоду... Это были бы никудышные защитники!
bulgarian: We can't only defend Mistria when it's nice out... what kind of protectors would we be!

english: Dry protectors, for one.
french: Des gardes au sec, au moins...
russian: Зато сухие защитники.
bulgarian: Dry protectors, for one.

english: The Dragonguard gathers, rain or shine! Duty is very important to an aspiring royal.
french: Pluie, vent ou grand beau temps, la Garde des dragons se rassemble ! Une future reine a conscience de son devoir.
russian: Драконья стража собирается всегда: и в дождь и в солнце! Для правителей важно поддерживать чувство долга.
bulgarian: The Dragonguard gathers, rain or shine! Duty is very important to an aspiring royal.

english: You've got to help us, [Ari]!
french: Tu dois nous aider, [Ari] !
russian:
[Ari], ты

должны

должнадолжендолжно нам помочь!
bulgarian: You've got to help us, [Ari]!

english: Give us your best Dragon Smash!
french: Utilise ta plus belle Frappe draconique !
russian: Покажи нам свой лучший «Удар дракона»!
bulgarian: Give us your best Dragon Smash!

english: This rain must be the work of an evil wizard!
french: Cette pluie doit être l'œuvre d'un sorcier maléfique !
russian: Этот дождь — явно дело рук злого волшебника!
bulgarian: This rain must be the work of an evil wizard!

english: LIKE FROGS!
french: COMME LES GRENOUILLES !
russian: НАПРИМЕР, ЛЯГУШКИ!
bulgarian: LIKE FROGS!

english: Frogs aren't bugs, Dell...
french: Ce n'est pas des insectes, Dell...
russian: Лягушки не жуки, Делл...
bulgarian: Frogs aren't bugs, Dell...

english: A lot of fascinating insects come out during the rain, [Ari].
french: De nombreux insectes fascinants sortent quand il pleut, [Ari].
russian: [Ari], в дождь вылезает множество удивительных насекомых.
bulgarian: A lot of fascinating insects come out during the rain, [Ari].

english: Operation Snow Guy is proceeding very nicely.
french: L'Opération Bonhomme de neige se déroule à merveille.
russian: Операция «Снеговик» проходит без препятствий.
bulgarian: Operation Snow Guy is proceeding very nicely.

english: He's so cute!
french: Il est trognon !
russian: Он такой красивый!
bulgarian: He's so cute!

english: Well, what do you think, Head Scientist Luc? Has the Dragonguard done a good job?
french: Alors, chef des savants Luc, ton avis ? La Garde des dragons fait-elle du bon travail ?
russian: Каково ваше мнение, учёный советник Люк? Оцените работу Драконьей стражи.
bulgarian: Well, what do you think, Head Scientist Luc? Has the Dragonguard done a good job?

english: You heard her! More snow, Luc!
french: Tu as entendu Dell ? Il faut plus de neige, Luc !
russian: Слышал, Люк? Нужно больше снега!
bulgarian: You heard her! More snow, Luc!

english: Yay!
french: Entendu !
russian: Ура!
bulgarian: Yay!

english: More snow! More snow!
french: Il faut plus de neige ! Encore plus !
russian: Больше снега! Ещё снега!
bulgarian: More snow! More snow!

english: I don't see why not! We'll just need some iron.
french: Je n'y vois aucun inconvénient ! Mais tu vas avoir besoin de métal.
russian: Почему бы и нет! Только надо немного железа.
bulgarian: I don't see why not! We'll just need some iron.

english: There's lot of iron stuff at the kitchen at the Inn! Let's go borrow some!
french: Il y a plein de trucs en métal dans la cuisine de l'auberge ! On n'a qu'à se servir !
russian: На кухне в трактире куча железных вещей. Давайте одолжим!
bulgarian: There's lot of iron stuff at the kitchen at the Inn! Let's go borrow some!

english: This seems like a bad idea...
french: Euh, je ne crois pas que ce soit une bonne idée...
russian: Звучит как плохая идея...
bulgarian: This seems like a bad idea...

english: My sister needs that stuff for making snacks and stuff! Sorry Dell.
french: Notre sœur en a besoin pour faire la cuisine ! Désolé, Dell.
russian: Моей сестре это всё нужно, чтобы делать всякие вкусности. Прости, Делл!
bulgarian: My sister needs that stuff for making snacks and stuff! Sorry Dell.

english: Mister Olric, can I use the forge? I want to make the coolest sword in all of Mistria.
french: Monsieur Olric, est-ce que je peux me servir de la forge ? Je veux fabriquer la plus belle épée de tout Mistria.
russian: Мистер Ольрик, можно мне воспользоваться кузницей? Я хочу сделать крутейший меч в Мистрии.
bulgarian: Mister Olric, can I use the forge? I want to make the coolest sword in all of Mistria.

english: Do I get to use a sword?
french: Avec une épée ?
russian: А мне дадут меч?
bulgarian: Do I get to use a sword?

english: Swords are not for the kitchen, Dell!
french: Dell, on n'a pas d'épée en cuisine, Dell !
russian: Никто не работает на кухне мечом, Делл!
bulgarian: Swords are not for the kitchen, Dell!

english: Unless you open your own restaurant! Dell's Sword and Grill...
french: À moins que tu n'ouvres ton propre restaurant ! « La fourchette et l'épée »...
russian: Если, конечно, это не твой ресторан! «Меч и Гриль от Делл».
bulgarian: Unless you open your own restaurant! Dell's Sword and Grill...

english: Okay, so we're learning to cook this morning! Who wants to cut the veggies?
french: Alors, ce matin, nous allons apprendre à cuisiner ! Qui veut couper les légumes ?
russian: Так, этим утром мы учимся готовить! Кто хочет порубить овощи?
bulgarian: Okay, so we're learning to cook this morning! Who wants to cut the veggies?

english: How much is a pinch? This much?
french: Ça fait combien une pincée ? Autant ?
russian: А щепотка — это сколько? Вот столько?
bulgarian: How much is a pinch? This much?

english: It's this much!
french: Ça fait ça !
russian: Вот столько!
bulgarian: It's this much!

english: No, no, it's this much!
french: Non, c'est beaucoup trop !
russian: Нет-нет, вот столько!
bulgarian: No, no, it's this much!

english: Oh dear... Now let me show you how to balance out too much salt.
french: Ouh là... Je vais vous montrer comment corriger le tir quand on a mis trop de sel.
russian: Божечки... Теперь давайте покажу, как сбалансировать пересоленное блюдо.
bulgarian: Oh dear... Now let me show you how to balance out too much salt.

english: You're almost done with your cooking lesson, Dragonguard! Now, who wants to add a pinch of salt?
french: Garde des dragons, votre cours de cuisine est bientôt terminé ! Alors, qui veut ajouter une pincée de sel ?
russian: Драконья стража, ваш урок готовки почти закончен! Кто хочет добавить щепотку соли?
bulgarian: You're almost done with your cooking lesson, Dragonguard! Now, who wants to add a pinch of salt?

english: I would like less peas, Miss Reina.
french: Non, sans façon, Reina.
russian: Я бы хотела поменьше гороха, мисс Рейна.
bulgarian: I would like less peas, Miss Reina.

english: Then eat the peas you already have, Dell. Trust me.
french: Dans ce cas, finis les petits pois qui sont dans ton assiette, Dell. Fais-moi confiance.
russian: Тогда съешь горох, который уже есть, Делл. Доверься мне.
bulgarian: Then eat the peas you already have, Dell. Trust me.

english: The more you complain about peas, the more peas you'll get.
french: Plus tu te plaindras des petits pois, plus elle t'en resservira.
russian: Чем больше жалуешься на горох, тем больше у тебя гороха.
bulgarian: The more you complain about peas, the more peas you'll get.

english: You want more peas, Dell?
french: Je te ressers des petits pois, Dell ?
russian: Хочешь побольше гороха, Делл?
bulgarian: You want more peas, Dell?

english: Cough cough... I can't believe I was betrayed... by my own second-in-command... poisoned... to DEATH...
french: (Tousse) Je... je n'arrive pas à croire... que mon propre bras droit ait pu... m'empoisonner... Argh, je meurs...
russian: Кх-кх... Поверить не могу, меня предал... мой ближайший соратник... отравил до СМЕРТИ...
bulgarian: Cough cough... I can't believe I was betrayed... by my own second-in-command... poisoned... to DEATH...

english: You shouldn't have crossed me, Dell... you're too pure of heart. You never stood a chance against Blood Queen Maple's royal poisoner, Luc the Venomous.
french: Jamais tu n'aurais dû me trahir, Dell... Ton cœur est trop pur. Tu n'avais aucune chance face à Luc la fiole, l'empoisonneur en chef de Sa Majesté, Maple la sanglante.
russian: Не стоило стоять у меня на пути, Делл... ты слишком наивна. У тебя не было шансов против кровавой королевы Мэйпл и её придворного отравителя, Ядовитого Люка.
bulgarian: You shouldn't have crossed me, Dell... you're too pure of heart. You never stood a chance against Blood Queen Maple's royal poisoner, Luc the Venomous.

english: And you are too sure of yourself, Blood Queen Maple. The poison I extracted from my beetles, the poison that now courses through Knight Dell's veins...
french: Tu es trop sûre de toi, Maple la sanglante. Le poison que j'ai extrait de mes scarabées et qui coule désormais dans les veines de Dell la chevaleresse...
russian: Вы слишком самоуверенны, кровавая королева Мэйпл. Яд, добытый из моих жуков, который сейчас растекается по венам рыцаря Делл...
bulgarian: And you are too sure of yourself, Blood Queen Maple. The poison I extracted from my beetles, the poison that now courses through Knight Dell's veins...

english: It's the same poison in your tea! Long live the insect kingdom!
french: Est le même que celui que j'ai versé dans ton thé ! Longue vie au royaume des insectes !
russian: Тот же яд был в вашем чае! Да здравствует королевство насекомых!
bulgarian: It's the same poison in your tea! Long live the insect kingdom!

english: Actually, this is pretty different.
french: Bon, nos histoires étaient un peu différentes.
russian: Ладно, вообще-то, у нас было не так.
bulgarian: Actually, this is pretty different.

english: Watching the kids play reminds me of when I used to play make-believe with Celine and Adeline.
french: Quand je regarde les enfants s'amuser, ça me rappelle l'époque où on se faisait des scènes avec Céline et Adeline.
russian: Когда я смотрю, как дети играют, я вспоминаю, как мы играли с Селин и Аделиной.
bulgarian: Watching the kids play reminds me of when I used to play make-believe with Celine and Adeline.

english: And it's SOUR!
french: Et c'est ACIDE !
russian: Он правда КИСЛЫЙ!
bulgarian: And it's SOUR!

english: SUPER SOUR!
french: SUPER ACIDE !
russian: УЖАСНО КИСЛЫЙ!
bulgarian: SUPER SOUR!

english: But is it sour enough?
french: Mais est-ce que c'est assez acide ?
russian: Но достаточно ли кислый?
bulgarian: But is it sour enough?

english: Here you go, [Ari]! I think you'll find it refreshing.
french: Goûte, [Ari] ! Je pense que ça devrait te donner un petit coup de fouet.
russian: Попробуй, [Ari]! Думаю, поможет освежиться.
bulgarian: Here you go, [Ari]! I think you'll find it refreshing.

english: Hey [Ari]! The kids are trying out my new sour lemon cake with a sugar crust.
french: Salut, [Ari] ! Les enfants goûtent mon nouveau cake au citron en croûte de sucre.
russian: Привет, [Ari]! Дети решили попробовать мой кислый лимонный торт с сахарной глазурью.
bulgarian: Hey [Ari]! The kids are trying out my new sour lemon cake with a sugar crust.

english: It's a barstool. Your mom wanted another for the Inn.
french: Un tabouret de bar. Ta maman m'en a commandé un pour l'auberge.
russian: Барный стул. Твоя мама просила ещё один для трактира.
bulgarian: It's a barstool. Your mom wanted another for the Inn.

english: I'll help! I can use a hammer. Or a saw! I'm allowed, because I'm in the Dragonguard.
french: Je vais vous aider ! Je sais utiliser un marteau. Et une scie ! J'ai le droit parce que je fais partie de la Garde des dragons.
russian: Я помогу! Я умею использовать молоток. И пилу! Мне можно, я из Драконьей стражи.
bulgarian: I'll help! I can use a hammer. Or a saw! I'm allowed, because I'm in the Dragonguard.

english: Dell is very not allowed.
french: C'est faux, Dell n'a pas le droit.
russian: Делл совершенно точно нельзя.
bulgarian: Dell is very not allowed.

english: I had a feeling.
french: Je me disais bien aussi...
russian: Я догадывался.
bulgarian: I had a feeling.

english: What're you building, Mister Ryis?
french: Vous construisez quoi, monsieur Ryis ?
russian: Что вы строите, мистер Риз?
bulgarian: What're you building, Mister Ryis?

english: With an ant colony inside!
french: Avec une colonie de fourmis à l'intérieur !
russian: С колонией муравьёв!
bulgarian: With an ant colony inside!

english: The captain's quarters are the biggest room, right? I call dibs!
french: La chambre la plus grande est celle du capitaine, c'est ça ? Prem's !
russian: Каюта капитана самая большая, да ведь? Это мне!
bulgarian: The captain's quarters are the biggest room, right? I call dibs!

english: What if we started with a simpler project first? Like maybe one we can fit in the shop?
french: Et si on commençait par un projet plus simple ? Quelque chose qui tiendrait dans la menuiserie ?!
russian: Давайте для начала попробуем проект попроще. Например, что-то, что уместится в мастерской?
bulgarian: What if we started with a simpler project first? Like maybe one we can fit in the shop?

english: Let's make a pirate ship!
french: Construisons un bateau pirate !
russian: Давайте сделаем пиратский корабль!
bulgarian: Let's make a pirate ship!

english: Protect me?
french: Me protéger ?
russian: Защитит меня?
bulgarian: Protect me?

english: No wonder I like him so much!
french: C'est pour ça que je l'aime bien !
russian: Тогда понятно, почему он мне так нравится!
bulgarian: No wonder I like him so much!

english: Yes, for conservation purposes!
french: Oui, pour sauvegarder votre espèce !
russian: Да, в целях охраны природы!
bulgarian: Yes, for conservation purposes!

english: Conservation...?
french: Sauvegarder... mon espèce ?
russian: Природы?..
bulgarian: Conservation...?

english: I am not an animal.
french: Je ne suis pas un animal.
russian: Я не животное.
bulgarian: I am not an animal.

english: I am a dragon. A higher being!
french: Je suis un dragon. Un être supérieur !
russian: Я дракон. Существо высшего порядка!
bulgarian: I am a dragon. A higher being!

english: But Mister Caldarus says humans and dragons are just like birds and sheep. He says we're all animals that coexist in delicate harmony!
french: Mais monsieur Caldarus dit que les humains et les dragons sont comme les oiseaux et les moutons. Et qu'on est tous des animaux vivant en délicate harmonie !
russian: Но мистер Кальдарус сказал, что люди и драконы — как птицы и овцы. Он говорит, мы все животные, сосуществующие в хрупкой гармонии!
bulgarian: But Mister Caldarus says humans and dragons are just like birds and sheep. He says we're all animals that coexist in delicate harmony!

english: And if an animal is endangered, we should protect it!
french: Et si un animal est en voie d'extinction, on doit le protéger !
russian: А если животное под угрозой, мы обязаны его защищать!
bulgarian: And if an animal is endangered, we should protect it!

english: Mister Caldarus... is an ant.
french: Monsieur Caldarus n'est... qu'une fourmi.
russian: Мистер Кальдарус... просто букашка.
bulgarian: Mister Caldarus... is an ant.

english: Oh.
french: Oh.
russian: О.
bulgarian: Oh.

english: Miss Seridia, don't worry! The Dragonguard is here to protect you!
french: Mademoiselle Seridia, n'ayez pas peur ! La Garde des dragons est là pour vous protéger !
russian: Мисс Серидия, не переживайте! Драконья стража вас защитит!
bulgarian: Miss Seridia, don't worry! The Dragonguard is here to protect you!

english: Are you responsible for keeping peace in the town?
french: C'est à vous qu'il incombe de préserver la paix de la ville ?
russian: Вы отвечаете за порядок в этом городе?
bulgarian: Are you responsible for keeping peace in the town?

english: Are you granted power to punish those who break that peace?
french: Vous a-t-on octroyé l'autorisation de punir ceux qui la perturberaient ?
russian: У вас есть власть наказывать нарушителей спокойствия?
bulgarian: Are you granted power to punish those who break that peace?

english: Well, one time I accidentally left the door to my cricket terrarium open...
french: Eh bien, une fois, j'ai laissé la porte de mon terrarium à grillons ouverte...
russian: Ну, однажды я забыл закрыть дверь в своём террариуме со сверчками...
bulgarian: Well, one time I accidentally left the door to my cricket terrarium open...

english: And we had to spend the whole day catching crickets down in the kitchen!
french: Et on a passé la journée entière à tous les récupérer dans la cuisine !
russian: И нам пришлось целый день отлавливать сверчков по всей кухне!
bulgarian: And we had to spend the whole day catching crickets down in the kitchen!

english: So in that way we kind of kept the peace...
french: Alors d'une certaine manière, on a préservé la paix...
russian: В этом смысле мы очень даже поддерживаем спокойствие...
bulgarian: So in that way we kind of kept the peace...

english: And I got sent to my room afterwards! So the person responsible was punished, too!
french: Et après, on m'a envoyé dans ma chambre ! Donc le responsable a bien été puni !
russian: А меня тогда отправили сидеть в своей комнате! Так что виновник был справедливо наказан!
bulgarian: And I got sent to my room afterwards! So the person responsible was punished, too!

english: Tell me, children. What do your Dragonguard duties entail?
french: Les enfants, quelles sont vos responsabilités en tant que membres de la Garde des dragons ?
russian: Поведайте, дети. Что входит в обязанности Драконьей стражи?
bulgarian: Tell me, children. What do your Dragonguard duties entail?

english: What can I do to be more royal?
french: Comment je pourrais améliorer mon statut royal ?
russian: Что мне сделать, чтобы быть более царственной?
bulgarian: What can I do to be more royal?

english: Oh, that's easy! You just have to order people around!
french: Oh, c'est facile ! Il suffit de donner des ordres à tout le monde !
russian: О, это проще простого! Надо всего лишь раздавать всем приказы!
bulgarian: Oh, that's easy! You just have to order people around!

english: And you have to be really mean about it!
french: Et surtout d'être très autoritaire !
russian: И делать это надо как можно грубее!
bulgarian: And you have to be really mean about it!

english: Dell, Luc... I ORDER you to shut up! I'm asking Lady Seridia!
french: Dell, Luc... Je vous ORDONNE de la fermer ! C'est à dame Seridia que j'ai posé la question !
russian: Делл, Люк... Я ПРИКАЗЫВАЮ вам заткнуться! Я спросила Леди Серидию!
bulgarian: Dell, Luc... I ORDER you to shut up! I'm asking Lady Seridia!

english: In my opinion, you are already off to a marvelous start.
french: Je dirais que c'est déjà un très bon début.
russian: На мой взгляд, у тебя уже великолепно получается.
bulgarian: In my opinion, you are already off to a marvelous start.

english: Lady Seridia, I was wondering...
french: Dame Seridia, j'aurais voulu savoir...
russian: Леди Серидия, можно поинтересоваться...
bulgarian: Lady Seridia, I was wondering...

english: I wish I was half shark!
french: J'aimerais bien être à moitié requin !
russian: Я бы хотела быть полуакулой!
bulgarian: I wish I was half shark!

english: I'll be half kraken!
french: Et moi, à moitié kraken !
russian: Я буду полукракеном!
bulgarian: I'll be half kraken!

english: That's a lot of halves, Miss Terithia!
french: Ça fait beaucoup de moitiés quand même, madame Terithia !
russian: Многовато половин, мисс Теризия!
bulgarian: That's a lot of halves, Miss Terithia!

english: And that's when the leviathan breached the surface! Half shark, half kraken, half stingray!
french: Et c'est là que le Léviathan refit surface ! Moitié requin, moitié kraken, moitié raie !
russian: И тогда левиафан вынырнул из воды! Полуакула, полукракен, полускат!
bulgarian: And that's when the leviathan breached the surface! Half shark, half kraken, half stingray!

english: That can't be true, right [Ari]? Nothing could be that big...
french: Ça ne peut pas être vrai, hein, [Ari] ? Il n'existe rien d'aussi gros...
russian: Это же неправда, да, [Ari]? Таких больших штук не бывает...
bulgarian: That can't be true, right [Ari]? Nothing could be that big...

english: Actually, the ocean is full of mysteries. Really big mysteries.
french: L'océan regorge de mystères... De très grands mystères...
russian: Вообще-то океан полон загадок. Огромных загадок.
bulgarian: Actually, the ocean is full of mysteries. Really big mysteries.

english: WOW! It sounds so cool! I wanna fight it!
french: WAOUH ! Ça a l'air trop cool ! Je veux y aller !
russian: Ух ты! Звучит круто! Хочу сразиться с этой штукой!
bulgarian: WOW! It sounds so cool! I wanna fight it!

english: And what Seville didn't see in the storm was a HUGE BLACK SHADOW passin' under the belly of the boat! Then we all started hearing the strangest noise...
french: Et ce que Saville n'avait pas vu pendant la tempête, c'était une GIGANTESQUE OMBRE NOIRE qui passa sous le bateau ! Ensuite, des bruits étranges résonnèrent...
russian: Но кое-что в шторме ускользнуло от взгляда Севиль: ОГРОМНАЯ ЧЁРНАЯ ТЕНЬ под кормой лодки! И тут мы все услышали престранный шум...
bulgarian: And what Seville didn't see in the storm was a HUGE BLACK SHADOW passin' under the belly of the boat! Then we all started hearing the strangest noise...

english: Or ancient books?
french: Ou des livres anciens ?
russian: Или древние книги?
bulgarian: Or ancient books?

english: Or a skull?
french: Ou un crâne ?
russian: Или череп?
bulgarian: Or a skull?

english: Maple, Luc... why is Dell always asking me about dredging up skulls?
french: Maple, Luc... Pourquoi Dell me parle tout le temps de crânes ?
russian: Мэйпл, Люк... Скажите, почему Делл всё время спрашиват меня о ловле черепов?
bulgarian: Maple, Luc... why is Dell always asking me about dredging up skulls?

english: Because they're so cool!
french: Parce que c'est trop cool !
russian: Потому что они круто выглядят!
bulgarian: Because they're so cool!

english: Have you ever fished up treasure, Miss Terithia?
french: Vous avez déjà remonté un trésor, madame Terithia ?
russian: Вы когда-нибудь поднимали со дна сокровища, мисс Теризия?
bulgarian: Have you ever fished up treasure, Miss Terithia?

english: For when we have to fight a monster!
french: Pour qu'on soit prêts le jour où on affrontera un gros monstre !
russian: Нам пригодится для сражений с монстром!
bulgarian: For when we have to fight a monster!

english: Can we just... not fight the monster?
french: On ne pourrait pas... éviter de se battre contre des monstres ?
russian: А может... просто не будем с ним драться?
bulgarian: Can we just... not fight the monster?

english: I'm with Luc. Let's make friends with the monster!
french: Je suis d'accord avec Luc. On devrait plutôt être copains avec eux !
russian: Согласна с Люком. Давайте лучше подружимся с монстром.
bulgarian: I'm with Luc. Let's make friends with the monster!

english: The children want me to demonstrate how to field-dress a wound.
french: Les enfants veulent que je leur montre comment faire un pansement de combat.
russian: Дети хотят, чтобы я показала им, как обрабатывать раны.
bulgarian: The children want me to demonstrate how to field-dress a wound.

english: Cough... yes... I think this is the end of the road for me... avenge me...
french: (Tousse) Oui... Je crois que tout est fini pour moi... Vous me vengerez...
russian: Кх-кх... Да... Боюсь, это конец моего земного пути... Отомстите за меня...
bulgarian: Cough... yes... I think this is the end of the road for me... avenge me...

english: I'm not doing all that.
french: Ça, je ne crois pas.
russian: Я этим заниматься не буду.
bulgarian: I'm not doing all that.

english: Avenging someone is a lot of work, Dell!
french: C'est beaucoup de travail de venger quelqu'un, Dell !
russian: Отмщение — довольно хлопотное дело, Делл!
bulgarian: Avenging someone is a lot of work, Dell!

english: So you were grievously injured in a great battle? And only I can heal you?
french: Donc, tu as été grièvement blessée au combat ? Et je suis la seule à pouvoir te soigner ?
russian: Значит, тебя смертельно ранили в великой битве? И только я способна тебя излечить?
bulgarian: So you were grievously injured in a great battle? And only I can heal you?

english: Not me.
french: Pas moi.
russian: У меня нет.
bulgarian: Not me.

english: Really? Why not?
french: Ah bon ? Comment ça ?
russian: Правда? А почему?
bulgarian: Really? Why not?

english: Because it's gross...
french: Parce que c'est répugnant...
russian: Скелеты противные...
bulgarian: Because it's gross...

english: It's actually quite normal.
french: C'est pourtant tout à fait normal.
russian: Вообще-то, они совершенно обычные.
bulgarian: It's actually quite normal.

english: But is Maple normal?
french: Mais est-ce que Maple est normale ?
russian: А Мэйпл точно обычная?
bulgarian: But is Maple normal?

english: Did you know, children? Each of us has a skeleton inside us.
french: Les enfants, vous savez que chacun de nous a un squelette à l'intérieur ?
russian: А знаете, ребята, что у каждого из нас внутри есть скелет?
bulgarian: Did you know, children? Each of us has a skeleton inside us.

english: The skull!
french: Le crâne !
russian: Череп!
bulgarian: The skull!

english: Skull!
french: Le crâne !
russian: Череп!
bulgarian: Skull!

english: Skull! Skull! Skull!
french: Le crâne ! Le crâne ! Le crâne !
russian: Череп! Череп! Череп!
bulgarian: Skull! Skull! Skull!

english: I see we have some skull fans in the Clinic! Me too.
french: Je vois qu'on a des fans de crânes dans cette clinique ! Moi aussi.
russian: Вижу, в клинике многие ценят черепа! Я тоже.
bulgarian: I see we have some skull fans in the Clinic! Me too.

english: I can see you're fascinated with the Clinic's skeleton, children. Can you tell me what bone this is?
french: Je vois que le squelette de la clinique vous intrigue, les enfants. Vous pouvez me donner le nom de cet os.
russian: Я смотрю, дети, вас очень интересует скелет в моей клинике. Ну-ка скажите, что это за кость?
bulgarian: I can see you're fascinated with the Clinic's skeleton, children. Can you tell me what bone this is?

english: But?
french: Mais ?
russian: Но?
bulgarian: But?

english: I thought we'd be catching more sharks!
french: Je pensais qu'on attraperait plus de requins !
russian: Я думала, мы поймаем больше акул!
bulgarian: I thought we'd be catching more sharks!

english: Miss Terithia, I appreciate you teaching me how to fish, and I'm learning lots and lots...
french: Madame Terithia, je suis vraiment contente que vous me montriez comment pêcher. J'apprends plein de choses...
russian: Мисс Теризия, спасибо, что учите меня рыбачить, я уже многому научилась...
bulgarian: Miss Terithia, I appreciate you teaching me how to fish, and I'm learning lots and lots...

english: Patience? No wonder I'm so bad at fishing...
french: Il faut de la patience ? C'est pas étonnant que je sois si mauvaise alors...
russian: Терпение? Тогда понятно, почему рыбалка мне не даётся...
bulgarian: Patience? No wonder I'm so bad at fishing...

english: A warrior needs patience most of all, Dell.
french: Pour être une vraie guerrière, il faut de la patience aussi, Dell.
russian: Для воина терпение — тоже важнейший навык, Делл.
bulgarian: A warrior needs patience most of all, Dell.

english: Really? Wow...
french: Ah bon ? Oh...
russian: Правда? Хмм...
bulgarian: Really? Wow...

english: I'll be the most patient warrior ever! You'll see!
french: Dans ce cas, je serai la guerrière la plus patiente de toutes ! Promis, juré !
russian: Тогда я буду самым терпеливым воином! Вот увидите!
bulgarian: I'll be the most patient warrior ever! You'll see!

english: Fishing is all about patience, Dell! Patience, and then a quick strike!
french: La pêche est une école de la patience, Dell ! Il faut attendre et frapper au bon moment !
russian: В рыбалке важнее всего терпение, Делл! Терпеливо ждать и быстро дёрнуть!
bulgarian: Fishing is all about patience, Dell! Patience, and then a quick strike!

english: You know, since you're not busy or anything.
french: Vu que tu n'as pas grand-chose à faire.
russian: Я же знаю, тебе нечего делать.
bulgarian: You know, since you're not busy or anything.

english: So this is how you ask for help, hm? Well, the good news is that Dozy simply has a dust allergy.
french: C'est ainsi que tu demandes de l'aide ? En tout cas, sache que Dozy est juste allergique à la poussière.
russian: Хм, это ты так просишь помощи? Что ж, хорошая новость в том, что у Дрёмы просто аллергия на пыль.
bulgarian: So this is how you ask for help, hm? Well, the good news is that Dozy simply has a dust allergy.

english: The bad news is that I prescribe sweeping around here every once in a while.
french: La mauvaise, c'est que le remède consiste à faire le ménage régulièrement.
russian: Плохая новость в том, что я назначаю регулярную уборку в помещении.
bulgarian: The bad news is that I prescribe sweeping around here every once in a while.

english: (Dozy sneezes.)
french: (Dozy éternue.)
russian: (Дрёма чихает.)
bulgarian: (Dozy sneezes.)

english: Dozy just kept sneezing! So I thought you could take a look at him.
french: Dozy n'arrête pas d'éternuer, alors je me suis dit que tu pourrais l'ausculter.
russian: Дрёма всё время чихает! Думала, может, ты его посмотришь.
bulgarian: Dozy just kept sneezing! So I thought you could take a look at him.

english: Oh, but Dozy and I are getting on so well. Aren't we, friend?
french: Oh, mais Dozy et moi, on s'entend bien. Pas vrai, mon grand ?
russian: Ой, но мы с Дрёмой так хорошо ладим. Да, дружок?
bulgarian: Oh, but Dozy and I are getting on so well. Aren't we, friend?

english: (Dozy gleefully wags his tail.)
french: (Dozy remue la queue de manière enjouée.)
russian: (Дрёма радостно виляет хвостом.)
bulgarian: (Dozy gleefully wags his tail.)

english: Traitor...
french: Traître...
russian: Предатель...
bulgarian: Traitor...

english: You already finished Dozy's checkup, so why are you still here? Don't you have patients or whatever?
french: Tu as fini d'ausculter Dozy. Inutile de rester ici. Tu n'as pas des patients à voir ?
russian: Ты же уже закончила осмотр Дрёмы. Почему ты тут стоишь? У тебя нет других пациентов?
bulgarian: You already finished Dozy's checkup, so why are you still here? Don't you have patients or whatever?

english: I know you think I'm a quack, Juniper, but I assure you... I wouldn't misdiagnose a patient. Dozy is perfectly healthy.
french: Je sais que tu me prends pour une sorte de rebouteux, Juniper, mais je t'assure... jamais je ne mentirais sur le diagnostic d'un patient. Dozy est en parfaite santé.
russian: Я знаю, ты думаешь, что у меня не все дома, Джунипер. Но, уверяю тебя... Ложных диагнозов я не ставлю. Дрёма совершенно здоров.
bulgarian: I know you think I'm a quack, Juniper, but I assure you... I wouldn't misdiagnose a patient. Dozy is perfectly healthy.

english: Just a little sleepy.
french: Il a juste un peu sommeil.
russian: Просто любит поспать.
bulgarian: Just a little sleepy.

english: (Dozy gives Juniper and Valen a drowsy look, as though asking if he can go back to bed.)
french: (Dozy regarde Juniper et Valen en somnolant, comme s'il leur demandait de retourner dormir.)
russian: (Дрёма устало смотрит на Джунипер и Вален, как будто просит отпустить его обратно поспать.)
bulgarian: (Dozy gives Juniper and Valen a drowsy look, as though asking if he can go back to bed.)

english: Maybe you should check him a third time, Valen.
french: Tu devrais peut-être l'ausculter une troisième fois, Valen.
russian: Может, осмотришь его ещё раз, Вален?
bulgarian: Maybe you should check him a third time, Valen.

english: Oh, he... likes you. Well, don't let it go to your head.
french: Oh, il t'aime bien. Eh bien, que ça ne te monte pas à la tête.
russian: Ого, ты... ему нравишься. Но это не повод задирать нос.
bulgarian: Oh, he... likes you. Well, don't let it go to your head.

english: I wouldn't dream of it.
french: Pas le moins du monde.
russian: Я и не думала.
bulgarian: I wouldn't dream of it.

english: (Dozy excitedly wags his tail at Valen. He seems happy to see her.)
french: (Dozy remue la queue en voyant Valen. Il semble content de sa visite.)
russian: (Дрёма радостно виляет хвостом при виде Вален. Кажется, он рад ей.)
bulgarian: (Dozy excitedly wags his tail at Valen. He seems happy to see her.)

english: And Eiland will recommend a dessert to pair with my wine! See? That's teamwork!
french: Et Eiland me recommandera un dessert en accord avec mon vin ! C'est ce qu'on appelle le travail d'équipe !
russian: А Эйланд рекомендует десерт к вину! Ну как? Вот она, командная работа!
bulgarian: And Eiland will recommend a dessert to pair with my wine! See? That's teamwork!

english: Elsie and I made a deal. She'll recommend a wine to pair with my dinner...
french: Elsie et moi avons passé un marché. Elle m'indiquera le vin qui va avec mon plat...
russian: У нас с Элси уговор. Она рекомендует мне вино к обеду....
bulgarian: Elsie and I made a deal. She'll recommend a wine to pair with my dinner...

english: No need to be worried, Lord Eiland. The rum is perfectly safe, I assure you.
french: N'ayez crainte, messire Eiland. Je vous assure que ce rhum est parfaitement sans danger.
russian: Волнение здесь ни к чему, лорд Эйланд. Уверяю вас, бутылка в отличном состоянии.
bulgarian: No need to be worried, Lord Eiland. The rum is perfectly safe, I assure you.

english: I think Eiland's more worried because rum goes straight to his head.
french: Je crois qu'Eiland est inquiet parce que le rhum lui tourne vite à la tête.
russian: Думаю, Эйланд больше беспокоится, что ром ударит ему в голову.
bulgarian: I think Eiland's more worried because rum goes straight to his head.

english: Ugh, me too.
french: Argh, moi aussi.
russian: Ух, я тоже.
bulgarian: Ugh, me too.

english: But it's hard to pass up a drink of such unique circumstance.
french: Mais c'est dur de refuser une boisson obtenue dans de telles circonstances.
russian: Но как отказаться от такой экстравагантной выпивки?
bulgarian: But it's hard to pass up a drink of such unique circumstance.

english: That's the spirit! Bottoms up!
french: Bien dit ! Santé !
russian: Так держать! Пей до дна!
bulgarian: That's the spirit! Bottoms up!

english: Help me, [Ari]! Terithia is making us try some rum she fished out of the bay!
french: Au secours, [Ari] ! Terithia veut nous faire goûter un rhum qu'elle a repêché dans la baie !
russian: Выручай, [Ari]! Теризия заставляет нас пробовать ром из бутылки, которую она выловила в бухте!
bulgarian: Help me, [Ari]! Terithia is making us try some rum she fished out of the bay!

english: An old timer? I think you're quite youthful, Landen.
french: Un petit vieux ? Mais tu es toujours fringant, Landen.
russian: Старика? Ланден, ты ещё весьма молод.
bulgarian: An old timer? I think you're quite youthful, Landen.

english: HAH! Youthful? Compared to what? The ancient Alda civilization?
french: HA ! Fringant ? Par rapport à quoi ? L'ancienne civilisation d'Alda ?
russian: Хах! Молод? По сравнению с чем, с Древней Альдой?
bulgarian: HAH! Youthful? Compared to what? The ancient Alda civilization?

english: I suspect that's exactly what young Eiland is comparing you to.
french: Je crois que c'est exactement ce à quoi le jeune Eiland vous compare.
russian: Подозреваю, что у Эйланда в голове именно такие сравнения.
bulgarian: I suspect that's exactly what young Eiland is comparing you to.

english: A toast, to our hosts! Thanks for having an old timer over for some grub.
french: Je lève mon verre à mes hôtes ! Merci d'avoir invité un petit vieux à partager votre repas.
russian: Тост за хозяев! Спасибо, что пригласили старика на ваши харчи.
bulgarian: A toast, to our hosts! Thanks for having an old timer over for some grub.

english: Indeed! There's so much still out there, waiting to be found.
french: Effectivement ! Et il reste encore tellement de choses à découvrir.
russian: В самом деле! Ещё множество ценностей в глубинах земли ожидают своего часа.
bulgarian: Indeed! There's so much still out there, waiting to be found.

english: I'm glad we made time to do some digging out here, Errol... it's been a good day for discoveries.
french: Je suis content que nous ayons eu le temps d'effectuer des fouilles, Errol... La journée a été riche en découvertes.
russian: Рад, что у нас нашлось время для совместных раскопок, Эррол... Сегодня день богат на находки.
bulgarian: I'm glad we made time to do some digging out here, Errol... it's been a good day for discoveries.

english: I appreciate it, Errol. I'll fill you in on any exciting discoveries!
french: Avec plaisir, Errol. Je vous dirai ce que j'ai trouvé !
russian: Спасибо, Эррол. Я сообщу, если будут выдающиеся находки!
bulgarian: I appreciate it, Errol. I'll fill you in on any exciting discoveries!

english: I'll attend to the Museum, so you go ahead and focus on the excavation at the Western Ruins.
french: Je dois m'occuper du musée, alors concentrez-vous sur les fouilles dans les ruines de l'ouest.
russian: Я посмотрю за музеем, так что вы можете пойти заняться раскопками в Западных руинах.
bulgarian: I'll attend to the Museum, so you go ahead and focus on the excavation at the Western Ruins.

english: Why, I thought that was lichen! It's a good thing we've got your young eyes, Lord Eiland.
french: Oh, j'ai cru que c'était du lichen ! Heureusement vous avez une vue de jeune homme, messire Eiland.
russian: Ничего себе, я думал, это лишайник! Нам повезло, что у нас есть ваши молодые глаза, лорд Эйланд!
bulgarian: Why, I thought that was lichen! It's a good thing we've got your young eyes, Lord Eiland.

english: It's badly eroded, but I believe there's trace amounts of paint in the crevices of some of these carvings.
french: Elles sont très érodées, mais je crois avoir repéré des traces de peinture dans les creux de certaines sculptures.
russian: Желобки сильно выветрились, но мне кажется, в этих узорах можно заметить остатки краски.
bulgarian: It's badly eroded, but I believe there's trace amounts of paint in the crevices of some of these carvings.

english: Yes, I see that... most interesting. Could they refer to a place? A person?
french: Oui, je vois... C'est très intéressant. Est-ce qu'il pourrait s'agir d'un endroit ? Ou d'une personne ?
russian: Да, вижу... весьма интересно. Может, они обозначают какое-то место? Или человека?
bulgarian: Yes, I see that... most interesting. Could they refer to a place? A person?

english: And look here! The charcoal rubbing I took at the Western Ruins matches the partial manuscript, except for these two characters.
french: Oh, regardez par ici ! Le calque au charbon que j'ai effectué dans les ruines de l'ouest est identique à ce bout de manuscrit, hormis ces deux caractères.
russian: И вот моя зарисовка с Западных руин, смотри. Письмо очень похоже на тот кусок рукописи, кроме этих двух символов.
bulgarian: And look here! The charcoal rubbing I took at the Western Ruins matches the partial manuscript, except for these two characters.

english: Look here! This stain indicates it might have been used to store food. Honey, perhaps? I have a file on ancient Aldarian apiaries somewhere here.
french: Là, regardez ! Cette tache indique que cela servait à stocker de la nourriture. Peut-être du miel ? J'ai un dossier sur les anciens ruchers aldariens quelque part.
russian: Смотри! По этому пятну можно предположить, что его использовали для хранения пищи. Возможно, мёда? У меня где-то тут лежит папка о древнеальдийском пчеловодстве.
bulgarian: Look here! This stain indicates it might have been used to store food. Honey, perhaps? I have a file on ancient Aldarian apiaries somewhere here.

english: I found a small cache of pottery fragments at the Western dig site. I have some here, but we'll have to take our time excavating the rest.
french: J'ai trouvé une petite cache de fragments de poterie sur le site de fouilles de l'ouest. J'en ai ramené quelques-uns, mais il nous faudra du temps pour tout exhumer.
russian: Я нашёл небольшое скопление кусков керамики в западном раскопе. Чуть-чуть я принёс, но нужно время, чтобы раскопать остальные.
bulgarian: I found a small cache of pottery fragments at the Western dig site. I have some here, but we'll have to take our time excavating the rest.

english: When you put it like that, it would be irresponsible to not have seconds!
french: Vous avez raison, je vais me resservir !
russian: Когда ты так говоришь, не взять добавки кажется просто безответственно!
bulgarian: When you put it like that, it would be irresponsible to not have seconds!

english: Eat up, Lord Eiland! It's important to have a hearty breakfast before a dig. That's no different from when I worked the Mines!
french: Mangez, messire Eiland ! C'est important d'avaler un bon petit-déjeuner avant une journée de fouilles. Comme quand je travaillais à la mine !
russian: Ешьте как следует, лорд Эйланд! Перед раскопками надо плотно позавтракать. Когда я работал в шахтах, было так же.
bulgarian: Eat up, Lord Eiland! It's important to have a hearty breakfast before a dig. That's no different from when I worked the Mines!

english: Very gracious of you, Lord Eiland!
french: C'est très aimable, messire Eiland !
russian: Очень любезно с вашей стороны, лорд Эйланд!
bulgarian: Very gracious of you, Lord Eiland!

english: Cheers, Errol. Drinks are on me tonight!
french: À la vôtre, Errol. C'est moi qui régale, ce soir !
russian: Твоё здоровье, Эррол! За выпивку сегодня плачу я.
bulgarian: Cheers, Errol. Drinks are on me tonight!

english: I couldn't ask for a better collaborator or curator. Your love of history and preservation is a gift to Mistria.
