english: No worries. I can handle it.
french: Ne t'en fais pas, je gère.
russian: Я вывезу, не переживай.
bulgarian: No worries. I can handle it.

english: You collected a lot of orders from around town, March.
french: Tu as reçu beaucoup de commandes des habitants de Mistria, March.
russian: Ты по всему городу набрал заказов, Март.
bulgarian: You collected a lot of orders from around town, March.

english: Yeah! Like something adjustable.
french: C'est ça ! Quelque chose qui serait réglable.
russian: Да! С разными регулировками.
bulgarian: Yeah! Like something adjustable.

english: So it's got to have moving parts. Interesting. Let me think on it.
french: Il faut donc qu'il y ait des pièces amovibles. Intéressant. Laisse-moi y réfléchir.
russian: Хм, значит, понадобятся подвижные детали. Интересно. Я ещё подумаю.
bulgarian: So it's got to have moving parts. Interesting. Let me think on it.

english: So you want a universal plane for shaving down wood?
french: Comme ça, tu voudrais un rabot universel pour le bois ?
russian: Ты хочешь универсальный рубанок, чтобы строгать древесину?
bulgarian: So you want a universal plane for shaving down wood?

english: That's right. Tools are in high demand these days.
french: Oui, entre autres. La demande d'outils a explosé dernièrement.
russian: Точно. На инструменты сейчас большой спрос.
bulgarian: That's right. Tools are in high demand these days.

english: You need wood for tools? Like the handles?
french: Tu as besoin de bois pour des outils ? Pour les manches, par exemple ?
russian: Тебе нужна древесина для инструментов? Для ручек, может быть?
bulgarian: You need wood for tools? Like the handles?

english: Hm, I thought so... can you recommend something sturdier?
french: Mmm, c'est ce qu'il me semblait... Tu aurais un bois plus dur à me conseiller ?
russian: Хм, так я и думал... Можешь порекомендовать дерево покрепче?
bulgarian: Hm, I thought so... can you recommend something sturdier?

english: The wood you're talking about is way too soft to take a nail.
french: Ce bois est bien trop tendre pour que tu puisses enfoncer un clou avec.
russian: Древесина, про которую ты говоришь, от таких гвоздей треснет.
bulgarian: The wood you're talking about is way too soft to take a nail.

english: Can you give me some time with this? It's an interesting problem.
french: Tu me laisses un peu de temps pour y réfléchir ? C'est un problème intéressant.
russian: Можно немного времени на размышления? Это любопытная задачка.
bulgarian: Can you give me some time with this? It's an interesting problem.

english: Take all the time you want!
french: Prends tout le temps qu'il te faudra !
russian: Времени у тебя, сколько потребуется!
bulgarian: Take all the time you want!

english: You'll want your hooks to be made with a sturdy metal, but I think blending ores might get you a more flexible fishing rod.
french: Tes hameçons doivent être faits dans un métal résistant, mais un alliage te permettrait d'avoir une canne à pêche plus souple.
russian: Крючки надо делать из прочного металла, а вот для гибкой удочки лучше подойдёт сплав.
bulgarian: You'll want your hooks to be made with a sturdy metal, but I think blending ores might get you a more flexible fishing rod.

english: I respect the skill it takes to prepare it.
french: Je respecte le talent nécessaire à leur préparation.
russian: Я ценю усилия, вложенные в готовку.
bulgarian: I respect the skill it takes to prepare it.

english: And it tastes pretty good too.
french: Et puis... c'est bon aussi.
russian: И на вкус очень даже хорошо.
bulgarian: And it tastes pretty good too.

english: I didn't take you for the type to enjoy sashimi, March!
french: Je ne pensais pas que tu aimais les sashimis, March !
russian: Не думала, что тебе нравится сасими, Март!
bulgarian: I didn't take you for the type to enjoy sashimi, March!

english: I do, but if it's mostly sneezing he might try trimming that mustache first.
french: Oui, mais si ça se manifeste surtout par des éternuements, qu'il commence par tailler sa moustache.
russian: Да, но если дело в чихании, то пусть для начала попробует подрезать усы.
bulgarian: I do, but if it's mostly sneezing he might try trimming that mustache first.

english: Holt thinks he might have allergies. Do you have anything for that?
french: Holt pense qu'il est peut-être allergique. Ça se soigne ?
russian: Хольт считает, что у него аллергия. У тебя есть что-то от аллергии?
bulgarian: Holt thinks he might have allergies. Do you have anything for that?

english: Thanks, Valen. You're a lifesaver, as always.
french: Merci, Valen. Tu me sauves la mise, comme toujours.
russian: Спасибо, Вален. Ты, как всегда, выручаешь.
bulgarian: Thanks, Valen. You're a lifesaver, as always.

english: Your ankle doesn't look swollen, but send Dell over to fetch me if you have trouble tomorrow morning.
french: Ta cheville n'a pas l'air enflée, mais si ça ne va pas demain matin, envoie Dell me chercher.
russian: Лодыжка у тебя вроде не распухла, но если завтра утром будет болеть, можешь прислать за мной Делл.
bulgarian: Your ankle doesn't look swollen, but send Dell over to fetch me if you have trouble tomorrow morning.

english: Hah! You know, it IS nice. It's always an adventure, too!
french: Ha ! En effet, et c'est aussi une véritable aventure.
russian: Ха! Знаешь, правда хорошо. И вечно случаются какие-то приключения.
bulgarian: Hah! You know, it IS nice. It's always an adventure, too!

english: It must be nice, running the business with your family.
french: Ce doit être sympathique de gérer un commerce en famille.
russian: Хорошо, наверное, когда бизнес семейный.
bulgarian: It must be nice, running the business with your family.

english: Nice and quiet. Which means people in town are well, so I don't mind it at all.
french: Oui, c'est plutôt calme. Ce qui veut dire que les habitants sont en bonne santé et c'est tant mieux.
russian: Тихо и спокойно. А значит, в городе все здоровы, так что я не желуюсь.
bulgarian: Nice and quiet. Which means people in town are well, so I don't mind it at all.

english: How's the Clinic, Valen?
french: Tout se passe bien à la clinique, Valen ?
russian: Как дела в клинике, Вален?
bulgarian: How's the Clinic, Valen?

english: I'll ask him! I'm sure he'll say something like, "Sounds like skele-tons of fun!"
french: Je vais lui demander ! Je suis sûre qu'il va me répondre « Je m'y mets d'os suite ! »
russian: Я у него спрошу! Наверняка ответит что-ниудь вроде: «С лёг-костью помогу!».
bulgarian: I'll ask him! I'm sure he'll say something like, "Sounds like skele-tons of fun!"

english: I'll leave it to you, then.
french: Euh... d'accord, merci.
russian: Тогда точно лучше спроси ты.
bulgarian: I'll leave it to you, then.

english: Do you think Holt could whittle a medical model of a femur? I'd like one for a demonstration.
french: Tu crois que Holt pourrait me sculpter un fémur ? C'est pour montrer à mes patients.
russian: Как ты думаешь, Хольт может вырезать медицинскую модель бедренной кости? Мне нужно для демонстрации.
bulgarian: Do you think Holt could whittle a medical model of a femur? I'd like one for a demonstration.

english: It was pure bliss. I read every murder mystery in the house, and then my father trudged out into the snow to get me some more!
french: C'était le bonheur ! J'avais lu tous les romans policiers de la maison et mon père avait bravé la neige pour m'en apporter d'autres !
russian: Чудное было время. Я прочитала все детективы в доме, а потом отец пробирался сквозь снег, чтобы добыть мне ещё!
bulgarian: It was pure bliss. I read every murder mystery in the house, and then my father trudged out into the snow to get me some more!

english: Do you remember the Year of the Two Week Blizzard? That was really something. I don't think it's snowed like that since.
french: Tu te souviens de l'année où la tempête de neige a duré deux semaines ? C'était quelque chose... Je ne crois pas qu'il ait neigé comme ça depuis.
russian: Помнишь год двухнедельной пурги? Вот это была погода! Не припомню с тех пор такого снегопада.
bulgarian: Do you remember the Year of the Two Week Blizzard? That was really something. I don't think it's snowed like that since.

english: Wow, you and March are quick! Thank you!
french: Waouh, vous ne traînez pas, March et toi ! Merci !
russian: Ничего себе, как вы с Мартом быстро управились! Спасибо!
bulgarian: Wow, you and March are quick! Thank you!

english: Here's those brackets you needed for your shelving! Ryis says he'll come by and install them the next time he's doing rounds around town.
french: Voilà les crochets pour tes étagères ! Ryis dit qu'il passera les installer lors de sa prochaine inspection en ville.
russian: У нас уже готовы твои уголки для полок! Риз сказал, что зайдёт и поставит их тебе, когда будет по пути.
bulgarian: Here's those brackets you needed for your shelving! Ryis says he'll come by and install them the next time he's doing rounds around town.

english: This one's a pudding stone! You're a long way from home, little fella!
french: C'est du poudingue ! Tu en as parcouru du chemin, mon coco !
russian: Это пудинговый камень! Далеко тебя занесло, да, малыш?
bulgarian: This one's a pudding stone! You're a long way from home, little fella!

english: I found this cool rock when I was wandering around the Narrows. Think you could identify it for me?
french: J'ai trouvé cette jolie pierre en me baladant du côté des Terrasses. Tu saurais me dire ce que c'est ?
russian: Смотри, какой крутой камень я нашёл на прогулке в Ущелье. Поможешь его опознать?
bulgarian: I found this cool rock when I was wandering around the Narrows. Think you could identify it for me?

english: Pretty good. I made the rounds and oiled some hinges earlier. Should make time to check some of the town's older stone foundations.
french: Rien à signaler. J'ai fait un tour et j'en ai profité pour huiler quelques gonds. Il faudrait que j'aille examiner les vieilles fondations en pierre un de ces jours.
russian: Неплохо. Я прошёлся по городу и смазал петли. Надо ещё найти время осмотреть старые городские фундаменты.
bulgarian: Pretty good. I made the rounds and oiled some hinges earlier. Should make time to check some of the town's older stone foundations.

english: Ooh, exciting!
french: Oh, trop cool !
russian: Ого, звучит увлекательно!
bulgarian: Ooh, exciting!

english: How's the town looking, Ryis?
french: Tout va bien en ville, Ryis ?
russian: Ну что, Риз, осмотрел дома?
bulgarian: How's the town looking, Ryis?

english: It was not my choice, Olric... I was imprisoned down there.
french: Je n'ai pas eu le choix, Olric... J'étais emprisonnée dans les profondeurs de ce lieu.
russian: Я была там не по своей воле, Ольрик... Меня держали в заточении.
bulgarian: It was not my choice, Olric... I was imprisoned down there.

english: I get that, but Errol is super strict about this stuff... he'll be so mad if he finds out.
french: Je comprends, mais Errol est super strict là-dessus... Il va se mettre en rogne quand il saura.
russian: Понимаю, но у Эррола всё очень строго... Он будет ужасно ругаться, если узнает.
bulgarian: I get that, but Errol is super strict about this stuff... he'll be so mad if he finds out.

english: Really?
french: Vraiment ?
russian: Правда?
bulgarian: Really?

english: Then perhaps I will tell him myself.
french: Dans ce cas, je lui dirai en personne.
russian: Тогда, возможно, я расскажу ему лично.
bulgarian: Then perhaps I will tell him myself.

english: Seridia, only [Ari] is allowed in the Mines!
french: Seridia, seul<she>e</she><he></he><they>·e</they> [Ari] a le droit d'entrer dans les mines !
russian:
Серидия, [Ari] —

единственные

единственнаяединственныйединственное, кому можно в шахты!
bulgarian: Seridia, only [Ari] is allowed in the Mines!

english: You used to hang out down there, right? Ever see anything scary?
french: Vous, vous y avez passé pas mal de temps, non ? Vous avez vu des trucs effrayants ?
russian: Ты же долго там была, да? Видела что-нибудь жуткое?
bulgarian: You used to hang out down there, right? Ever see anything scary?

english: Hah! Ahaha!
french: Ha ! Ha ha !
russian: Ха! А-ха-ха!
bulgarian: Hah! Ahaha!

english: Hahaha!
french: Ha ha ha !
russian: Ха-ха-ха!
bulgarian: Hahaha!

english: Hahaha!
french: Ha ha ha !
russian: Ха-ха-ха!
bulgarian: Hahaha!

english: Haha! Wait, why are we laughing again?
french: Ha ha ! Mais attendez, pourquoi on rigole comme ça ?
russian: Ха-ха! Погоди, а что тут смешного?
bulgarian: Haha! Wait, why are we laughing again?

english: Errol says these mines are haunted...
french: Errol dit que ces mines sont hantées...
russian: Эррол говорит, в этих шахтах призраки...
bulgarian: Errol says these mines are haunted...

english: But sometimes you like to visit the entrance so you can... "remember the good times".
french: Mais vous aimez toutefois venir à l'entrée, car cela vous... « rappelle de bons souvenirs ».
russian: Но иногда ты приходишь ко входу, чтобы... «вспомнить старые-добрые деньки»?
bulgarian: But sometimes you like to visit the entrance so you can... "remember the good times".

english: Yeah! Don't you ever do that?
french: C'est ça ! Vous ne le faites jamais ?
russian: Ага! А ты разве так не делаешь?
bulgarian: Yeah! Don't you ever do that?

english: The places I remember are long gone... so no, I do not.
french: Les endroits dont je me souviens n'existent plus depuis bien longtemps, donc... non, je ne le fais pas.
russian: Мест, которые я могу помнить, уже давно нет на свете... Так что, нет, не делаю.
bulgarian: The places I remember are long gone... so no, I do not.

english: Sounds like you need to go to some new places and make some new memories!
french: Ça veut dire que vous devez découvrir de nouveaux lieux et créer de nouveaux souvenirs !
russian: Наверное, тебе пора сходить в новые места и наполучать новых воспоминаний!
bulgarian: Sounds like you need to go to some new places and make some new memories!

english: Hm. I suppose I am working on it.
french: Mmm. Je suppose que c'est ce à quoi je m'attelle, ces temps-ci.
russian: Хм. Наверное, этим я и занимаюсь.
bulgarian: Hm. I suppose I am working on it.

english: You are very wise for one so muscular, Olric.
french: Vous êtes très sage pour quelqu'un d'aussi musclé, Olric.
russian: Неожиданная мудрость от такого бугая, как ты, Ольрик.
bulgarian: You are very wise for one so muscular, Olric.

english: So I am to understand that the Mines are condemned, and therefore you cannot go inside.
french: Je dois donc comprendre que les mines sont condamnées et que vous ne pouvez par conséquent pas y pénétrer ?
russian: Выходит, по твоим словам, шахты — проклятое место, и туда нельзя заходить.
bulgarian: So I am to understand that the Mines are condemned, and therefore you cannot go inside.

english: I've learned my lesson about bestowing unimaginable power.
french: Pour ce qui est d'octroyer des pouvoirs incommensurables, j'ai appris la leçon.
russian: Я усвоила свой урок и больше не дарую невероятные силы.
bulgarian: I've learned my lesson about bestowing unimaginable power.

english: Aw, I don't need to get paid to help out a bud, Seri!
french: Oh, je ne m'attends pas à me faire payer pour aider une amie, Seri !
russian: Ой, да за помощь в дружбу не нужно платить, Сери!
bulgarian: Aw, I don't need to get paid to help out a bud, Seri!

english: ... I mean, a cool gem would be pretty sweet... if you've got one lying around.
french: Enfin, même si une jolie pierre, ça ne serait pas de refus... si jamais vous en avez une sous la main.
russian: То есть... Крутой камешек было бы
bulgarian: ... I mean, a cool gem would be pretty sweet... if you've got one lying around.

english: I must warn you Olric, I can only pay for your services with gold or gems.
french: Olric, je dois vous avertir que je ne peux m'acquitter de vos services qu'en or et en pierres précieuses.
russian: Должна предупредить, Ольрик, я могу оплатить твои услуги лишь золотом или драгоценными камнями.
bulgarian: I must warn you Olric, I can only pay for your services with gold or gems.

english: Wow, that's so nice of you!
french: Waouh, c'est très sympa de votre part !
russian: Ух ты, мне очень приятно!
bulgarian: Wow, that's so nice of you!

english: But... it's kinda...
french: Mais... c'est un peu...
russian: Вот только....
bulgarian: But... it's kinda...

english: The title displeases you. What is your preference?
french: Ce titre ne vous plaît pas. Quelle serait votre préférence ?
russian: Этот титул тебе не по нраву? Какой бы ты предпочёл?
bulgarian: The title displeases you. What is your preference?

english: Lord of Leg Day!
french: Le Seigneur des abdos !
russian: Владыка мышц!
bulgarian: Lord of Leg Day!

english: Olric, in another life, I would have made you my Grand Minister of Calisthenics.
french: Olric, dans une autre vie, j'aurais fait de vous mon Ministre suprême à la callisthénie.
russian: Ольрик, в иной жизни я бы сделала тебя главным министром физкультуры.
bulgarian: Olric, in another life, I would have made you my Grand Minister of Calisthenics.

english: Such a subtle touch of leather... but I find it pleasantly understated.
french: Cette touche de cuir est... subtilement discrète.
russian: Такие тонкие кожаные акценты... Мне нравится их неожиданная скромность.
bulgarian: Such a subtle touch of leather... but I find it pleasantly understated.

english: Aw, thanks Seri! I like how understated your outfits are, too!
french: Ah, merci Seri ! Moi aussi, j'aime le côté subtilement discret de vos vêtements !
russian: Ой, спасибо, Сери! Мне тоже нравятся твои скромные наряды!
bulgarian: Aw, thanks Seri! I like how understated your outfits are, too!

english: I find myself appreciating your ensembles, Olric.
french: Vos tenues sont tout à fait à mon goût, Olric.
russian: Твой выбор костюма мне по нраву, Ольрик.
bulgarian: I find myself appreciating your ensembles, Olric.

english: Four thousand four hundred ninety... four thousand four hundred ninety one... four thousand four hundred ninety two...
french: Quatre mille quatre cent quatre-vingt-dix... Quatre mille quatre cent quatre-vingt-onze... Quatre mille quatre cent quatre-vingt-douze...
russian: Четыре тысячи четыреста девяносто... Четыре тысячи четыреста девяносто один... Четыре тысячи четыреста девяносто два...
bulgarian: Four thousand four hundred ninety... four thousand four hundred ninety one... four thousand four hundred ninety two...

english: Fifty three... fifty four... fifty five...
french: Cinquante-trois... Cinquante-quatre... Cinquante-cinq...
russian: Пятьдесят три... пятьдесят четыре... пятьдесят пять...
bulgarian: Fifty three... fifty four... fifty five...

english: Oh, he's a lifesaver. My ol' fishing rod jams a lot these days, and that's how the fish get away!
french: Oh, c'est génial. Ma vieille canne à pêche n'arrête pas de se gripper ces temps-ci et les poissons en profitent pour s'échapper !
russian: Как он меня выручает! Последнее время моя старая удочка часто заедает — так рыба и ускользает от меня!
bulgarian: Oh, he's a lifesaver. My ol' fishing rod jams a lot these days, and that's how the fish get away!

english: March has the pieces of your reel all finished. He's just gotta put them together.
french: March a terminé les différentes pièces de ton moulinet. Il ne lui reste plus qu'à les assembler.
russian: Март уже доделал тебе катушку. Осталось только собрать все детали.
bulgarian: March has the pieces of your reel all finished. He's just gotta put them together.

english: Wonderful!
french: Parfait !
russian: Чудно!
bulgarian: Wonderful!

english: Hm. Olric, I'm afraid that "bummer vibes" is not the kind of medical terminology I'm looking for. Good effort, though.
french: Euh, Olric. Je préfère éviter le terme « coup de mou » dans mes dossiers, mais merci quand même.
russian: Хмм. Ольрик, «везде колбасит» это не совсем те медицинские термины, которые мне нужны. Но я ценю твоё старание.
bulgarian: Hm. Olric, I'm afraid that "bummer vibes" is not the kind of medical terminology I'm looking for. Good effort, though.

english: Thanks, boss!
french: De rien, patronne !
russian: Спасибо, босс!
bulgarian: Thanks, boss!

english: Valen, I recorded the last patient's symptoms for you! Just like you asked!
french: Valen, j'ai noté les symptômes du dernier patient pour toi ! Comme tu me l'avais demandé !
russian: Вален, я записал симптомы последнего пациента, как ты просила!
bulgarian: Valen, I recorded the last patient's symptoms for you! Just like you asked!

english: Aw...
french: Mais...
russian: Эх...
bulgarian: Aw...

english: However, this is the biggest deltoid I've ever recorded in all my years practicing.
french: En tout cas, c'est le plus gros deltoïde que j'aie jamais vu de ma vie.
russian: Но это самая большая дельта, что я видела в своей практике.
bulgarian: However, this is the biggest deltoid I've ever recorded in all my years practicing.

english: Whoa!
french: Hé hé !
russian: Ух ты!
bulgarian: Whoa!

english: I don't know that you discovered a new muscle, Olric.
french: Je ne suis pas sûre que tu aies découvert un nouveau muscle, Olric.
russian: Не уверена, что ты правда открыл новую мышцу, Ольрик...
bulgarian: I don't know that you discovered a new muscle, Olric.

english: Fascinating, the way the human body can surpass its own limits.
french: C'est fou comme le corps humain est capable de dépasser ses limites.
russian: Удивительно, как широки пределы человеческих возможностей.
bulgarian: Fascinating, the way the human body can surpass its own limits.

english: Want me to pick it up right now?
french: Tu veux que je la soulève, là ?
russian: Хочешь, сейчас возьму и подниму?
bulgarian: Want me to pick it up right now?

english: That's alright. I'm not interested in surpassing the limits of March's temper.
french: Non, ça ira. On risquerait de dépasser les limites de March en termes de patience.
russian: Не нужно. Испытывать пределы терпения Марта мне точно не хочется.
bulgarian: That's alright. I'm not interested in surpassing the limits of March's temper.

english: And you say you can pick up the whole anvil? By yourself?
french: Tu dis que tu peux soulever cette enclume ? Tout seul ?
russian: Ты правда можешь поднять наковальню целиком? В одиночку?
bulgarian: And you say you can pick up the whole anvil? By yourself?

english: Well, you're in luck! I've just restocked.
french: Ça tombe bien, je viens d'en recevoir.
russian: Тебе повезло! У меня как раз готова свежая партия.
bulgarian: Well, you're in luck! I've just restocked.

english: Our medicine cabinet was looking a little empty, so mom sent me over to pick up some syrups.
french: Notre armoire à pharmacie est un peu vide, alors maman m'a envoyée chercher du sirop.
russian: Наша домашняя аптечка слегка растратилась, так что мама послала меня за сиропами.
bulgarian: Our medicine cabinet was looking a little empty, so mom sent me over to pick up some syrups.

english: You'll be fine, Ryis, it looks worse than it is. But that's good advice, [Ari].
french: Ça va aller, Ryis, c'est moins grave qu'il n'y paraît. Mais suis son conseil, [Ari].
russian: Да всё в порядке, Риз, выглядит хуже, чем на самом деле. Но совет хороший, [Ari].
bulgarian: You'll be fine, Ryis, it looks worse than it is. But that's good advice, [Ari].

english: Hey, [Ari]. Friendly piece of advice? Don't get to hammering before you're totally awake.
french: Salut, [Ari]. Tu veux un conseil ? Ne te sers pas de ton marteau avant d'être bien réveillé<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they>.
russian: Вот тебе дружеский совет, [Ari]: не становись за станок поутру, пока не проснёшься как следует.
bulgarian: Hey, [Ari]. Friendly piece of advice? Don't get to hammering before you're totally awake.

english: That's a relief. Thanks, Valen.
french: Ah, tant mieux. Merci, Valen.
russian: Спасибо, Вален. Ты меня успокоила.
bulgarian: That's a relief. Thanks, Valen.

english: It's good that you came to check it out, but I don't think it's sprained. Keep it elevated when you sleep tonight and you should be fine.
french: C'est bien que tu sois venu me montrer ça, mais ça n'a pas l'air d'être une entorse. Surélève ta cheville en dormant ce soir et ça devrait aller.
russian: Я думаю, растяжения нет, но ты молодец, что пришёл показать. Держи её повыше, когда будешь спать, — и всё пройдёт.
bulgarian: It's good that you came to check it out, but I don't think it's sprained. Keep it elevated when you sleep tonight and you should be fine.

english: That explains why I'm such a genius!
french: C'est pour ça que je suis si intelligente !
russian: Вот в чём секрет моей гениальности!
bulgarian: That explains why I'm such a genius!

french: HÉ HÉ HÉ !
russian: КЯ-ХА-ХА!
bulgarian: KYA HA HA!

french: Savais-tu que l'huile de poisson était très bonne pour le cerveau, [Ari] ?
russian:
Рыбий жир очень полезен для мозга. Ты

знали

зналазналзнало, [Ari]?

russian: Вы гляньте, ну что за подлиза!
bulgarian: We've got a flatterer here!

english: KYA HA HA!
french: HÉ HÉ HÉ !
russian: КЯ-ХА-ХА!
bulgarian: KYA HA HA!

english: You're the picture of health, Terithia. Fishing keeps you young!
french: Tu es en parfaite santé, Terithia. Il n'y a pas à dire, manger du poisson, ça conserve !
russian: Вы просто образец здоровья, Теризия. Остаётесь молодой благодаря рыбалке!
bulgarian: You're the picture of health, Terithia. Fishing keeps you young!
